601.e: Remembering the war, the Yoginis are hailing and the trembling cowards of the Iron Age also became fearless, the hags are laughing violently and Sheshnaga, getting dubious, is wavering.497.

The gods are looking and saying “Bravo, bravo”, and the goddess getting glorious, is shouting, the flowing wounds inflicted by the swords are testing the warriors and the fighters alongwith their horses are enduring the cruelty of war.498.

601.g: ਗਣਿ ਹੂਰ ਸੁ ਪੂਰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਰਣੰ ॥
601.t: gan hoor su poorat dhoor rana(n) ||

601.e: The goddess Chandi, riding on her lion, is shouting loudly and her glorious sword is gleaming, because of the ganas and heavenly damsels, the battlefield has become filled with dust and all the gods and demons are looking at this war.499.

Seeing the radiant headless trunks, roaming in the war-arena, the gods are becoming pleased, the warriors are wedding the heavenly damsels in the battlefield and seeing the warriors, the Sun-god is withholding his chariot.500.
The ghosts and fiends are dancing to the tune of drums, anklets, tabors, conche, fifes, kettledrums etc.501.
Conquering the fearless kings of the West, in anger, kalki marched forward towards the Souh, the enemies, leaving their countries, ran away and the warriors thundered in the battlefield.502.

602.e: The mighty ghosts and Baitals, danced, the elephants trumpetted and the heart-moving instruments were played the horses neighed and the elephants roared the swords in the hands of the warriors looked splendid.503.

602.g: ਗਿਰੇ ਤਛ ਮੁਛੰ ਨਚੀ ਰੁੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੀ ॥੫੦੪॥
602.t: gire tachh muchha(n) nachee ru(n)dd mu(n)ddee ||504||
602.e: After killing the proud demons of the West, now the trumpets sounded in the South, there the warriors of Bijapur and Golkunda were killed the warriors fell and the goddess Kali, the wearer of the rosary of skulls, began to dance.504.

The battles were fought with the residents of Setubandh and other ports and with the persistent warriors of Matasya Pradesh, the inhabitants of Telangana and the warriors of Dravir and Surat were destroyed.505.

602.g: ਚਪੇ ਚਾਦ ਰਾਜਾ ਚਲੇ ਚਾਦ ਬਾਸੀ ॥
602.t: chape chaadh raajaa chale chaadh baasee ||

602.e: The honour of the king of Chand town mashed, the kings of Vidarbha country were suppressed in great ire after conquering and chastising the South, the Lord Kalki journeyed towards the East.506.

602.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਦਛਨ ਜੈ ਬਿਜਯ ਨਾਮ ਦੂਜਾ ਧਿਆਯ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨॥
602.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the kalakee avataar dhachhan jai bijay naam dhoojaa dhiaay samaapata(n) ||2||
602.e: End of the second chapter entitled “Kalki Incarnation, Victory over the South” in Bachittar Natak.2.
PAADHARI STANZA (Now begins the description of the fighting in the East)
After conquering the West and devastating the South, Kalki incarnation went towards the East and his trumpets of victory sounded.507.
There he met the kings of Magadha, who were experts in eighteen sciences, on that side there were also fearless kings of Bang, Kaling, Nepal etc.508.
Many kings who were equal in authority like Yaksha, were killed by adopting suitable measures and in this way, cruel warriors were killed and the land of the East was also snatched.509.
The demons of evil intellect were killed and turned towards the North in great anger and after killing many dangerous kings, bestowed their kingdom on others.510.

602.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਕਲਕੀ ਵਤਾਰ ਪੂਰਬ ਜੀਤ ਬਿਜਯ ਨਾਮ ਤੀਜਾ ਧਿਆਯ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੩॥
602.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the kalakee vataar poorab jeet bijay naam teejaa dhiaay samaapata(n) ||3||
602.e: End of the chapter third entitled “Victory over the East” in Kalki incarmnation in Bachittar Natak.3.
(Now begins the description of the twenty-fourth of the cities of the east and Killing the fighters of indestructible Glory the trumpets of Kalki incarnation sounded proudly.511.
The warriors were again absorbed in war and showered arrows while thundering
The cowards ran away in fear and their wounds burst.512.
The war-drums sounded, the ghosts danced in a charming manner, the Baitals shouted the goddess Kali laughed and the fire-showering tabor was played.513.
The cowards ran away from the battlefield

603.e: The ghosts, fiends and Baitals danced, the Shiva, engaged in Sport, began to string the rosaries of skulls and the warriors looking at the heavenly damsels covetously, wedded them.514.
The warriors, inflicting wounds are falling upon the opponents and the ghosts are dancing and singing with zeal
Shiva is dancing while playing on his tabor.515.
The famous Gandharvas, the minstrels and adepts are composing poems in appreciation of war
The gods playing their lyres, are pleasing the mind of sages.516.
There is sound of innumerable elephants and horses and the drums of war are being played
The sound is spreading in all the directions and the Sheshnaga is wavering on felling the loss of Dharma.517.
The bloody swords have been drawn in the battlefield and the arrows are being discharged fearlessly
The warriors are fighting and their secret parts are touching each other, the heavenly damsels are roaming in the sky enthusiastically.518.
There are showers of lances and arrows and seeing the warriors, the heavenly damsels are getting pleased
The drums and dreadful tabors are being and the ghosts and Bhairavas are dancing.519.
The knocking sound of the sheaths and the clattering of swords is being heard
The terrible demons are being crushed and the ganas and others are laughing loudly.520.
UTBHUJ STANZA
The Kalki incarnation like Shiva, giver of happiness to all, mounting on his Bull, remained stable in the battlefield like the dreadful fires.521.
He, assuming his great benign form, was destroying the afflicting agonies
He was redeeming those who had taken shelter and was removing th effect of sin of the sinners.522.
He was unfolding brilliance like the fire or the roasary of fire
His dreadful form was radiating brightness like fire.523.
The Lord of all the three worlds took his dagger in his hand and in his pleasure, he destroyed the demons.524.
ANJAN STANZA
Conquering the invincible people and causing the warriors to run away like cowards and
taking all his allies with him, he reached the kingdom of China.525.

604.e: The angry and furious tone of the Kalki incarnation, who assumed royalty, is very queer
Before him, the beauty of the women of Kamroop with bewitching eyes and the charm of Kamboj country is devoid of radiance.526.
His drums, are his shields, his blows are severe,
his musical instruments create loud sounds and his arrows raise anger and ire.527.
PAADHARI STANZA
He conquered the unconquerable, established the unestablished
He broke the unbreakable and devided the indivisible, He broke the unbreakable and he destroyed those who resisted.528.
The heavenly damsels, seeing both the brave and coward warriors were getting pleased
They were all sprinkling roses, camphor nad saffron on the head of kalki incarnation.529.
In this way, after conquering the three directions the trumpet sounded in the North
He went towards China and Manchuria, where there were people in the garb of Rawalpanthis.530.
The war-musical instruments were played and the warriors thundered
Seeing the Lords, the heavenly damsels were filled with zeal, the gods and others, all were pleased and all of them, abandoning their pride began to sing songs.531.

604.g: ਸਜਿਓ ਸੁ ਸੈਣ ਸੁਣਿ ਚੀਨ ਰਾਜ ॥
604.t: sajio su sain sun cheen raaj ||

604.e: Listening to the news about the arrival of the army, the king of China caused the war-horns to be sounded in all his territory
All the warriors marched for the war and in their fury, they began to discharge arrows.532.
The bloody daggers came out and the great warriors died in the war
The wounds were inflicted and the atmosphere became foggy with the dust of the feet of the warriors, the shouts of vultures were heard in all the four directions.533.
The dreadful Kali laughed and the huge Bhairavas and the ghosts shouted, the arrows were inflicted
The ghosts and fiends ate the flesh the cowards in their anxiety began to run away.534.
RASAAVAL STANZA
The king of China attacked, he was ready in every way
The bloody daggers came out of scabbards with double zeal.535.
The warriors, getting enraged, discharged arrows and
Roamed in the battlefield, destroying the limbs of others.536.
Shiva also joined the armies and danced and discharged arrows in a queer way.537.

605.e: The warriors in their fury discharged arrows in the battlefield
The streams of blood were full and the heavenly damsels moved in the sky.538.
The goddess kali laughed and produced fire of Yoga
The tyrants were killed with the arrows of the soldiers.539.
The warriors are swinging and falling on the ground and the dust is rising from the earth
The fighters have gathered zealously in the battlefield and the ghosts and fiends are dancing.540.
The king of China met his men, whose objectives were fulfilled
He took many with himself and advanced forward.541.

605.g: ਲਏ ਸੰਗ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਸਰਬ ਬਜੇ ਬਿਜਈ ਦੁੰਦਭਿ ਰਣ ॥
605.t: le sa(n)g nirap sarab baje bijiee dhu(n)dhabh ran ||
605.e: The king took all alongwith him and the drums of victory sounded

605.g: ਸੁਭੇ ਸੂਰ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਰੀਝਈ ਅਪਛਰ ਗਣ ॥
605.t: subhe soor sa(n)graam nirakh reejhiee apachhar gan ||
605.e: The warriors gathered in the battlefield and seeing them, the heavenly damsels were allured

605.g: ਛਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਆਦੇਵ ਜਕੇ ਗੰਧਰਬ ਜਛ ਬਰ ॥
605.t: chhake dhev aadhev jake ga(n)dharab jachh bar ||
605.e: The gods, demons and Gandharvas all were filled with wonder and pleased

605.g: ਚਕੇ ਭੂਤ ਅਰੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਦਿਆਧਰ ਨਰ ਬਰ ॥
605.t: chake bhoot ar pret sarab bidhiaadhar nar bar ||
605.e: All ghosts, fiends and superb Vidyadharis wondered

605.g: ਖੰਕੜੀਯ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰੂਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਾ ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰੀਯ ॥
605.t: kha(n)kaReey kaal kraooraa prabhaa bahu prakaar usatat kareey ||
605.e: Kalki (Lord) thundered as a manifestation of KAL (death) and he was eulogized in various ways

606.g: ਖੰਡਨ ਅਖੰਡ ਚੰਡੀ ਮਹਾ ਜਯ ਜ੍ਰਯ ਜ੍ਰਯ ਸਬਦੋਚਰੀਯ ॥੫੪੨॥
606.t: kha(n)ddan akha(n)dd cha(n)ddee mahaa jay jray jray sabadhochareey ||542||
606.e: The destroyer of invincible warriors like Chandika, the Lord Kalki was being hailed.542.

606.g: ਭਿੜਿਯ ਭੇੜ ਲੜਖੜਿਯ ਮੇਰੁ ਝੜਪੜਿਯ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਬਣ ॥
606.t: bhiRiy bheR laRakhaRiy mer jhaRapaRiy patr ban ||
606.e: The armies fought with each other, the Sumeru mountain trembled, and the leaves of the forest quivered and fell

606.g: ਡੁਲਿਯ ਇੰਦੁ ਤੜਫੜ ਫਨਿੰਦ ਸੰਕੁੜਿਯ ਦ੍ਰਵਣ ਗਣ ॥
606.t: dduliy i(n)dh taRafaR fani(n)dh sa(n)kuRiy dhravan gan ||
606.e: Indra and Sheshnaga writhed on becoming agitated

606.g: ਚਕਿਯੋ ਗਇੰਦ ਧਧਕਯ ਚੰਦ ਭੰਭਜਿਗ ਦਿਵਾਕਰ ॥
606.t: chakiyo gi(n)dh dhadhakay cha(n)dh bha(n)bhajig dhivaakar ||
606.e: Ganas and others shrunk with fear, the elephants of he directions wondered

606.g: ਡੁਲਗ ਸੁਮੇਰੁ ਡਗਗ ਕੁਮੇਰ ਸਭ ਸੁਕਗ ਸਾਇਰ ॥
606.t: ddulag sumer ddagag kumer sabh sukag sair ||
606.e: The moon was frightened and the sun ran hither and thither, the Sumeru mountain wavered, the Tortoise became unsteady and all the oceans dried up in fear

606.g: ਤਤਜਗ ਧ੍ਯਾਨ ਤਬ ਧੂਰਜਟੀ ਸਹਿ ਨ ਭਾਰ ਸਕਗ ਥਿਰਾ ॥
606.t: tatajag dhayaan tab dhoorajaTee seh na bhaar sakag thiraa ||
606.e: The meditation of Shiva was shattered and the burden on the earth could not remain in equilibrium

606.g: ਉਛਲਗ ਨੀਰ ਪਛੁਲਗ ਪਵਨ ਸੁ ਡਗ ਡਗ ਡਗ ਕੰਪਗੁ ਧਰਾ ॥੫੪੩॥
606.t: auchhalag neer pachhulag pavan su ddag ddag ddag ka(n)pag dharaa ||543||
606.e: The water sprang up, the wind flowed and the earth staggered and trembled.543.

606.g: ਚਲਗੁ ਬਾਣੁ ਰੁਕਿਗ ਦਿਸਾਣ ਪਬ੍ਰਯ ਪਿਸਾਨ ਹੂਅ ॥
606.t: chalag baan rukig dhisaan pabray pisaan hooa ||
606.e: With the discharge of arrows, the directions were covered and the mountains were pulverized

606.g: ਡਿਗਗੁ ਬਿੰਧ ਉਛਲਗੁ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕੰਪਗੁ ਸੁਨਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਧੂਅ ॥
606.t: ddigag bi(n)dh uchhalag si(n)dh ka(n)pag sun mun dhooa ||
606.e: Of war, the sage Dhruva trembled

606.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੇਦ ਤਜ ਭਜਗੁ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਿ ਤਜਗੁ ॥
606.t: braham bedh taj bhajag i(n)dhr i(n)dhraasan tajag ||
606.e: Brahma abandoned the Vedas and ran away, the elephants fled and Indra also left his seat

606.g: ਜਦਿਨ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਕਲਕੀਵਤਾਰ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਤ ਰਣਿ ਗਜਗੁ ॥
606.t: jadhin kraoor kalakeevataar krudhat ran gajag ||
606.e: The day on which the Kalki incarnation, thundered in rage in the battlefield

606.g: ਉਛਰੰਤ ਧੂਰਿ ਬਾਜਨ ਖੁਰੀਯ ਸਬ ਅਕਾਸ ਮਗੁ ਛਾਇ ਲੀਅ ॥
606.t: auchhara(n)t dhoor baajan khureey sab akaas mag chhai leea ||
606.e: On that day, the dust of the hoofs of the horses, springing up, covered the whole of the sky

606.g: ਜਣੁ ਰਚੀਯ ਲੋਕ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਹਰਿ ਅਸਟਕਾਸ ਖਟੁ ਧਰਣਿ ਕੀਅ ॥੫੪੪॥
606.t: jan racheey lok kar kop har asaTakaas khaT dharan keea ||544||
606.e: It seemed that in his rage the Lord had created the additional eight skies and six earths.544.

606.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਾਰੁ ਚਕ੍ਰਵੇ ਚਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਿਰ ਸਹੰਸ ਸੇਸ ਫਣ ॥
606.t: chakirat chaar chakrave chakirat sir saha(n)s ses fan ||
606.e: On all the four sides, all including Sheshnaga are wondering

606.g: ਧਕਤ ਮਛ ਮਾਵਾਸ ਛੋਡਿ ਰਣ ਭਜਗ ਦ੍ਰਵਣ ਗਣ ॥
606.t: dhakat machh maavaas chhodd ran bhajag dhravan gan ||
606.e: The heats of the fish also throbbed, the ganas and others ran away from the war-arena

606.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਕਾਕ ਕੁੰਡਲੀਅ ਗਿਧ ਉਧਹੂੰ ਲੇ ਉਡੀਯ ॥
606.t: bhramat kaak ku(n)ddaleea gidh udhahoo(n) le uddeey ||

606.g: ਬਮਤ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਖੰਕਾਲਿ ਲੁਥ ਹਥੋਂ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੀਯ ॥
606.t: bamat javaiaal kha(n)kaal luth hatho(n) nahee chhuTeey ||
606.e: The crows and vultures violently hovered over the corpses and Shiva, the manifestation of KAL (death), is shouting in the battlefield, without dropping the dead from his hands

606.g: ਟੁਟੰਤ ਟੋਪ ਫੁਟੰਤ ਜਿਰਹ ਦਸਤਰਾਗ ਪਖਰ ਤੁਰੀਯ ॥
606.t: TuTa(n)t Top fuTa(n)t jireh dhasataraag pakhar tureey ||

606.g: ਭਜੰਤ ਭੀਰ ਰਿਝੰਤ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸੂਰ ਹੂਰੈਂ ਫਿਰੀਯ ॥੫੪੫॥
606.t: bhaja(n)t bheer rijha(n)t man nirakh soor hoorai(n) fireey ||545||
606.e: The helmets are breaking, the armours are being torn and the armoured horses are also getting frightened the cowards are running away and the warriors seeing the heavenly damsels are getting allured by them.545.

606.g: ਮਾਧੋ ਛੰਦ ॥
606.t: maadho chha(n)dh ||
606.e: MADHO STANZA

606.g: ਜਬ ਕੋਪਾ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
606.t: jab kopaa kalakee avataaraa ||

606.g: ਬਾਜਤ ਤੂਰ ਹੋਤ ਝਨਕਾਰਾ ॥
606.t: baajat toor hot jhanakaaraa ||
606.e: When Lord Kalki became infuriated, then the war-horns sounded, and there was jingling sound

606.g: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਮਾਧੋ ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਸੰਭਾਰੇ ॥
606.t: haa haa maadho baan kamaan kirapaan sa(n)bhaare ||

606.g: ਪੈਠੇ ਸੁਭਟ ਹਥ੍ਯਾਰ ਉਘਾਰੇ ॥੫੪੬॥
606.t: paiThe subhaT hathayaar ughaare ||546||
606.e: The Lord held up his bow and arrow and the sword and taking out his weapons, he penetrated amongst the warriors.546.

606.g: ਲੀਨ ਮਚੀਨ ਦੇਸ ਕਾ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
606.t: leen macheen dhes kaa raajaa ||

606.g: ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਬਜੇ ਜੁਝਾਊ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
606.t: taa dhin baje jujhaauoo baajaa ||
606.e: When the king of Manchuria was conquered, on that day, the war-drums sounded

606.g: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਮਾਧੋ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛਿਨਾਏ ॥
606.t: haa haa maadho dhes dhes ke chhatr chhinaae ||

606.g: ਦੇਸ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਫਿਰਾਏ ॥੫੪੭॥
606.t: dhes bidhes tura(n)g firaae ||547||
606.e: The Lord, causing loud lamentation, snatched away the canopies of various countries and got his horse moved in all the countries.547.

606.g: ਚੀਨ ਮਚੀਨ ਛੀਨ ਜਬ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
606.t: cheen macheen chheen jab leenaa ||

606.g: ਉਤਰ ਦੇਸ ਪਯਾਨਾ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
606.t: autar dhes payaanaa keenaa ||
606.e: When China and Manchuria were conquered, then Lord kalki advanced further in the North

606.g: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਮਾਧੋ ਕਹ ਲੌ ਗਨੋ ਉਤਰੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
606.t: haa haa maadho keh lau gano utaree raajaa ||

606.g: ਸਭ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਕ ਜੀਤ ਕਾ ਬਾਜਾ ॥੫੪੮॥
606.t: sabh sir dda(n)k jeet kaa baajaa ||548||
606.e: O my Lord! to what extent I should enumerate the kings of the North, the drum of victory sounded on the heads of all.548.

606.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
606.t: eeh bidh jeet jeet kai raajaa ||

606.g: ਸਭ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਾਦ ਬਿਜੈ ਕਾ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
606.t: sabh sir naadh bijai kaa baajaa ||
606.e: In this way, conquering various kings, the musical instruments of victory was played

606.g: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਮਾਧੋ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਛਾਡਿ ਦੇਸ ਭਜਿ ਚਲੇ ॥
606.t: haa haa maadho jeh teh chhaadd dhes bhaj chale ||

606.g: ਜਿਤ ਤਿਤ ਦੀਹ ਦਨੁਜ ਦਲ ਮਲੇ ॥੫੪੯॥
606.t: jit tit dheeh dhanuj dhal male ||549||
606.e: O my Lord! they all left their countries and went here and there and the Lord Kalki destroyed the tyrants everywhere.549.

606.g: ਕੀਨੇ ਜਗ ਅਨੇਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਾ ॥
606.t: keene jag anek prakaaraa ||

606.g: ਦੇਸਿ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਤਿ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਾਰਾ ॥
606.t: dhes dhes ke jeet nirapaaraa ||
606.e: Many types of yajnas were performed, the kings of many counties were conquered

606.g: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਮਾਧੋ ਦੇਸ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਭੇਟ ਲੈ ਆਏ ॥
606.t: haa haa maadho dhes bidhes bheT lai aae ||

606.g: ਸੰਤ ਉਬਾਰਿ ਅਸੰਤ ਖਪਾਏ ॥੫੫੦॥
606.t: sa(n)t ubaar asa(n)t khapaae ||550||
606.e: O Lord! the kings came from various countries came with their offerings and you redeemed the saints and destroyed the evil ones.550.

606.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਚਲੀ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
606.t: jeh teh chalee dharam kee baataa ||

606.g: ਪਾਪਹਿ ਜਾਤ ਭਈ ਸੁਧਿ ਸਾਤਾ ॥
606.t: paapeh jaat bhiee sudh saataa ||
606.e: Religious discussions were held everywhere and the sinful acts were totally finished

606.g: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਮਾਧੋ ਕਲਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਜੀਤ ਘਰ ਆਏ ॥
606.t: haa haa maadho kal avataar jeet ghar aae ||

606.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਹੋਵਨ ਲਾਗ ਬਧਾਏ ॥੫੫੧॥
606.t: jeh teh hovan laag badhaae ||551||
606.e: O Lord! The Kalki incarnation came home after his conquests and the songs of felicitation were sung everywhere.551.

606.g: ਤਬ ਲੋ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਾਤ ਨੀਯਰਾਯੋ ॥
606.t: tab lo kalijugaat neeyaraayo ||

606.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਭੇਦ ਸਬਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
606.t: jeh teh bhedh saban sun paayo ||
606.e: Then the end of the Iron Age came very near and all came to know about this mystery

606.g: ਹਾ ਹਾ ਮਾਧੋ ਕਲਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਤਬੈ ਪਹਚਾਨੀ ॥
606.t: haa haa maadho kalakee baat tabai pahachaanee ||

606.g: ਸਤਿਜੁਗ ਕੀ ਆਗਮਤਾ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੫੫੨॥
606.t: satijug kee aagamataa jaanee ||552||
606.e: The Kalki incarnation comprehended this mystery and felt that Satyuga was about to begin.552.

607.e: ANHAD STANZA
Everyone heard that Satyuga (Age of Truth) had come
The sages were pleased and ganas etc. sang songs of praise.553.
This mysterious fact was comprehended by all
The sages believed but did not feel it.554.
The whole world saw that mysterious Lord, whose elegance was of a special type.555.
He, the fascinator of the mind of the sages, looks splendid like a flower and who else had been created equivalent in beauty like him?556.
TILOKI STANZA
After the end of Kalyuga (the Iron Age), Satyuga (the Age of Truth) came and the saints enjoyed bliss everywhere
They sang and played their musical instruments, Shiva and Parvati also laughed and danced.557.
The tabors and other musical instruments were played like the gongs and the weapons-wielding warriors got pleased
The songs were sung and everywhere there was talk about the wars fought by Kaki incarnation.558.
MOHAN STANZA

607.g: ਅਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕੈ ਰਿਪੁ ਟਾਰ ਕੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਸੰਗ ਕੈ ਲੀਓ ॥
607.t: ar maar kai rip Taar kai nirap ma(n)ddalee sa(n)g kai leeo ||

607.g: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਜਿਤੇ ਤਿਤੇ ਅਤਿ ਦਾਨ ਮਾਨ ਸਬੈ ਦੀਓ ॥
607.t: jatr tatr jite tite at dhaan maan sabai dheeo ||
607.e: After killing the enemies and taking the group of kings alongwith him, the Kalki incarnation bestowed charities here there and everywhere

607.g: ਸੁਰ ਰਾਜ ਜ੍ਯੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਰਾਜ ਹੁਐ ਗਿਰ ਰਾਜ ਸੇ ਭਟ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
607.t: sur raaj jayo nirap raaj huaai gir raaj se bhaT maar kai ||

607.g: ਸੁਖ ਪਾਇ ਹਰਖ ਬਢਾਇਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਆਇਯੋ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਗ ਲੈ ॥੫੫੯॥
607.t: sukh pai harakh baddaikai greh aaiyo jas sa(n)g lai ||559||
607.e: After killing the powerful enemies like indra the Lord getting pleased and also getting approbation, came back to his home.559.

607.g: ਅਰਿ ਜੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਅਭੀਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਜਗਿ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਘਨੇ ਕਰੇ ॥
607.t: ar jeet jeet abheet havai jag hom jag ghane kare ||

607.g: ਦੇਸਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਅਸੇਸ ਭਿਛਕ ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਬੈ ਹਰੇ ॥
607.t: dhes dhes ases bhichhak rog sog sabai hare ||
607.e: After conquering the enemies, he fearlessly performed many hom-yajnas and removed the sufferings and ailments of all the beggars in various countires

607.g: ਕੁਰ ਰਾਜ ਜਿਉ ਦਿਜ ਰਾਜ ਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਦਾਰਿਦ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ॥
607.t: kur raaj jiau dhij raaj ke bahu bhaat dhaaridh maar kai ||

607.g: ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਿ ਸੰਭਰ ਕੋ ਚਲਯੋ ਜਗਿ ਜਿਤ ਕਿਤ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਕੈ ॥੫੬੦॥
607.t: jag jeet sa(n)bhar ko chalayo jag jit kit bithaar kai ||560||
607.e: After removing the poverty of Brahmins, like the kings of Kuru clan, the Lord on conquering the worlds and spreading his glory of victory, marched towards

607.g: ਜਗ ਜੀਤਿ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਥਾਰ ਕੇ ਜਗ ਸੁ ਅਰਥ ਅਰਥ ਚਿਤਾਰੀਅੰ ॥
607.t: jag jeet bedh bithaar ke jag su arath arath chitaareea(n) ||

607.g: ਦੇਸਿ ਦੇਸਿ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਮੈ ਨਵ ਭੇਜਿ ਭੇਜਿ ਹਕਾਰੀਅੰ ॥
607.t: dhes dhes bidhes mai nav bhej bhej hakaareea(n) ||
607.e: Conquering the world, spreding the praise of the Vedas and thinking about the good works, the lord subdued fighting all the kings of various countries

607.g: ਧਰ ਦਾੜ ਜਿਉ ਰਣ ਗਾੜ ਹੁਇ ਤਿਰਲੋਕ ਜੀਤ ਸਬੈ ਲੀਏ ॥
607.t: dhar dhaaR jiau ran gaaR hui tiralok jeet sabai le'ee ||

607.g: ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ਦੈ ਸਨਮਾਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਭੇਜ ਭੇਜ ਤਹਾ ਦੀਏ ॥੫੬੧॥
607.t: bahu dhaan dhai sanamaan sevak bhej bhej tahaa dhe'ee ||561||
607.e: On becoming the axe of Yama, the Lord conquered all the three worlds and sent his servants with honour everywhere, bestowing great gifts on them.561.

607.g: ਖਲ ਖੰਡਿ ਖੰਡਿ ਬਿਹੰਡ ਕੈ ਅਰਿ ਦੰਡ ਦੰਡ ਬਡੋ ਦੀਯੋ ॥
607.t: khal kha(n)dd kha(n)dd biha(n)dd kai ar dha(n)dd dha(n)dd baddo dheeyo ||

607.g: ਅਰਬ ਖਰਬ ਅਦਰਬ ਦਰਬ ਸੁ ਜੀਤ ਕੈ ਆਪਨੋ ਕੀਯੋ ॥
607.t: arab kharab adharab dharab su jeet kai aapano keeyo ||
607.e: On destroying and punishing the tyrants, the Lord conquered the materials of the value of billions

607.g: ਰਣਜੀਤ ਜੀਤ ਅਜੀਤ ਜੋਧਨ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਅਤ੍ਰ ਛਿਨਾਈਅੰ ॥
607.t: ranajeet jeet ajeet jodhan chhatr atr chhinaieea(n) ||

607.g: ਸਰਦਾਰ ਬਿੰਸਤਿ ਚਾਰ ਕਲਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਈਅੰ ॥੫੬੨॥
607.t: saradhaar bi(n)sat chaar kal avataar chhatr firaieea(n) ||562||
607.e: Subduing the warriors, he conquered their weapons and crown and the canopy of Kali-incarnation revolved on all the four sides.562.
MATHAAN STANZA
His light shone like the sun
The whole world unhesitatingly adored him.563.

608.e: Before his great beauty, all the kings felt shy
All of them accepted defeat and made offerings to him.564.
The warriors equivalent to his glory also felt shy
His words are very sweet and his eyes are full of enjoyment and pleasure.565.
His body is so beautiful as if it was especially fashioned
The women of gods and saints are getting pleased. 566.
He who saw him even slightly, his eyes kept on looking at him
The women of gods, getting allured are looking with love towards him.567.
Seeing the beauty-incarnate Lord, the god of love is feeling shy
The enemes are so much fearful in their mind as if they have been ripped by the weapons.568.
The warriors are looking at his glory covetously
His eyes are black and touched with antimony, which seem to have awakened continuously for several nights.569.

609.e: Filled with beauty and love they look magnificent like a comedian king.570.
The black arrows are fitted in the bow and they hit the enemies.571.
He leads the life of a producer, a king, an authority, bestower of fortune and love.572.
He is a Soverign, an arms-wielding warrior, elehance-incarnate an the creator of the whole world.573.
He is lustful like the god of love, blooming like a flower an dyed in love like a beautiful song.574.
He is cobra for a female serpent, deer for the does, a canopied Sovereign for the kings and a devotee before the goddess Kali.575.

609.g: ਇਮ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰਿ ਜੀਤੇ ਜੁਧ ਸਬੈ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ॥
609.t: eim kalakee avataar jeete judh sabai nirapat ||

609.g: ਕੀਨੋ ਰਾਜ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ਬੀਸ ਸਹਸ ਦਸ ਲਛ ਬਰਖ ॥੫੭੬॥
609.t: keeno raaj sudhaar bees sahas dhas lachh barakh ||576||
609.e: In this way Kalki incarnation conquered all the kings and ruled for ten lakh and twenty thousand years .576.
He caught his sword in his hand and knocked down everyone in the war and there was no delay in the change of destiny.577.
He gave his mantra to everyone, he abandoned all the Tantras and sitting in solitude, he produced his Yantras.578.
Many people got allured by his various beautiful forms
In the language of the Vedas, his Glory was infinite.579.
Seeing his many garbs, charms and glories, the sings fled away.580.
Those who were special powerful people composed of various forms,

610.e: The Lord killed these innumerable enemies and obtained approbation in the world.581.
The Lord is most powerful with indestructible arms and his pure light looks splendid
He is removing the sins by performing the hom-yajna.582.
TOMAR STANZA
When he conquered the whole world, his pride was extremely increased
He also forgot the unmanifested Brahmin and said this583
“There is no second except me and the same is accepted at all the place
I have conquered the whole world and made it my slave and have caused everyone to repeat my name.584.
I have given life again to the traditional and have swung the canopy over my head
All the people consider me as their own and none other comes to their sight.585.
No one the repeats the name of the Lord-God or the name of any other God goddess
” Seeing this the Unamanifested Brahma created another purusha.586.
Mehdi Mir was created, who was very angry and persistent one
He killed the Kalki incarnation within himself again.587.
Those who conquered, the made it there possession they are all under the control of KAL (death) in the end
In this way, with complete improvement the description of twenty-fourth incarnation is completed.588.

610.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਚਤੁਰ ਬਿਸਤਿ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਬਰਨਨੰ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
610.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the chatur bisat kalakee avataar baranana(n) samaapata(n) ||
610.e: End of the description of twenty-fourth incarnation in Bachittar natak.
(Now being the description of the killing of Mehdi Mir)
TOMAR STANZA
In the way, destroying him, the age of the truth was manifested
The whole of Iron Age had passed away and the light manifested itself everywhere consistently .1
Then Mir Mehdi, conquering the whole world, was filled with pride
He also got the canopy swung over his head and caused the whole world to bow at his feet.2.
Expect himself, he did not have faith in anyone
He who did not comprehend One Lord-God, he ultimately could not save himself from KAL(death).3.
There is not one other in all colours and forms except one God

611.e: He, who has not recognized that one Lord, he wasted his birth.4.
Expect that one Lord, there is none other in water, on plain and all the places
He who had not recognized the One Reality, he only roamed away amongst the Yogis.5.
He who leaving the one, believed in another one, in my view, he is devoid of wisdom
He will be surrounded by suffering, hunger, thirst and anxiety throughout day and night.6.
He will never get peace and will always be surrounded by ailments
He will always suffer death on account of suffering and hunger, he will always remain restless.7.
The leprosy will prevail in his body and all his body will rot
His body will not remain health and his foundness for sons and grandson will always afflict him.8.
His family will be destroyed and at the and, his body will not be redeemed also
He will always be engrossed in disease and sorrow, ultimately, he will die the death of a dog .9.
Reflecting over the egoistic state of Mir Mehdi the Unmanifested Brahman thought of killing him
He created an insect, which entered the ear of Mir Mehdi.10.
Entering his ear, that insect conquered that base fellow, and
Giving him various types of suffering, killed him in this way.11.

611.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਮਹਿਦੀ ਮੀਰ ਬਧ ॥
611.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the mahidhee meer badh ||
611.e: End of the description of twenty-fourth incarnation in Bachittar natak.
Brahma Avatar
Grace of the true Guru
Now being the description of Brahma Incarnation
TOMAR STANZA
The age the truth was established again and all the new creation appeared
The kings of all the countries because religious.1.
O the Lord of breadful fury! there is none else except thee,
Who created the Iron Age and its fires burning the word, everyone should repeat His Name.2.
Those who will remember the Name of the Lord in the Iron Age, all their tasks will be fulfilled
They will never experience suffering, hunger and anxiety and will always remain happy.3.
There is none else except the One Lord pervanding all the colours and forms
He helps those who repeat His Name.4.
Those who remember His Name, never run away
They do not fear the enemies and wearing their arms and weapons, they conquer all the direction.5.
Their houses are filled with wealth and all their tasks are fulfilled
Those who remember the Name of one Lord, they are not entrapped in the noose of death.6.
That One Lord is pervading all the created beings and the whole world should know that there is none else except Him.7.
The One Lord is the creator as well as the Destroyer of the whole world and there is one other in all the colours and forms.8.
Many indras are in His service, many Brahmas recite the Vedas, many Shivas sit at His Gate and many Sheshnagas remain present in order to become His bed.9.

612.e: Many kings like Surya, Chandra and Indra and many Indras, upendras, great sages, the Fish incarnation, the Tortoise incarnation and sheshnagas remain ever present before Him.10.
Many Krishna and Rama incarnation sweep His Door many Fish and Tortoise incarnations are seen standing at His special gate.11.
There are many Shukras, Brahaspatis, Datts, Gorakhs, Rama Krishnas, Rasult ect, but none is acceptable at His gate wightout the remembrance of His Name.12.
No other work is appropriate except the support of the one Name
Those who will believe in the one Guru-Lord, they will only comprehend His myself.13.
We should not know anyone else except Him and none other should be kept in mind
Only one Lord should be worshipped, so that we may be redeemed at the end.14.
O being! You may consider that without Him you cannot be redeemed
If you adore anyone else, then you will get away from that Lord.15.
Only that Lord should be adored consistently, who is beyond attachment, colours and form
None other except the One Lord should be kept in view .16.
He who creates this and the next word and merges them within himself, if you want the salvation of your body, then worship only that One Lord.17.
He who has created the nine regions, all the worlds and the universe, why do you not meditate on him and how do you fall in the well deliberately? 18.
O foolish being! you should adore Him who was established all the fourteen worlds
With His meditation all the wishes are fulfilled.19.
All the twenty-four incarnations have been enumerated in detail and now I am going to enumerate the smaller incarnations how the Lord assumed the other forms.20.
Those forms which Brahma assumed, I have narrated them in poetry and not after reflection, I narrated the incarnation of Rudra (Shiva).21.

613.e: When the Lord commended, then Brahma preprared the Vedas
At that time his pride was increased and he did not consider anyone else like himself.22.
He thought that there was none other like him and there was no other poet like him
On the Lord-God because unhappay and threw him on the ground like the Vajra of Indra.23.
When Brahma, the ocean of four Vedas fell upon the earth,
He began to worship with the fullness of his heart the mysterious Lord, who is beyond the ken of gods.24.
He worshipped the Lord for ten Lakh years and he to the Lord of gods to redeem him in any in any way.25.
SPEECH OF THE GOD
(Vishnu said) “When you will adore Lord-God with the fullness of your heart, then the Lord who is the support of the helpless, will fulfill you wish.”26.
Hearing this Brahma began to worship and make offerings exactly in the same way, as Vishnu had suggested.27.
Vishnu also said this, that the powerful Chandika, the destroyer of the tyrants should also be adored, who had killed the demons like Jawalaksha and Dhumar Lochan.28
“When you will worship all of them, then the curse on you will terminte
Worship the unmanifested Brahman and abandoning your persistence, you may go under his shelter.29.
“Blessed are they, on the earth, who go under His refuge
They do not fear anyone and all their tasks are fulfilled.30.
For ten Lack years Brahma stood on one leg and when he served the Lord with the singleness of his heart, then the Guru-Lord was pleased.31.
When with the goddess explained the myself, then Brahma served with fullness of his mind, and the unmanifested Bharma was pleased with him.32.
Then there was such-like voice from heaven,”I am the masher of pride and I have subjugated all.33.
“You had been puffed up with pride, therefore I did not like you
Now I sea this and tell you as to how you will be redeemed.34.
“You may now assume seven incarnation on the earth for your redemption
” Brahma accepted all this and assumed new births in the world.35.
“Never forget from your mind my slander and praise
O Brahma! Also listen to one thing more36
“A god named Vishnu has also meditated on me and greatly pleased me
He has also asked for a boon from me, which I have bestowed on him.37.
“There is no difference between me and him, all the people know this
The people consider him the creator of this and the next world and their destroyer.38.

614.g: ਸੁਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥੩੯॥
614.t: sun leh braham kumaar ||39||
614.e: “Whenever we will assume the incarnations and whatever he will do. O Brahma! You may describe team.”39.

614.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
614.t: naraaj chha(n)dh ||
614.e: NARAAJ STANZA

614.g: ਸੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਮਾਨੁਖੀ ਬਪੁੰ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
614.t: s dhaar maanukhee bapu(n) sa(n)bhaar raam jaag hai ||
614.e: “You may assume the human form and take up the story of Ram

614.g: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰਣੰ ਜੁਝਾਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਭਾਗਿ ਹੈ ॥
614.t: bisaar sasatr asatrana(n) jujhaar satr bhaag hai ||
614.e: The enemies will run away, abandoning their arms and weapons, before the glory of Ram

614.g: ਬਿਚਾਰ ਜੌਨ ਜੌਨ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਭਾਖੀਯੋ ॥
614.t: bichaar jauan jauan bhayo sudhaar sarab bhaakheeyo ||

614.g: ਹਜਾਰ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਕਿਯੋ ਕਰੋ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਸਬਦ ਰਾਖੀਯੋ ॥੪੦॥
614.t: hajaar kouoo na kiyo karo bichaar sabadh raakheeyo ||40||
614.e: Whatever he will do, reform and describe them and inspire of the though of difficulties present the same in poetry arranging the thoughtful worlds.”40.

614.g: ਚਿਤਾਰਿ ਬੈਣ ਵਾਕਿਸੰ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਬਾਲਮੀਕ ਭਯੋ ॥
614.t: chitaar bain vaakisa(n) bichaar baalameek bhayo ||

614.g: ਜੁਝਾਰ ਰਾਮਚੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਉਚਰ੍ਯੋ ॥
614.t: jujhaar raamacha(n)dhr ko bichaar chaar ucharayo ||
614.e: Obeying the saying of the Lord, Brahma assumed the form of Valmiki and manifested himself and he composed in poetry the actions performed by Ramchandra, the most powerful one

614.g: ਸੁ ਸਪਤ ਕਾਡਣੋ ਕਥ੍ਯੋ ਅਸਕਤ ਲੋਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਰਹ੍ਯੋ ॥
614.t: s sapat kaaddano kathayo asakat lok hui rahayo ||

614.g: ਉਤਾਰ ਚਤ੍ਰਆਨਨੋ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ਐਸ ਕੈ ਕਹ੍ਯੋ ॥੪੧॥
614.t: autaar chatraanano sudhaar aais kai kahayo ||41||
614.e: He composed in a reformed way the Ramayana, of seven chapters for helpless people.41.

614.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥
614.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the brahamaa prat aagiaa samaapata(n) ||
614.e: End of the description containing command for Brahma.

614.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
614.t: naraaj chha(n)dh ||
614.e: NARAAJ STANZA

614.g: ਸੁ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕੋ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਦੂਜ ਭਾਖਿ ਹੈ ॥
614.t: s dhaar avataar ko bichaar dhooj bhaakh hai ||

614.g: ਬਿਸੇਖ ਚਤ੍ਰਾਨ ਕੇ ਅਸੇਖ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਚਾਖਿ ਹੈ ॥
614.t: bisekh chatraan ke asekh savaiaadh chaakh hai ||
614.e: After assuming the incarnation, Brahma, with the fullness of his heart and in a special way, presented his thoughts

614.g: ਅਕਰਖ ਦੇਵਿ ਕਾਲਿਕਾ ਅਨਿਰਖ ਸਬਦ ਉਚਰੋ ॥
614.t: akarakh dhev kaalikaa anirakh sabadh ucharo ||

614.g: ਸੁ ਬੀਨ ਬੀਨ ਕੈ ਬਡੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਬੀਨ ਅਛ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਧਰੋ ॥੧॥
614.t: s been been kai badde praabeen achhr ko dharo ||1||
614.e: He remembered the Lord and composed the songs and prepared the epic skillfully arranging the selected words.1.

614.g: ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਆਦਿ ਈਸ੍ਵਰੀ ਅਪਾਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਰਾਖੀਐ ॥

614.e: For the divine thoughts, he created the word `Brahm` and by remembering the Lord and with His grace, he narrated whatever he wanted

614.e: He unhesitatingly, composed in this way the, fine epic Ramayana, which none else will be able to do.2.

614.t: bichaar aapanee kirata(n) bisekh chit kheejh hai ||3||
614.e: The erudite scholars of language and and literature read it with pleasure, and while comparing with their own works, they get angry in their minds.3.

614.t: bachitr kaabray kee kathaa pavitr aaj bhaakheeaai ||

614.e: The story of his immaculate poem which is really wonderful accomplished and powerful, this story is

614.t: pavitr niramalee mahaa bachitr kaabray katheeaai ||

614.t: pavitr sabadh uoopajai charitr kau na kijeeaai ||4||
614.e: His poem is said to be extremly pure and each of its episodies is spotless, sanctified and marvelous.4.

614.e: According to the instructions given in Ramayana, we should ever be in the service of the Lord

614.e: Through the glory of His Name, many mighty enemies are killed and the charities of innumerable types are bestowed

614.e: That Lord, also keeping his name on our heads, protects the ignorant people like us.5.

614.t: n sa(n)t baar baak hai asa(n)t joojh hai balee ||

614.e: Even after the fighting of many mighty warriors, the saints remain unharmed and before the forces of agony and before the white arrows of His Grace and tranquility, the forces of agony and affliction fly away

614.e: Those who because sages, he though about them, he interpreted the Vedas and removed the misfortune from the earth.8.

615.e: The manner in which Brahma assumed his body, I now describe it nicely.9.

615.e: End of the description of Kashyap the second incarnation of Brahma, in Bachittar Natak.
Now being the description about the third incarnation Shukra
PAADHARI STANZA

The lowly gods served the Lord for a hundred years, when he (the Guru-Lord) was pleased
Then Brahma assumed the from of Baches, when Indra, the king of gods became the conqueror and the demons were defeated.3.
In way, the fourth incarnation manifested himself, on account of which Indra, conquered and the demons were defeated

615.e: Then all the gods relinquished their pried and served with him bowed eyes.4.

Treat age passed and Dwapar age came, when Krishna manifested himself and performed various kinds of sports, then Vyas was born

615.t: tab bhe bayaas mukh aan chaar ||5||
615.e: He had a charming face.5.

615.g: ਜੇ ਜੇ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਅ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਦੇਵ ॥
615.t: je je charitr keea kirasan dhev ||

Now I describe them in brief, all the works, which Vyas executed.6.

615.t: teh bhaat kaab kath hai bichaar ||
615.e: The manner in which he propagated his writings, in the same manner, I relate the same here thoughtfully
The poetry that Vyas composed, I now relate here same type of glorious sayings.7.

615.g: ਜੇ ਭਏ ਭੂਪ ਭੂਅ ਮੋ ਮਹਾਨ ॥
615.t: je bhe bhoop bhooa mo mahaan ||

615.e: The scholars describe the stories of all the great kings, who ruled over the earth
To what extent, they may be narrated, O my fried! Listen to the same in brief.8.

615.t: man bhayo raaj meh ko bhooaar ||

He brought to the human words and extending his approbation his greatness?

615.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਹੁਇ ਰਹੈ ਮਉਨ ॥੧੦॥
615.t: sun sravan kirat hui rahai maun ||10||
615.e: And listening to his praise one can only remain mute.10.
He was ocean of eighteen sciences and he got his trumpets sounded after conquering his enemies
He made many person kings, and those who resisted, he killed them, the ghosts and fiends also used to dance in his battlefield.11.
He conquered many countries of opponents and destroyed many to the status of royalty
He snatched the countries of many and exiled them.12.
He killed many dreadful Kshatriyas and suppressed many corrupt and tyrannical warriors
Many stable and invincible fighter fled before him and me destroyed many powerful warriors.13.
He subdued many mighty kshatriyas and established many new kings,

615.g: ਮਾਨੀ ਸੁ ਮਾਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਇ ॥੧੪॥
615.t: maanee su maan man raaj rai ||14||
615.e: In the countries of opposing kings, in the way, the king menu was hououred throughout the bravery.14.

615.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਦੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਸ ਰਾਜ ॥
615.t: eeh bhaat dheeh kar dhes raaj ||

615.e: In this way, after conquering many kings, manu performed many hom-yajnas,

616.t: jo hutee jag ar bedh reet ||

616.e: He performed all the Vedic traditions with devotion
He also gave various types of charities concerning lands, jewels ect.16.

616.t: kar dhes dhes im neet raaj ||

He donated many decorated horses to those Brahmins, who had the knowledge of eighteen sciences, who were the reciters of six Shastr ect.
And also those who were skilful in playing various types of musical instruments.18.
At that time the Sandal and roses were rubbed and the liquor of musk was prepared
During the reign of that king, the abodes of all the people gave out the fragrance of Kashmiri grass.19.

The tunes of Iyer, drum etc. were heard
The pleasing sounds of tabors, clarions, clarionets ect. Were also heard.2o.
Somewhere there wes tune of drum, lyer etc. and somewhere the sound of tabor, anklet, drum,musical glasses ect. Was heard

616.t: sas sooraj kee lakh kraat hare ||24||
616.e: There a women named Shakuntala, whose light bedimmed even the luster of the sun.24.
HARIBOLMANA STANZA
After killing a deer and seeing a desolate cottage, the king reached there.25.

617.e: He went there and there was none with him, he saw a very charming woman there.26.
Her glory coveted his mind, when the king saw her, his mind was startled.27.
The king though as to whose daughter that beautiful woman was, seeing here beauty the king saw allured and his mind fell in love with her.28.
The king caught her arm and that woman kept silent, absorded and dyed with love, both became lustful.29.
The king enjoyed her in various ways till night both of them felt so much pleased with each other that is the not possible for me to narrate.30.
Being absorbed and dyed with love, they kept engrossed in sexual enjoinment many types of postures.31.
They enjoyment the relish of various types of postures and in the way, both of them established their sexual sport.32.
After that woman having enjoyed the sexual sport, came out of that cottage, the king went away and Shakuntala became pregnant.33.
Many days passed, when she gave birth to a child, who was wearing armour on his body and was also the abductor of moon’s beauty.34.
His splendour was like the forest-fire, whosoever saw him, he was wonder-struck.35.
When the child grew a bit older, she (the mother) took him there where his father was.36.
When the king saw her, he hesitated a little and asked her ”O” woman, who are you and who is this boy?”37.
Speech of the woman addressed to the king:
HARIBOLMANA STANZA
“O king! I am the same woman, with whom you had had sexual enjoyment in the forest-cottage.38.
“Then you had given your word now you have forgotten, O king! remember that promise and now own me.39.
“If now you are forsaking me, then why did you own me at that time? O king! I am saying the truth that he is your son.40.
“If you will not wed me, then I shall curse you, therefore now do not forsake me and do not feel shy.”41.
Speech of the king addressed to the woman
You may tell me some sign or saying, otherwise I shall not wed You; O woman! Do not forsake your shyness 42.

618.g: ਕਸ ਹੇਰ ਤਲੈ ॥੪੩॥
618.t: kas her talai ||43||
618.e: Sakuntla placed a gold coin on the hand of the king and said, " You look at it and remember." 43.

618.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਜਾਨਿ ਗਏ ॥
618.t: nirap jaan ge ||

618.g: ਪਹਿਚਾਨਤ ਭਏ ॥
618.t: pahichaanat bhe ||

618.g: ਤਬ ਤਉਨ ਬਰੀ ॥
618.t: tab taun baree ||

618.g: ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਰੀ ॥੪੪॥
618.t: bahu bhaat bharee ||44||
618.e: The king remembered all and recognised Shakuntala,Then the king solemnised his wedding with her and enjoyed her in various ways.44.

618.g: ਸਿਸੁ ਸਾਤ ਭਏ ॥
618.t: sis saat bhe ||

618.g: ਰਸ ਰੂਪ ਰਏ ॥
618.t: ras roop re ||

618.g: ਅਮਿਤੋਜ ਬਲੀ ॥
618.t: amitoj balee ||

618.g: ਦਲ ਦੀਹ ਦਲੀ ॥੪੫॥
618.t: dhal dheeh dhalee ||45||
618.e: She had seven charming sons born to her, who were man of infinite glory and destroyers of enemies. 45.

618.g: ਹਨਿ ਭੂਪ ਬਲੀ ॥
618.t: han bhoop balee ||

618.g: ਜਿਣਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਥਲੀ ॥
618.t: jin bhoom thalee ||

618.g: ਰਿਖਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਰਜੀ ॥
618.t: rikh bol rajee ||

618.g: ਬਿਧਿ ਜਗ ਸਜੀ ॥੪੬॥
618.t: bidh jag sajee ||46||
618.e: They conquered the earth after killing the mighty kings and inviting the sages performed the Yajna. 46.

618.g: ਸੁਭ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੇ ॥
618.t: subh karam kare ||

618.g: ਅਰਿ ਪੁੰਜ ਹਰੇ ॥
618.t: ar pu(n)j hare ||

618.g: ਅਤਿ ਸੂਰ ਮਹਾ ॥
618.t: at soor mahaa ||

618.g: ਨਹਿ ਔਰ ਲਹਾ ॥੪੭॥
618.t: neh aauar lahaa ||47||
618.e: The performed good actions and destroyed the enemies and none seems equivalent in bravery to them. 47.

618.g: ਅਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਸੈ ॥
618.t: at jot lasai ||

618.g: ਸਸਿ ਕ੍ਰਾਤਿ ਕਸੈ ॥
618.t: sas kraat kasai ||

618.g: ਦਿਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਕੀ ॥
618.t: dhis chaar chakee ||

618.g: ਸੁਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਛਕੀ ॥੪੮॥
618.t: sur naar chhakee ||48||
618.e: They were lustrous like moonlight and women of gods of all the four directions were pleased to see them. 48.

618.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
618.t: rooaal chha(n)dh ||
618.e: ROOAAL STANZA

618.g: ਗਾਰਿ ਗਾਰਿ ਅਖਰਬ ਗਰਬਿਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਨਰੇਸ ॥
618.t: gaar gaar akharab garabin maar maar nares ||

618.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਜੀਤ ਰਾਜਨ ਛੀਨਿ ਦੇਸ ਬਿਦੇਸ ॥
618.t: jeet jeet ajeet raajan chheen dhes bidhes ||
618.e: They killed innumerable proud kings and snatching the kingdoms of invincible kings, they killed them

618.g: ਟਾਰਿ ਟਾਰਿ ਕਰੋਰਿ ਪਬਯ ਦੀਨ ਉਤਰ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥
618.t: Taar Taar karor pabay dheen utar dhisaan ||

618.g: ਸਪਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਭਏ ਧਰਾ ਪਰ ਲੀਕ ਚਕ੍ਰ ਰਥਾਨ ॥੪੯॥
618.t: sapat si(n)dh bhe dharaa par leek chakr rathaan ||49||
618.e: They went to the North, crossing many mountains and with the lines of the wheels of their chariots seven oceans were formed. 49.

618.g: ਗਾਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਦੇਸਨ ਬਾਹਿ ਬਾਹਿ ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ॥
618.t: gaeh gaeh agaeh dhesan baeh baeh hathiyaar ||

618.g: ਤੋਰਿ ਤੋਰਿ ਅਤੋਰ ਭੂਧ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਉਤ੍ਰਹਿ ਟਾਰ ॥
618.t: tor tor ator bhoodhirak dheen utreh Taar ||
618.e: By striking their weapons and roaming on the whole earth and breaking the mountains, they threw their fragments in the North

618.g: ਦੇਸ ਔਰ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਜੀਤਿ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਰਾਜ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
618.t: dhes aauar bidhes jeet bisekh raaj kamai ||

618.g: ਅੰਤ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਤਿ ਭੀ ਪ੍ਰਿਥ ਰਾਇ ॥੫੦॥
618.t: a(n)t jot su jot mo mil jaat bhee pirath rai ||50||
618.e: After conquering various countries far and near and ruling over them, the king prithu ultimately merged in the Supreme Light.50.

618.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਅਵਤਾਰੇ ਬਿਆਸ ਰਾਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨॥੫॥
618.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the brahamaa avataare biaas raajaa pirath ko raaj samaapata(n) ||2||5||

618.g: ਅਥ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
618.t: ath raajaa bharath raaj kathana(n) ||

618.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
618.t: rooaal chha(n)dh ||
618.e: ROOAAL STANZA

618.g: ਜਾਨਿ ਅੰਤ ਸਮੋ ਭਯੋ ਪ੍ਰਿਥੁ ਰਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਵਤਾਰ ॥
618.t: jaan a(n)t samo bhayo pirath raaj raaj vataar ||

618.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਸਮ੍ਰਿਧਿ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰਿ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
618.t: bol sarab samiradh sa(n)pat ma(n)tr mitr kumaar ||
618.e: Considering his end very near, the king Prithu called for all his assets, friends, ministers and princes

618.g: ਸਪਤ ਦ੍ਵੀਪ ਸੁ ਸਪਤ ਪੁਤ੍ਰਨਿ ਬਾਟ ਦੀਨ ਤੁਰੰਤ ॥
618.t: sapat dhavaieep su sapat putran baaT dheen tura(n)t ||

618.g: ਸਪਤ ਰਾਜ ਕਰੈ ਲਗੈ ਸੁਤ ਸਰਬ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤ ॥੫੧॥
618.t: sapat raaj karai lagai sut sarab sobhaava(n)t ||51||
618.e: He immediately the seven continents among his seven sons and they all being to rule with extreme glory.51.

618.g: ਸਪਤ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਗੈ ਸਿਰ ਸਪਤ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
618.t: sapat chhatr firai lagai sir sapat raaj kumaar ||

618.g: ਸਪਤ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਪਰੇ ਧਰਾ ਪਰਿ ਸਪਤ ਜਾਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥
618.t: sapat i(n)dhr pare dharaa par sapat jaan avataar ||
618.e: The canopies swung over the heads of all the seven princes and they were all considered as the seven incarnation of Indra

618.g: ਸਰਬ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਰੀ ਸਬੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੇਦ ਰੀਤਿ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ॥
618.t: sarab saasatr dharee sabai mil bedh reet bichaar ||

618.g: ਦਾਨ ਅੰਸ ਨਿਕਾਰ ਲੀਨੀ ਅਰਥ ਸ੍ਵਰਥ ਸੁਧਾਰਿ ॥੫੨॥
618.t: dhaan a(n)s nikaar leenee arath savairath sudhaar ||52||
618.e: They established all the Shastras with commentaries according to Vedic rites and held in honour again the significance of charity.52.

618.g: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਅਖੰਡ ਉਰਬੀ ਬਾਟਿ ਲੀਨਿ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
618.t: kha(n)dd kha(n)dd akha(n)dd urabee baaT leen kumaar ||

618.g: ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਭਏ ਪੁਨਿਰ ਨਵਖੰਡ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
618.t: sapat dheep bhe punir navakha(n)dd naam bichaar ||
618.e: Those princes fragmented the earth and distributed amongst themselves and seven continents “Nav-Khand’ (nine regions)

618.g: ਜੇਸਟ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਧਰੀ ਧਰਾ ਤਿਹ ਭਰਥ ਨਾਮ ਬਖਾਨ ॥
618.t: jesaT putr dharee dharaa teh bharath naam bakhaan ||

618.g: ਭਰਥ ਖੰਡ ਬਖਾਨ ਹੀ ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥੫੩॥
618.t: bharath kha(n)dd bakhaan hee dhas chaar chaar nidhaan ||53||
618.e: The eldest son, whose name was Bharat, he named one of the region as “Bharat Khand”, after the name of the adept Bharat, who was expert in eighteen sciences.53.

618.g: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਕਹੈ ਕਥੇ ਕਵਿ ਨਾਮ ਠਾਮ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
618.t: kaun kaun kahai kathe kav naam Thaam ana(n)t ||
618.e: Which names should be mentioned here by the poet ?

618.g: ਬਾਟਿ ਬਾਟਿ ਸਬੋ ਲਏ ਨਵਖੰਡ ਦ੍ਵੀਪ ਦੁਰੰਤ ॥
618.t: baaT baaT sabo le navakha(n)dd dhavaieep dhura(n)t ||
618.e: They all distributed the Nav-Khand continents among themselves

618.g: ਠਾਮ ਠਾਮ ਭਏ ਨਰਾਧਿਪ ਠਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
618.t: Thaam Thaam bhe naraadhip Thaam naam anek ||

619.g: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਉਚਾਰੀਐ ਕਰਿ ਸੂਰ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਬੇਕ ॥੫੪॥
619.t: kaun kaun uchaareeaai kar soor sarab bibek ||54||
619.e: Many of various names ruled over many places and with power of intellect, whose names should be mentioned, with their description? 54.

619.g: ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪਨ ਸਪਤ ਭੂਪ ਭੁਗੈ ਲਗੇ ਨਵਖੰਡ ॥
619.t: sapat dheepan sapat bhoop bhugai lage navakha(n)dd ||

619.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿਨ ਸੋ ਫਿਰੇ ਅਸਿ ਬਾਧਿ ਜੋਧ ਪ੍ਰਚੰਡ ॥
619.t: bhaat bhaatin so fire as baadh jodh pracha(n)dd ||
619.e: The king ruled over seven continents and nine regions and taking up their swords, in various ways, they moved at all places powerfully

619.g: ਦੀਹ ਦੀਹ ਅਜੀਹ ਦੇਸਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਆਪਿ ਭਨਾਇ ॥
619.t: dheeh dheeh ajeeh dhesan naam aap bhanai ||

619.g: ਆਨਿ ਜਾਨੁ ਦੁਤੀ ਭਏ ਛਿਤਿ ਦੂਸਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥੫੫॥
619.t: aan jaan dhutee bhe chhit dhoosare har rai ||55||
619.e: They forcefully promulgated their names and it seemed that they were the incarnation of the Lord on the earth.55.

619.g: ਆਪ ਆਪ ਸਮੈ ਸਬੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਤ੍ਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥
619.t: aap aap samai sabai sir atr patr firai ||

619.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਜੀਤ ਜੋਧਨ ਰੋਹ ਕ੍ਰੋਹ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
619.t: jeet jeet ajeet jodhan roh kroh kamai ||
619.e: They continued to conquer furiously the invincible warriors, swinging the canopies over the heads of one another

619.g: ਝੂਠ ਸਾਚ ਅਨੰਤ ਬੋਲਿ ਕਲੋਲ ਕੇਲ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
619.t: jhooTh saach ana(n)t bol kalol kel anek ||

619.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਸਬੈ ਭਛੇ ਜਗਿ ਛਾਡੀਆ ਨਹਿ ਏਕ ॥੫੬॥
619.t: a(n)t kaal sabai bhachhe jag chhaaddeeaa neh ek ||56||
619.e: Garrying on behavior conquer furiously the invincible warriors, Swinging the canopies over the ultimately became the food of KAL ( death).56.

619.g: ਆਪ ਅਰਥ ਅਨਰਥ ਅਪਰਥ ਸਮਰਥ ਕਰਤ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
619.t: aap arath anarath aparath samarath karat ana(n)t ||

619.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਠਟੀ ਕਛੂ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੋਟਿ ਕ੍ਯੋਨ ਨ ਕਰੰਤ ॥
619.t: a(n)t hot ThaTee kachhoo prabhoo koT kayon na kara(n)t ||
619.e: The powerful people perform many sinful action and unjust deeds, for their interest, but ultimately they have to appear before the Lord

619.g: ਜਾਨ ਬੂਝ ਪਰੰਤ ਕੂਪ ਲਹੰਤ ਮੂੜ ਨ ਭੇਵ ॥
619.t: jaan boojh para(n)t koop laha(n)t mooR na bhev ||
619.e: The being deliberately falls into the well and dose not know the secret of the Lord

619.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲ ਤਬੈ ਬਚੈ ਜਬ ਜਾਨ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥੫੭॥
619.t: a(n)t kaal tabai bachai jab jaan hai gurdhev ||57||
619.e: He will only save himself from death, when he will comprehend that Guru-Lord.57.

619.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਠਟੀ ਭਲੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੂੜ ਲੋਗ ਨ ਜਾਨਿ ॥
619.t: a(n)t hot ThaTee bhalee prabh mooR log na jaan ||
619.e: The fools do not know that ultimately we feet shy before the Lord

619.g: ਆਪ ਅਰਥ ਪਛਾਨ ਹੀ ਤਜਿ ਦੀਹ ਦੇਵ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
619.t: aap arath pachhaan hee taj dheeh dhev nidhaan ||
619.e: These fools forsaking their supreme father, the Lord, only recognize their own interest

619.g: ਧਰਮ ਜਾਨਿ ਕਰਤ ਪਾਪਨ ਯੌ ਨ ਜਾਨਤ ਮੂੜ ॥
619.t: dharam jaan karat paapan yau na jaanat mooR ||

619.g: ਸਰਬ ਕਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੋ ਕਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਯੋਗ ਗੂੜ ਅਗੂੜ ॥੫੮॥
619.t: sarab kaal dhiaal ko kahu prayog gooR agooR ||58||
619.e: They commit sins in the name of religion and they do not know even this much that this is the profound myself of the compassionate of the Name of the Lord.58

619.g: ਪਾਪ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਛਾਨ ਹੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਕੀ ਸਮ ਪਾਪ ॥
619.t: paap pu(n)n pachhaan hee kar pu(n)n kee sam paap ||

619.g: ਪਰਮ ਜਾਨ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਜਾਪਨ ਜਪੈ ਲਾਗ ਕੁਜਾਪ ॥
619.t: param jaan pavitr jaapan japai laag kujaap ||
619.e: They are ever absorbed in evil action considering sin as virtue and virtue as sin, the holy as unholy and without knowing the remembrance of the Name of the Lord:

619.g: ਸਿਧ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਮਾਨਹੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਧ ਠਉਰ ਪੂਜੰਤ ॥
619.t: sidh Thaur na maanahee bin sidh Thaur pooja(n)t ||
619.e: The being does not believe in the good place and worship bad place

619.g: ਹਾਥਿ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਲੈ ਮਹਾ ਪਸੁ ਮਧਿ ਕੂਪ ਪਰੰਤ ॥੫੯॥
619.t: haath dheepak lai mahaa pas madh koop para(n)t ||59||
619.e: In such a position he falls in the well, even having the lamp in his hand.59.

619.g: ਸਿਧ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਮਾਨ ਹੀ ਅਨਸਿਧ ਪੂਜਤ ਠਉਰ ॥
619.t: sidh Thaur na maan hee anasidh poojat Thaur ||
619.e: Having on belief in holy places, he worship the unholy ones

619.g: ਕੈ ਕੁ ਦਿਵਸ ਚਲਾਹਿਗੇ ਜੜ ਭੀਤ ਕੀ ਸੀ ਦਉਰ ॥
619.t: kai k dhivas chalaahige jaR bheet kee see dhaur ||
619.e: But for now many days he will be able to run such a cowardly race ?

619.g: ਪੰਖ ਹੀਨ ਕਹਾ ਉਡਾਇਬ ਨੈਨ ਹੀਨ ਨਿਹਾਰ ॥
619.t: pa(n)kh heen kahaa uddaib nain heen nihaar ||
619.e: Hoe can one fly without the wings? And how can one see without the eyes? How can one go to the battlefield without weapons

619.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਹੀਨ ਜੁਧਾ ਨ ਪੈਠਬ ਅਰਥ ਹੀਨ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥੬੦॥
619.t: sasatr heen judhaa na paiThab arath heen bichaar ||60||
619.e: And without understaning the meaning how can one understand any problem?.60.

619.g: ਦਰਬ ਹੀਣ ਬਪਾਰ ਜੈਸਕ ਅਰਥ ਬਿਨੁ ਇਸ ਲੋਕ ॥
619.t: dharab heen bapaar jaisak arath bin is lok ||

619.g: ਆਂਖ ਹੀਣ ਬਿਲੋਕਬੋ ਜਗਿ ਕਾਮਕੇਲ ਅਕੋਕ ॥
619.t: aa(n)kh heen bilokabo jag kaamakel akok ||
619.e: How can one indulge in trade without wealth? How can one visualise the lustful actions without eyes?

619.g: ਗਿਆਨ ਹੀਣ ਸੁ ਪਾਠ ਗੀਤਾ ਬੁਧਿ ਹੀਣ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
619.t: giaan heen su paaTh geetaa budh heen bichaar ||

619.g: ਹਿੰਮਤ ਹੀਨ ਜੁਧਾਨ ਜੂਝਬ ਕੇਲ ਹੀਣ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥੬੧॥
619.t: hi(n)mat heen judhaan joojhab kel heen kumaar ||61||
619.e: How can one recite Gita without knowledge and reflect upon it without intellect? How can one go to the battlefield without counrage.61

619.g: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਗਨਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਭਏ ਭੂਮਿ ਮਹੀਪ ॥
619.t: kaun kaun ganaieeaai je bhe bhoom maheep ||

619.g: ਕਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਸੁ ਕਥੀਐ ਜਗਿ ਕੇ ਸੁ ਦ੍ਵੀਪ ਅਦ੍ਵੀਪ ॥
619.t: kaun kaun su katheeaai jag ke su dhavaieep adhavaieep ||
619.e: How many kings were there? To want extent they be enumerated, and how far should the continents and regions of the world be described?

619.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਕੀਨ ਗਨੈ ਵਹੈ ਇਮਿ ਔਰ ਕੀ ਨਹਿ ਸਕਤਿ ॥
619.t: jaas keen ganai vahai im aauar kee neh sakat ||

619.g: ਯੌ ਨ ਐਸ ਪਹਚਾਨੀਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਕੀ ਕੀਏ ਭਗਤਿ ॥੬੨॥
619.t: yau na aais pahachaaneeaai bin taas kee ke'ee bhagat ||62||
619.e: I have enumerated, only those which have come within my sight, I am unable to enumerate more and the this is also not possible without His devotion.62.

619.g: ਇਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਭਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੩॥੫॥
619.t: eit raajaa bharath raaj samaapata(n) ||3||5||

619.g: ਅਥ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਰ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
619.t: ath raajaa sagar raaj kathana(n) ||

619.g: ਰੂਆਲ ਛੰਦ ॥
619.t: rooaal chha(n)dh ||
619.e: ROOAAL STANZA

619.g: ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਭਏ ਜਿਤੇ ਇਹ ਭੂਮਿ ਆਨਿ ਨਰੇਸ ॥
619.t: sresaT sresaT bhe jite ieh bhoom aan nares ||

619.g: ਤਉਨ ਤਉਨ ਉਚਾਰਹੋ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਅਸੇਸ ॥
619.t: taun taun uchaaraho tumare prasaadh ases ||
619.e: All the superb kings who had ruled over the earth, O Lord! With thy Grace, I describe at of them

619.g: ਭਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਤੀਤ ਭੇ ਭਏ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਗਰ ਰਾਜ ॥
619.t: bharath raaj biteet bhe bhe raajaa sagar raaj ||

619.g: ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਕੀ ਤਪਸਾ ਕਰੀ ਲੀਅ ਲਛ ਸੁਤ ਉਪਰਾਜਿ ॥੬੩॥
619.t: rudhr kee tapasaa karee leea lachh sut uparaaj ||63||
619.e: There was king sagar after Bharat, who meditated on Rudra and performed austerities, he obtained the boon of one lakh sons.63.

619.g: ਚਕ੍ਰ ਬਕ੍ਰ ਧੁਜਾ ਗਦਾ ਭ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਜ ਕੁਮਾਰ ॥
619.t: chakr bakr dhujaa gadhaa bhirat sarab raaj kumaar ||

619.g: ਲਛ ਰੂਪ ਧਰੇ ਮਨੋ ਜਗਿ ਆਨਿ ਮੈਨ ਸੁ ਧਾਰ ॥
619.t: lachh roop dhare mano jag aan main su dhaar ||
619.e: They were princes of discus, banners and maces and it seemed that the god of love had manifested himself in lakhs of forms

619.g: ਬੇਖ ਬੇਖ ਬਨੇ ਨਰੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਜੀਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਅਸੇਸ ॥
619.t: bekh bekh bane naresavair jeet dhes ases ||

619.g: ਦਾਸ ਭਾਵ ਸਬੈ ਧਰੇ ਮਨਿ ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਨਰੇਸ ॥੬੪॥
619.t: dhaas bhaav sabai dhare man jatr tatr nares ||64||
619.e: They conquered various countries and became kings considering them sovereigns became their servants.64.

619.g: ਬਾਜ ਮੇਧ ਕਰੈ ਲਗੈ ਹਯਸਾਲਿ ਤੇ ਹਯ ਚੀਨਿ ॥
619.t: baaj medh karai lagai hayasaal te hay cheen ||
619.e: They selected a fine horse from their stable and decided to perform Ashvamedha Yajna

619.g: ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਅਮੋਲ ਰਿਤੁਜ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ॥
619.t: bol bol amol rituj ma(n)tr mitr prabeen ||
619.e: They invited the ministers, friends and Brahmins

619.g: ਸੰਗ ਦੀਨ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੈਨ ਬ੍ਰਯੂਹ ਬ੍ਰਯੂਹ ਬਨਾਇ ॥
619.t: sa(n)g dheen samooh sain brayooh brayooh banai ||

619.g: ਜਤ੍ਰ ਤਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰੈ ਲਗੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਅਤ੍ਰ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥੬੫॥
619.t: jatr tatr firai lage sir atr patr firai ||65||
619.e: After that they gave groups of their forces to their ministers, who moved here and there, swinging the canopies over their heada.65.

619.g: ਜੈਤਪਤ੍ਰ ਲਹ੍ਯੋ ਜਹਾ ਤਹ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਭੇ ਸਭ ਚੂਰ ॥
619.t: jaitapatr lahayo jahaa teh satr bhe sabh choor ||
619.e: They obtained letter of victory from all the places and all their enemies were smashed

619.g: ਛੋਰਿ ਛੋਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਨਰੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੂਰ ॥
619.t: chhor chhor bhaje naresavair chhaadd sasatr karoor ||
619.e: All the such kings ran away, forsaking their weapons

619.g: ਡਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਸੂਰ ਤ੍ਰੀਆਨ ਭੇਸ ਸੁ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
619.t: ddaar ddaar sanaeh soor treeaan bhes su dhaar ||

619.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ ਜਹਾ ਤਹ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ॥੬੬॥
619.t: bhaaj bhaaj chale jahaa teh putr mitr bisaar ||66||
619.e: These warriors, putting off their armours, assuming the guise of women and forgetting their sons and friends, ran away here and there.66.

619.g: ਗਾਜਿ ਗਾਜਿ ਗਜੇ ਗਦਾਧਰਿ ਭਾਜਿ ਭਾਜਿ ਸੁ ਭੀਰ ॥
619.t: gaaj gaaj gaje gadhaadhar bhaaj bhaaj su bheer ||
619.e: The mace-wielders thundered and the cowards fled away

619.g: ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਤਜੈ ਭਜੈ ਬਿਸੰਭਾਰ ਬੀਰ ਸੁਧੀਰ ॥
619.t: saaj baaj tajai bhajai bisa(n)bhaar beer sudheer ||
619.e: Many warriors leaving their paraphernalia ran away

619.g: ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਗਜੇ ਜਹਾ ਤਹ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਨਚਾਇ ॥
619.t: soorabeer gaje jahaa teh asatr sasatr nachai ||

619.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਲਏ ਸੁ ਦੇਸਨ ਜੈਤਪਤ੍ਰ ਫਿਰਾਇ ॥੬੭॥
619.t: jeet jeet le su dhesan jaitapatr firai ||67||
619.e: Wherever there brave warriors thundered, activating their arms and weapons, they obtained victory and got the letter of conquest.67.

619.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਪੂਰਬ ਪਛਿਮੈ ਅਰੁ ਲੀਨ ਦਛਨਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
619.t: jeet poorab pachhimai ar leen dhachhan jai ||

619.g: ਤਾਕਿ ਬਾਜ ਚਲ੍ਯੋ ਤਹਾ ਜਹ ਬੈਠਿ ਥੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
619.t: taak baaj chalayo tahaa jeh baiTh the mun rai ||
619.e: They conquered the East, West and south and now the horse reached there where the grate sage Kapila was sitting

619.g: ਧ੍ਰਯਾਨ ਮਧਿ ਹੁਤੇ ਮਹਾ ਮੁਨਿ ਸਾਜ ਬਾਜ ਨ ਦੇਖਿ ॥
619.t: dhrayaan madh hute mahaa mun saaj baaj na dhekh ||

619.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਪਛ ਖਰੋ ਭਯੋ ਰਿਖਿ ਜਾਨਿ ਗੋਰਖ ਭੇਖ ॥੬੮॥
619.t: pirasaT pachh kharo bhayo rikh jaan gorakh bhekh ||68||
619.e: He was absorbed in meditation, he did not see the home, which seeing him in the guise of Gorakh, stood behind him.68.

619.g: ਚਉਕ ਚਿਤ ਰਹੇ ਸਬੈ ਜਬ ਦੇਖਿ ਨੈਨ ਨ ਬਾਜ ॥
619.t: chauk chit rahe sabai jab dhekh nain na baaj ||
619.e: When all the warriors did not see the horse, they were wonderstruks

619.g: ਖੋਜਿ ਖੋਜਿ ਥਕੇ ਸਬੈ ਦਿਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਸਲਾਜ ॥
619.t: khoj khoj thake sabai dhis chaar chaar salaaj ||
619.e: And in their shame, began to search for the horse in all the four direction

619.g: ਜਾਨਿ ਪਯਾਰ ਗਯੋ ਤੁਰੰਗਮ ਕੀਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਬਿਚਾਰ ॥
619.t: jaan payaar gayo tura(n)gam keen chit bichaar ||

619.g: ਸਗਰ ਖਾਤ ਖੁਦੈ ਲਗੇ ਰਣਧੀਰ ਬੀਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥੬੯॥
619.t: sagar khaat khudhai lage ranadheer beer apaar ||69||
619.e: Thinking this that the horse had gone to the nether-world, they tried to enter that world by digging a comprehensive pit.69.

619.g: ਖੋਦਿ ਖੋਦਿ ਅਖੋਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਜੋਧ ਅਨੰਤ ॥
619.t: khodh khodh akhodh pirathavee krodh jodh ana(n)t ||

619.g: ਭਛਿ ਭਛਿ ਗਏ ਸਬੈ ਮੁਖ ਮ੍ਰਿਤਕਾ ਦੁਤਿ ਵੰਤ ॥
619.t: bhachh bhachh ge sabai mukh mritakaa dhut va(n)t ||
619.e: The furious warriors began to dig the earth and the brightness of their faces became earth like

619.g: ਸਗਰ ਖਾਤ ਖੁਦੈ ਲਗੇ ਦਿਸ ਖੋਦ ਦਛਨ ਸਰਬ ॥
619.t: sagar khaat khudhai lage dhis khodh dhachhan sarab ||

619.g: ਜੀਤਿ ਪੂਰਬ ਕੋ ਚਲੇ ਅਤਿ ਠਾਨ ਕੈ ਜੀਅ ਗਰਬ ॥੭੦॥
619.t: jeet poorab ko chale at Thaan kai jeea garab ||70||
619.e: In this way when they made the whole of the South an abyss, then they conquering it advanced towards the East.70.

619.g: ਖੋਦ ਦਛਨ ਕੀ ਦਿਸਾ ਪੁਨਿ ਖੋਦ ਪੂਰਬ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥
619.t: khodh dhachhan kee dhisaa pun khodh poorab dhisaan ||

619.g: ਤਾਕਿ ਪਛਮ ਕੋ ਚਲੇ ਦਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
619.t: taak pachham ko chale dhas chaar chaar nidhaan ||
619.e: After digging the south and the east, those warriors, who were experts in all the sciences, fell upon the west

619.g: ਪੈਠਿ ਉਤਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਜਬੈ ਖੋਦੈ ਲਗੇ ਸਭ ਠਉਰ ॥
619.t: paiTh utar dhisaa jabai khodhai lage sabh Thaur ||

619.g: ਅਉਰ ਅਉਰ ਠਟੈ ਪਸੂ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਠਾਟੀ ਅਉਰ ॥੭੧॥
619.t: aaur aaur ThaTai pasoo kal kaal ThaaTee aaur ||71||
619.e: When, advancing towards the north, they began to dig the earth, they were thinking sometime else in their minds, but the Lord had thought otherwise.71.

620.g: ਖੋਦਿ ਕੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਵੀ ਪੂਜਿ ਅਰਧ ਦਿਸਾਨ ॥
620.t: khodh kai bahu bhaat pirathavee pooj aradh dhisaan ||

620.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਭੇਦ ਬਿਲੋਕੀਆ ਮੁਨਿ ਬੈਠਿ ਸੰਜੁਤ ਧ੍ਯਾਨ ॥
620.t: a(n)t bhedh bilokeeaa mun baiTh sa(n)jut dhayaan ||
620.e: While digging the earth in various ways, scanned all the directions, they ultimately saw the sage Kapila in medication

620.g: ਪ੍ਰਿਸਟ ਪਾਛ ਬਿਲੋਕ ਬਾਜ ਸਮਾਜ ਰੂਪ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
620.t: pirasaT paachh bilok baaj samaaj roop anoop ||

620.g: ਲਾਤ ਭੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਅਤਿ ਗਰਬ ਕੈ ਸੁਤ ਭੂਪ ॥੭੨॥
620.t: laat bhe mun maario at garab kai sut bhoop ||72||
620.e: They saw the horse behind him and those princes in their pride, hit the sage with the leg.72.

620.g: ਧ੍ਰਯਾਨ ਛੂਟ ਤਬੈ ਮੁਨੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਗ ਜ੍ਵਾਲ ਮਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ॥
620.t: dhrayaan chhooT tabai munee dhirag javaiaal maal karaal ||

620.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿਨ ਸੋ ਉਠੀ ਜਨੁ ਸਿੰਧ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਿਸਾਲ ॥
620.t: bhaat bhaatin so uThee jan si(n)dh agan bisaal ||
620.e: The medication of the sage was broken and from within him arose various kinds of huge fires

620.g: ਭਸਮਿ ਭੂਤ ਭਏ ਸਬੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਲਛ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਨੈਨ ॥
620.t: bhasam bhoot bhe sabe nirap lachh putr su nain ||

620.g: ਬਾਜ ਰਾਜ ਸੁ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਜੁਤ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸੁ ਸੈਨ ॥੭੩॥
620.t: baaj raaj su sa(n)padhaa jut asatr sasatr su sain ||73||
620.e: In that fire, one-lakh sons of the king along with their horses, arms, weapons and forces were reduced to ashes.73.
All the sons of the king were reduced to ashes and all his forces were destroyed while lamenting.74
When those prices of great glory were burnt down then the pride of all was smashed.75.
That most powerful Lord is extremely Glorious and the warriors of all the four directions fear Him.76.
Some warriors who had been burnt, ran impatiently towards the king and they conveyed the whole thing to the king sagar.77.
When the king sagar saw this, he impatiently asked the news about his sons.78.
Then all of them talked about their strength and also said how the pried of those warriors was destroyed, the tears were flowing from their eyes while saying this.79.
The messengers told this that his sons, causing their horse to move on all the earth, had conquered all the kings and had taken them along with themselves.80.
Your sons, thinking that the horse had gone to the nether-world, had dug the whole of the earth and in this way, their pride had enormously increased.81.
There all of them saw themost glorious sage (Kapila) absorbed in meditation.82.

621.e: Your sons, taking the warriors with them, hit that sage with their legs.83.
Then the meditation of that great sage was shattered and a huge fire came out of his eyes.84.
The messenger told, “O king Sagar! in this way all your sons were burnt and reduced to ashes alongwith their army and not even one of them survived.”85.
Hearing about the destruction of his sons, the whole city was steeped in sorrow and all the people here and there were filled with anguish.86.
All of them, remembering Shiva, withholding their tears assumed patience in their minds with the holy saying of the sages.87.
Then the king performed the last funeral rites of all affectionately according to Vedic injunctions.88.
In his extreme sorrow on the demise of his sons, the king left for heaven and after him, there were several other kings, who can describe them?89.

621.g: ਇਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੪॥੫॥
621.t: eit raajaa saagar ko raaj samaapata(n) ||4||5||
621.e: End of the description of Vyas, the incrnation of Brahma and the rule of king Prithu in Bachittar Natak.

621.g: ਅਥ ਜੁਜਾਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ
621.t: ath jujaat raajaa ko raaj kathana(n)
621.e: Now begins the description about king Yayati
MADHUBHAAR STANZA
Then there was a most glorious king Yayati, whose fame had spread in the fourteen worlds.90.
His eyes were charming and his form of enormous glory was like the god of love.91.
The fourteen worlds had received brilliance from the glory of his charming elegance.92.
That generous king had innumerable qualities and had skill in fourteen science.93.
That beautiful king was most glorious, capable, expert in qualities and had faith in God.94.
The king had knowledge of Shastras, he was extremely furious in war, he was the fulfiller of all wishes like Kamadhenu, the wish-fulfilling cow.95.
The king with his bloody dagger was and invincible, complete, furious and powerful warrior.96.
When he drew his sword, he was like KAL (death) for his enemies, and his magnificence was like the fires of the sun.97.
When he fought, none of his limbs turned back, none of his enemies could stand before him and thus ran away.98.
The sun trembled before him, the directions shivered, the opponents stood with bowed heads and would run away in anxiety.99.
The warriors trembled, the cowards fled and the kings of various countries would break before him like thread.100.

622.e: The moon stood wonder-stuck in his presence, the heart of Indra throbbed violently, the ganas were destroyed and the mountains also fled away.101.

Everyone heard his praise at many places and the enemies, listening to his praises would become fearful and suffer mental agony, he removed the afficions of the poor by performing the Yajnas in a nice manner.102.

622.g: ਇਤਿ ਜੁਜਾਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਸਿ ਹੋਤ ਭਏ ॥੫॥੫॥
622.t: eit jujaat raajaa mirat bas hot bhe ||5||5||
622.e: End of the description about king Yayati and his death.

622.g: ਅਥ ਬੇਨ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
622.t: ath ben raaje ko raaj kathana(n) ||
622.e: Now begins the description about the rule of king Ben

622.g: ਨਿਜਿ ਡੰਡ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਨ ਲਯੋ ॥
622.t: nij dda(n)dd kaahoo(n) te na layo ||

622.e: Then Ben became the king of the earth, he never charged tax from anyone, the beings were happy in various ways and none had any pride in him.103.
The beings were happy in various ways and even the trees did not seem to have any suffering, there was praise of the king everywhere on the earth.104.
In this way, keeping all his country happy, the king removed many afflictions of the lowly and seeing his splendour, all the gods also appreciated him.105.
Ruling for a very long time and getting the canopy swung over his head, the light of the soul of that mighty king Ben merged in the Supreme Light of the Lord.106.
All the immaculate kings ultimately merged in the Lord after their rule, which poet can enumerate their names? Therefore, I have only hinted about them.107.

622.g: ਇਤਿ ਬੇਨੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਸ ਹੋਤ ਭਏ ॥੬॥੫॥
622.t: eit ben raajaa mirat bas hot bhe ||6||5||
622.e: End of the description about the king Ben and his death.
Now beings the description about the rule of Mandhata

622.g: ਨਾਮ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਵਿ ਕੋ ਧਰਿ ॥
622.t: naam sakai tin ke kav ko dhar ||

622.e: All the kings who have ruled over the earth, which poet can describe their names? I fear the increase of this volume by narrating their names.108.

622.g: ਬੇਨੁ ਗਏ ਜਗ ਤੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਾ ਕਰਿ ॥
622.t: ben ge jag te nirapataa kar ||

622.e: After the rule of Ben, Mandhata became the king

622.g: ਬਾਸਵ ਲੋਗ ਗਏ ਜਬ ਹੀ ਵਹ ॥
622.t: baasav log ge jab hee veh ||

622.e: When he went to the country of Indra, Indra gave him half his seat.109.
The king Mandhata was filled with rage and challenging him, held his dagger in his hand
When, in his fury, he was about to strike Indra, then Brihaspati immediately caught his hand.110.

622.g: ਨਾਸ ਕਰੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਬਾਸਵ ਕੋ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ॥
622.t: naas karo jin baasav ko nirap ||

623.g: ਆਸਨ ਅਰਧ ਦਯੋ ਤੁਹ ਯਾ ਬ੍ਰਤ ॥
623.t: aasan aradh dhayo tuh yaa brat ||
623.e: He said, “O king! do not strike Indra, there is reason on his part for offering you half of his seat

623.g: ਤਾਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਰ ਸਕੇ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰ ॥੧੧੧॥
623.t: taeh na maar sake tum kiau kar ||111||
623.e: There is one demon named Lavanasura on earth, why have you not been able to kill him as yet?111.

623.g: ਜੌ ਤੁਮ ਤਾਹਿ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕੈ ਆਵਹੁ ॥
623.t: jau tum taeh sa(n)ghaar kai aavahu ||

623.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੋ ਪਰ ਨਾਕੁ ਨ ਐਠਹੁ ॥੧੧੨॥
623.t: saach kaho par naak na aaiThahu ||112||
623.e: “When you will come after killing him, you will then have the full seat of Indra, therefore now be seated on half the seat and accepting this truth, do not exhibit your anger.”112.
ASTAR STANZA
The king, taking up his weapons, reached there, where the demon lived in Mathura-Mandal

623.g: ਮਹਾ ਗਰਬੁ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਮੰਦ ਬੁਧੀ ॥
623.t: mahaa garab kai kai mahaa ma(n)dh budhee ||

623.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੋਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਦਲੰ ਪਰਮ ਕ੍ਰੁਧੀ ॥੧੧੩॥
623.t: mahaa jor kai kai dhala(n) param krudhee ||113||
623.e: He was a great stupid and an egoist, he was a most powerful one and dreadfully outrageous.113.

623.g: ਮਹਾ ਘੋਰ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਘਨੰ ਕੀ ਘਟਾ ਜਿਯੋ ॥
623.t: mahaa ghor kai kai ghana(n) kee ghaTaa jiyo ||

623.g: ਸੁ ਧਾਇਆ ਰਣੰ ਬਿਜੁਲੀ ਕੀ ਛਟਾ ਜਿਯੋ ॥
623.t: s dhaiaa rana(n) bijulee kee chhaTaa jiyo ||
623.e: Thundering like the clouds Mandhata fell upon (the demon) in the battlefield like lightning

623.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਸਰਬ ਦਾਨੋ ਸੁ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਸਿਧਾਇ ॥
623.t: sune sarab dhaano su saamuh sidhai ||
623.e: MEDAK STANZA

623.g: ਮਹਾ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਕੈ ਸੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਨਚਾਏ ॥੧੧੪॥
623.t: mahaa krodh kai kai su baajee nachaae ||114||
623.e: When the demons heard this, they also confronted him and furioudly caused their horses to dance.114.

623.g: ਅਬ ਏਕ ਕੀਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਯੌ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
623.t: ab ek ke'ee bin yau na Tarai ||

623.e: The king was determined to kill him and body of the enemies, grinding their teeth and challenging each other began to fight violently

623.g: ਜਬ ਲੌ ਨ ਸੁਨੋ ਲਵ ਖੇਤ ਮਰਾ ॥
623.t: jab lau na suno lav khet maraa ||

623.g: ਤਬ ਲਉ ਨ ਲਖੋ ਰਨਿ ਬਾਜ ਟਰਾ ॥੧੧੫॥
623.t: tab lau na lakho ran baaj Taraa ||115||
623.e: The king did not stop the showering of arrows, as he waited to get the news of the death of Lavansaura.115.

623.g: ਅਬ ਹੀ ਰਣਿ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਏਕ ਕਰੈ ॥
623.t: ab hee ran ek kee ek karai ||

623.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਏਕ ਕੀਏ ਰਣਿ ਤੇ ਨ ਟਰੈ ॥
623.t: bin ek ke'ee ran te na Tarai ||
623.e: Both of them had the same objective and did not want to leave the battle without killing the opponent

623.g: ਬਹੁ ਸਾਲ ਸਿਲਾ ਤਲ ਬ੍ਰਿਛ ਛੁਟੇ ॥
623.t: bahu saal silaa tal birachh chhuTe ||

623.g: ਦੁਹੂੰ ਓਰਿ ਜਬੈ ਰਣ ਬੀਰ ਜੁਟੇ ॥੧੧੬॥
623.t: dhuhoo(n) or jabai ran beer juTe ||116||
623.e: Both the warriors showered trees and stones etc. from both the sides.116.

623.g: ਕੁਪ ਕੈ ਲਵ ਪਾਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਲਯੋ ॥
623.t: kup kai lav paan tirasool layo ||

623.e: Lavanasura held his trident in his hand in anger and chopped the head of Mandhata into two parts

623.g: ਨ ਉਚਾਇ ਸਕੈ ਸਿਰੁ ਐਸ ਲਜੀ ॥੧੧੭॥
623.t: n uchai sakai sir aais lajee ||117||
623.e: The army of Mandhata ran away, being grouped together and got so much ashmed that it could not carry the head of the king.117.

623.g: ਘਨ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਜੇ ਘਨ ਘਾਇਲ ਹੁਐ ॥
623.t: ghan jaise bhaje ghan ghail huaai ||

623.e: The army, getting wounded, flew away like clouds and the blood flowed as if it was raining

623.g: ਸਬ ਹੀ ਦਲ ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲਾ ਜੀਅ ਲੈ ॥੧੧੮॥
623.t: sab hee dhal bhaaj chalaa jeea lai ||118||
623.e: Abandoning the dead king in the battlefield, the whole army of the king saved itself by fleeing away.118.
Those who returned, their heads cracked, their hair were loosened and being wounded, the blood flowed form their heads

623.g: ਰਣਿ ਮਾਰ ਕੈ ਮਾਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸੂਲ ਲੀਏ ॥
623.t: ran maar kai maan tirasool le'ee ||

623.e: In this way, Lavanasura won the battle on the strength of his trident and caused the warriors of many kinds to run away.119.
End of the killing of Mandhata.
Now begins the description of the rule of Dileep
TOTAK STANZA
When Mandhata was killed in the war, then Dileep became the king of Delhi
CHAUPI

623.g: ਸਬ ਠੌਰ ਸਬੈ ਉਠਿ ਧਰਮ ਪਲੇ ॥੧੨੦॥
623.t: sab Thauar sabai uTh dharam pale ||120||
623.e: He destroyed the demons in various ways and propagated religion at all places.120.
When taking the trident of Shiva, Lavanasura killed the superb king mandhata, then the king Dileep came to the throne
He had various types of royal luxuries.121.
This king was a great warrior any Sovereign
It seemed that he had been shaped in a mould of gold, like the form of the god of love, this king was so beautiful, that he appeared to be the Sovereign of Beauty.122.
He performed various types of Yajnas and executed hom and bestowed charities according to Vedic injunctions
His banner of the extension of Dharma fluttered here and there and seeing his glory, the abode of Indra felt shy.123.

623.g: ਪਗ ਪਗ ਜਗਿ ਖੰਭ ਕਹੁ ਗਾਡਾ ॥
623.t: pag pag jag kha(n)bh kahu gaaddaa ||

623.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਅੰਨ ਸਾਲ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਡਾ ॥
623.t: ghar ghar a(n)n saal kar chhaaddaa ||
623.e: He got planted the columns of Yajnas at short distances
And caused the granaries of corn to be built in every home, the hungry or naked, whosoever came, his desire was fulfilled Immediately.124.

623.g: ਜੋ ਜਿਹੰ ਮੁਖ ਮਾਗਾ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਵਾ ॥
623.t: jo jiha(n) mukh maagaa teh paavaa ||

623.g: ਬਿਮੁਖ ਆਸ ਫਿਰਿ ਭਿਛਕ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥
623.t: bimukh aas fir bhichhak na aavaa ||
623.e: Whosoever asked for anything, he obtained it and no beggar returned without the fulfillment of his wish
The banner of Dharma flew on every home and seeing this the abode of Dharamraja also became unconscious.125.
No one remained ignorant and all children and old people studied intelligently

623.g: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਤ ਭਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
623.t: ghar ghar hot bhiee har sevaa ||

623.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਮਾਨਿ ਸਬੈ ਗੁਰ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧੨੬॥
623.t: jeh teh maan sabai gur dhevaa ||126||
623.e: There was the worship of the Lord in every home and the Lord was abored nad honoured everywhere.126.

623.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਰਾਜ ਦਿਲੀਪ ਬਡੋ ਕਰਿ ॥
623.t: eeh bidh raaj dhileep baddo kar ||

623.e: Such was the rule of king Dileep, who himself was great warrior and a great archer

624.e: He had complete knowledge of Kok Shastra nd Smrities and he was expert in fourteen sciences.127.
He was a great hero and superb intellectual, he was the store of fourteen sciences
He was extremely charming and enormously glorious, he was also very proud and alongwith it, he was greatly deatched from the world.128.
The king was expert in all Vedangs and six Shastras, he was the knower of the secret of Dhanurveda and also remained absorbed in the love of the Lord

624.g: ਅਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਤੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਲਿ ਮਲਿ ॥੧੨੯॥
624.t: ar anek jeete jin dhal mal ||129||
624.e: He had many qualities and was unlimited like the virtues and strength of the Lord, he had conquered man
He had conquered many kings of undivided territories and there was none like him
He was extremely powerful and glorious and was very modest in the presence of the saints.130.

624.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਚਲੀ ਰਾਜ ਕੀ ਨੀਤਾ ॥
624.t: jeh teh chalee raaj kee neetaa ||
624.e: He conquered many countries far and near and his rule was discussed everywhere

624.g: ਤਜਿ ਹਠ ਚਰਨਿ ਲਗੇ ਬਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੧੩੧॥
624.t: taj haTh charan lage badd raajaa ||131||
624.e: He assumed many types of canopies and many great kings fell at his feet leaving their persistence.131.

624.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਹੋਤ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਾ ॥
624.t: jeh teh hot dharam kee reetaa ||

624.e: The traditions of Dharma became prevalent in all directions and there was no misconduct anywhere
He became famous in bestowing charities like the king Varuna, Kuber, Ben, and Bali.132.
He ruled in various ways and his drum sounded upto the ocean

624.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਕਰਮ ਪਾਪ ਭਯੋ ਦੂਰਾ ॥
624.t: jeh teh karam paap bhayo dhooraa ||

624.e: The voice and fear were nowhere observed and all performed the religious actions in his presence.133.

624.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਪਾਪ ਛਪਾ ਸਬ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
624.t: jeh teh paap chhapaa sab dhesaa ||

624.e: All the countries became sinless and all the kings observed the religious injunctions
The discussion about the rule of Dileep extended upto the ocean.134.
End of the description of the rule of Dileep and his departure for heaven.

624.g: ਅਥ ਰਘੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਕੋ ਰਾਜ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
624.t: ath ragh raajaa ko raaj kathana(n) ||
624.e: Now begins the description of he rule of the king Raghu
CHAUPAI
The light of everyone merged in supreme light, and this activity continued in the world
The king Rahghu ruled over the world and wore new arms, weapons and canopies.135.
He performed several types of Yajnas and spread the religion in all the countires

624.g: ਝੂਠ ਬੈਨ ਕਿਹੂੰ ਭੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਖਾ ॥੧੩੬॥
624.t: jhooTh bain kihoo(n) bhool na bhaakhaa ||136||
624.e: He did not allow any sinner to stay with him and never uttered falsehood, even through oversight.136.
The nigh considered him as moon and the day as sun
The Vedas considered him as “Brahm” and the gods visualized him as Indra.137.
All the Brahmins saw in him the god Brihaspati and the demons as Shukracharya
The ailments looked at him as medicine and the Yogis visulised in him the supreme essence.138.
The children saw him as a child and the Yogis as the supreme Yogi
The donors saw in him the supreme Donor and the pleasure seeking persons considered him as a Supreme Yogi.139.
The Sannyasis considered him as Dattatreya and the Yogis as Guru Gorakhnath
The Bairagis considered him as Ramanand and the Muslims as Muhammad.140. (This is a period-error).
The gods considered him as Indra and the demons as Shmbh
The Yakshas and Kinnar thought of him as their king.141.
The lustful women considered him as the god of love and the diseases thought of him as the incarnation of Dhanvantri
The kings considered him as the Sovereign and the Yogis thought of him s the Supreme Yogi.142.
The Kshatriyas considered him the great canopied king and the wielders of arms and weapons thought of him as the great and powerful warrior
The night considered him as moon and the day as sun.143.
The saints thought of him as manifestation of peace and the fire thought of him as effulgence
The earth considered him as a mountain and the does as the king of deer.144.

625.e: He appeared to the kshatris as Soverign and to the Yogis as Supreme Yogi
The mountains considered him as Himalaya and the darkness thought of him as the effulgence of the sun.145.
The water thought of him as the sea and the cloud considered him as Indra
The Vedas considered him as Brahman and the Brahmins imagined him as the sage Vyas.146.
Lakshmi considered him as Vishnu and Indrani as Indra
The saints saw him s peace-personified and the enemies as the clash-personified.147.
The ailments saw him as medicine and the women as lust
The friends considered him as great friend and the Yogis as Supreme essence.148.
The peacocks thought of him as cloud and the Chakvi (Brahmani duck) as sun
The female partridge viewed him as moon and the shell as rain-drop.149.
The nightingale saw him as spring and the rain-bird as the rain-drop
The Sadhus (saints) viewed him s Siddh (an adept) and the kings as Sovereign.150.
The beggars saw him as the Donor and the enemies as KAL (death)
The Smritis considered him as the knowledge of Shastras and the saints as Truth.151.
The saints viewed him as the personification of good conduct and absorbed his kindness in their mind
The peacocks thought of him as cloud and the thieves as day dawn.152.
The women considered him s the incarnation of lust and the saints saw him s adept
The serpents considered him as Sheshnaga and the gods believed him to be ambrosia.153.
He seemed to be like jewel in the serpent and the creatures saw him as prana (life-force)
