They were kind-hearted people, wearing ochre-coloured clothes,
Purifying all the countries far and near were the destroyers of evil actions.423.
Seeing their radiance even the sun was wonder-struck
And someone out of them was repeating the Name of the Lord, and someone was singing the Praises of the Lord.424.
While remembering and repeating the Name of the Lord,
They were firmly establishing the Lord in their mind.425.
The horns were being sounded and there was the singing of Ragas (musical modes)
The Name of the Lord was being repeated, which had frightened the sins.426.
The moon was wondering and Indra, seeing their devotion, had been fearful
All the gods were looking at them.427.
The ghosts, fiends and ganas, seeing their beauty were wonder-struck
And all were thinking about them with sincerity.428.
The Yogi Dut saw there a parrot, who was released from bondage and immediately flew away.429.
As soon as the pious Dutt saw him, he flew away and made known to Dutt this secret that the action-prone man with ten senses and none doors was superior amongst beings.430.

670.e: He is the abode of wisdom, but falling in the attachment of his wife etc. he remains in illusion.431.
The individual entrapped in the key of wisdom and mildness, he is absorbed in pleasure and is removed far away from Dharma.432.
His wisdom seized by the attachment of mother, wife, sons and brothers.433.
Engrossed in lust, he is absorbed in attachments and burning in the fire of anger, he is occupied in the collection of wealth.434.
On getting an opportunity, he destroys the great warriors for his self-interest and in this way, he falls into hell.435.
If forsaking all, the Lord is adored with sincerity, and then all the sufferings and malice come to an end.436.
If the being relinquishes all like the abandonment of the cage by parrot, then all his actions can bear fruit and he achieves the position of superiority.437.

670.g: ਇਤਿ ਨਲਿਨੀ ਸੁਕ ਉਨੀਸਵੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਰਨਨੰ ॥੧੯॥
670.t: eit nalinee suk uneesavo guroo baranana(n) ||19||
670.e: End of the description of the adoption of the Parrot as the Nineteenth Guru.
Now begins the description of the adoption of a Trader as the Twentieth Guru
Then Dutt, the wearer of matted locks moved further
The musical instruments were being played seeing Dutt. The inanimate things were becoming animate and the animate were wonder-struck.438.

670.g: ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪ ਕਛੁ ਕਹਾ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
670.t: mahaa roop kachh kahaa na jaiee ||

670.e: His great beauty was indescribable, seeing which all the world was in astonishment

670.g: ਜਿਤ ਜਿਤ ਜਾਤ ਪਥਹਿ ਰਿਖਿ ਗ੍ਯੋ ॥
670.t: jit jit jaat patheh rikh gayo ||

670.e: The paths on which the sage went, it appeared that the cloud of love was raining.439.
There he saw a wealthy trader, was extremely comely and treasure of money and materials
He was supremely splendid and it appeared that Brahma himself had created him.440.

670.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਪਾਰ ਜਿਨ ਅਉਰ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
670.t: bin bipaar jin aaur na jaanaa ||
670.e: He was extremely conscious about his sale and it seemed that he did not know anything else except trade
Absorbed in desires his attention was solely engrossed in trade and he was looking like a great Yogi.441.
The sage reached there alongwith Sannyasis and innumerable disciples

671.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਜਾਇ ਦੁਆਰ ਪਰ ਬੈਠੇ ॥
671.t: taa ke jai dhuaar par baiThe ||

671.e: The great sage Dutt sat at the gate of that trader alongwith many other sages.442.

671.g: ਸਾਹ ਸੁ ਦਿਰਬ ਬ੍ਰਿਤ ਲਗ ਰਹਾ ॥
671.t: saeh su dhirab birat lag rahaa ||

671.g: ਰਿਖਨ ਓਰ ਤਿਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਯੋ ਨ ਕਹਾ ॥
671.t: rikhan or tin chitrayo na kahaa ||
671.e: The mind of the trader was so much absorbed in earning money that he did not pay attention to the sages even slightly
With closed eyes he was immersed in the expectation of money like a detached hermit.443.

671.g: ਤਹ ਜੇ ਹੁਤੇ ਰਾਵ ਅਰੁ ਰੰਕਾ ॥
671.t: teh je hute raav ar ra(n)kaa ||

671.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਪਗ ਪਰੇ ਛੋਰ ਕੈ ਸੰਕਾ ॥
671.t: mun pag pare chhor kai sa(n)kaa ||

671.e: All the kings and poor people who were there, leaving all their doubts fell dwon at the feet of the sages, but that trader was so much immersed in his work that he did not even raise his eyes and see towards the sages.444.

671.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕਹਾ ਤਜ ਕੈ ਹਠ ਭਾਊ ॥
671.t: pragaT kahaa taj kai haTh bhaauoo ||

671.e: Dutt looking at his position and impact, leaving his persistence, said openly, “If such a love is employed with the Lord, then that supreme Lord can be realized.”445.
End of the description of the adoption of a Trader as the Twentieth Guru.

671.g: ਅਥ ਸੁਕ ਪੜਾਵਤ ਨਰ ਇਕੀਸਵੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
671.t: ath suk paRaavat nar ikeesavo guroo kathana(n) ||
671.e: Now begins the description of the adoption of a parrot-instructor as the twenty-first Guru
CHAUPAI
Adopting twenty Gurus and learning all the arts of Yoga, the sage moved further
His glory, impact and radiance were infinite and it seemed that he had completed all the practices and was roaming, remembering the Name of the Lord.446.

671.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਮਾਨ ਜਗਿ ਭਯੋ ਨ ਹੂਆ ॥
671.t: jeh samaan jag bhayo na hooaa ||
671.e: There he saw a person seated with a parrot and for him there was none like it in the world

671.g: ਏਕ ਟਕ ਪਰਾ ਅਉਰ ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੪੪੭॥
671.t: ek Tak paraa aaur na jaanee ||447||
671.e: That person was teaching the parrot the art of speaking he was so much concentrated that he did not know anything else.447.

671.g: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਤੀਰ ਤੀਰ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ॥
671.t: taa ke teer teer chal ge ||

671.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਨਰ ਏ ਨਹੀ ਦੇਖਤ ਭਏ ॥੪੪੮॥
671.t: tin nar e nahee dhekhat bhe ||448||
671.e: Dutt, taking with him the sages and a large gathering of silence-observing hermits, passed just before him, but that person did not see anyone from them.448.

671.g: ਇਨੈ ਕਛੂ ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਾ ॥
671.t: einai kachhoo mukh te nahee kahaa ||
671.e: That person kept on instructing the parrot and did not talk anything with these persons
The absorption of that persons the love welled up in the mind of the sage.449.

671.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਪਰਮ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਹੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
671.t: tab hee param purakh kahu paavai ||
671.e: If such a love is applied towards the Lord, only then that Supreme Lord can be realized

671.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਮੋਲ ਜਨੁ ਲੀਆ ॥੪੫੦॥
671.t: man bach karam mol jan leeaa ||450||
671.e: Surrendering before him with mind, speech and action, the sage adopted him as his twenty-first Guru.450.

671.g: ਇਤਿ ਇਕੀਸਵੋਂ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਕ ਪੜਾਵਤ ਨਰ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨੧॥
671.t: eit ikeesavo(n) gur suk paRaavat nar samaapata(n) ||21||
671.e: End of the description of the adoption of a parrot-instructor as the Twenty-First Guru.

671.g: ਅਥਿ ਹਰ ਬਾਹਤ ਬਾਈਸਵੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
671.t: ath har baahat baieesavo guroo kathana(n) ||
671.e: Now begins the description of the adoption of Ploughman as the Twenty-Second Guru
CHAUPAI
When after adopting his twenty-first Guru, Dutt moved further, then he saw a ploughman

671.g: ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਹੀਏ ਜਿਹ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੪੫੧॥
671.t: pat kee aas he'ee jeh bhaaree ||451||
671.e: His wife was a great comfort-giving chaste woman.451.
Her husband had called her and she had come with food

671.g: ਹਰ ਬਾਹਤ ਤਿਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲਹਾ ॥
671.t: har baahat tin kachhoo na lahaa ||

671.g: ਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਥ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਰਹਾ ॥੪੫੨॥
671.t: treeaa ko dhiaan naath prat rahaa ||452||
671.e: That ploughman did not see anything else while ploughing and the attention of the wife was absorbed in her husbadd.452.

672.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਏ ਰਿਖ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
672.t: mun pat sa(n)g le rikh sainaa ||

672.g: ਮੁਖ ਛਬਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਲਜਤ ਜਿਹ ਮੈਨਾ ॥
672.t: mukh chhab dhekh lajat jeh mainaa ||
672.e: The king of sages was moving alongwith a large gathering of sages and seeing the beauty of his face, even the god of love was feeling shy

672.g: ਤੀਰ ਤੀਰ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ ॥
672.t: teer teer taa ke chal ge ||

672.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਪਤਿ ਬੈਠ ਰਹਤ ਪਛ ਭਏ ॥੪੫੩॥
672.t: mun pat baiTh rahat pachh bhe ||453||
672.e: The sages passed near him and the king of sages also sat there.453.

672.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
672.t: anoop naraaj chha(n)dh ||
672.e: ANOOP NARAAJ STANZA

672.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਗਾਤ ਅਤਿਭੁਤੰ ਬਿਭੂਤ ਸੋਭਤੰ ਤਨੰ ॥
672.t: anoop gaat atibhuta(n) bibhoot sobhata(n) tana(n) ||
672.e: The bodies of the sages were marvelous and their magnificence were unique

672.g: ਅਛਿਜ ਤੇਜ ਜਾਜੁਲੰ ਅਨੰਤ ਮੋਹਤੰ ਮਨੰ ॥
672.t: achhij tej jaajula(n) ana(n)t mohata(n) mana(n) ||
672.e: Their luster was indestructible and they allured the innumerable minds

672.g: ਸਸੋਭ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਰੰਗਤੰ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਗੇਰੂ ਅੰਬਰੰ ॥
672.t: sasobh basatr ra(n)gata(n) sura(n)g geroo a(n)bara(n) ||
672.e: Their clothes were beautifully dyed in ochre colour

672.g: ਬਿਲੋਕ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵੰ ਮਮੋਹ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੰ ਨਰੰ ॥੪੫੪॥
672.t: bilok dhev dhaanava(n) mamoh ga(n)dhraba(n) nara(n) ||454||
672.e: , Seeing which the gods and demons, men and Gnadharvas were all fascinated.454.

672.g: ਜਟਾ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਜਾਨਵੀ ਜਟੀ ਸਮਾਨ ਜਾਨਈ ॥
672.t: jaTaa bilok jaanavee jaTee samaan jaaniee ||
672.e: Seeing the matted locks of the sage, the Ganges was considering him as Shiva and

672.g: ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਲੋਕ ਲੋਕਿਣੰ ਅਲੋਕਿ ਰੂਪ ਮਾਨਈ ॥
672.t: bilok lok lokina(n) alok roop maaniee ||
672.e: The beings of all the worlds accepted him as one containing supernatural elegance

672.g: ਬਜੰਤ ਚਾਰ ਕਿੰਕੁਰੀ ਭਜੰਤ ਭੂਤ ਭੈਧਰੀ ॥
672.t: baja(n)t chaar ki(n)kuree bhaja(n)t bhoot bhaidharee ||
672.e: All the beings, in His fear, playing on the fiddle, were repeating His Name

672.g: ਪਪਾਤ ਜਛ ਕਿੰਨ੍ਰਨੀ ਮਮੋਹ ਮਾਨਨੀ ਮਨੰ ॥੪੫੫॥
672.t: papaat jachh ki(n)nranee mamoh maananee mana(n) ||455||
672.e: The Yaksha and Kinnar women were all getting allured.455.

672.g: ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਰਿ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਣੀ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਣੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥
672.t: bachitr naar chitranee pavitr chitrana(n) prabha(n) ||
672.e: The beautiful Chitarni (a kind of women) women, getting pleased on that poure Lord,

672.g: ਰ ਰੀਝ ਜਛ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੰ ਸੁਰਾਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥
672.t: r reejh jachh ga(n)dhraba(n) suraar naar su prabha(n) ||
672.e: The women of Yakshas, Gandharvas and gods, were remembering Him

672.g: ਕੜੰਤ ਕ੍ਰੂ ਕਿੰਨ੍ਰਣੀ ਹਸੰਤ ਹਾਸ ਕਾਮਿਣੀ ॥
672.t: kaRa(n)t kraoo ki(n)nranee hasa(n)t haas kaaminee ||

672.g: ਲਸੰਤ ਦੰਤਣੰ ਦੁਤੰ ਖਿਮੰਤ ਜਾਣੁ ਦਾਮਿਣੀ ॥੪੫੬॥
672.t: lasa(n)t dha(n)tana(n) dhuta(n) khima(n)t jaan dhaaminee ||456||
672.e: The evil Kinnar women were getting angry and other pretty ladies laughingly exhibited their teeth making the lightning shyful.456.

672.g: ਦਲੰਤ ਪਾਪ ਦੁਭਰੰ ਚਲੰਤ ਮੋਨਿ ਸਿੰਮਰੰ ॥
672.t: dhala(n)t paap dhubhara(n) chala(n)t mon si(n)mara(n) ||
672.e: Seeing him, the formidable sins were destroyed and the silent remembrance of the Lord was the natural outcome

672.g: ਸੁਭੰਤ ਭਾਰਗਵੰ ਪਟੰ ਬਿਅੰਤ ਤੇਜ ਉਫਣੰ ॥
672.t: subha(n)t bhaaragava(n) paTa(n) bia(n)t tej ufana(n) ||
672.e: On their bodies, their garments were keeping under control the rising radiance

672.g: ਪਰੰਤ ਪਾਨਿ ਭੂਚਰੰ ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਸਰਬਤੋ ਦਿਸੰ ॥
672.t: para(n)t paan bhoochara(n) bhrama(n)t sarabato dhisa(n) ||
672.e: The beings of all the directions, wandering and coming there, were falling at his feet

672.g: ਤਜੰਤ ਪਾਪ ਨਰ ਬਰੰ ਚਲੰਤ ਧਰਮਣੋ ਮਗੰ ॥੪੫੭॥
672.t: taja(n)t paap nar bara(n) chala(n)t dharamano maga(n) ||457||
672.e: All the beings forsaking their sins were following the path of Dharma on reaching there.457.

672.g: ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਬੀਰਣੋ ਦਯੰ ਅਰੁਝ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਮਣੰ ॥
672.t: bilok beerano dhaya(n) arujh chhatr karamana(n) ||
672.e: There he saw two kshatriya fighters absorbed in their actions of war

672.g: ਤਜੰਤਿ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸਿਤੰ ਕਟੰਤ ਟੂਕ ਬਰਮਣੰ ॥
672.t: taja(n)t saika(n) sita(n) kaTa(n)t Took baramana(n) ||
672.e: The warriors were abandoning their bows and cutting the armours seeing that fighting

672.g: ਥਥੰਭ ਭਾਨਣੋ ਰਥੰ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਕਉਤਕੰ ਰਣੰ ॥
672.t: thatha(n)bh bhaanano ratha(n) bilok kautaka(n) rana(n) ||

672.g: ਗਿਰੰਤ ਜੁਧਣੋ ਛਿਤੰ ਬਮੰਤ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤੰ ਮੁਖੰ ॥੪੫੮॥
672.t: gira(n)t judhano chhita(n) bama(n)t sronata(n) mukha(n) ||458||
672.e: The chariot of the sun stopped there and there the fighters falling on the earth, were throwing out blood from their mouths.458.

672.g: ਫਿਰੰਤ ਚਕ੍ਰਣੋ ਚਕੰ ਗਿਰੰਤ ਜੋਧਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
672.t: fira(n)t chakrano chaka(n) gira(n)t jodhano rana(n) ||
672.e: The discs were being discharged and the fighters were falling

672.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ ਠਠੁਕਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਿਤੰ ਭੁਜੰ ॥
672.t: auTha(n)t krodh kai haThee ThaThuk krudhita(n) bhuja(n) ||
672.e: The persistent warriors were again rising in anger

672.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਅਧ ਬਧਤੰ ਕਮਧ ਬਧਤੰ ਕਟੰ ॥
672.t: bhrama(n)t adh badhata(n) kamadh badhata(n) kaTa(n) ||

672.g: ਪਰੰਤ ਭੂਤਲੰ ਭਟੰ ਬਕੰਤ ਮਾਰੂੜੈ ਰਟੰ ॥੪੫੯॥
672.t: para(n)t bhootala(n) bhaTa(n) baka(n)t maarooRai raTa(n) ||459||
672.e: Having been cut into half in the form of headless trunks were wandering and those falling on the earth were shouting “kill, kill”.459.

672.g: ਪਿਪੰਤ ਅਸਵ ਭਟੰਤ ਭਿਰੰਤ ਦਾਰੁਣੋ ਰਣੰ ॥
672.t: pipa(n)t asav bhaTa(n)t bhira(n)t dhaaruno rana(n) ||
672.e: The horses of the warriors were fighting in that dreadful war

672.g: ਬਹੰਤ ਤੀਛਣੋ ਸਰੰ ਝਲੰਤ ਝਾਲ ਖੜਿਗਿਣੰ ॥
672.t: baha(n)t teechhano sara(n) jhala(n)t jhaal khaRigina(n) ||
672.e: The sharp arrows were being seen

672.g: ਉਠੰਤ ਮਾਰੂੜੋ ਰਣੰ ਬਕੰਤ ਮਾਰਣੋ ਮੁਖੰ ॥
672.t: auTha(n)t maarooRo rana(n) baka(n)t maarano mukha(n) ||
672.e: The fighters were rising with the shouts of “kill, kill”

672.g: ਚਲੰਤ ਭਾਜਿ ਨ ਹਠੀ ਜੁਝੰਤ ਦੁਧਰੰ ਰਣੰ ॥੪੬੦॥
672.t: chala(n)t bhaaj na haThee jujha(n)t dhudhara(n) rana(n) ||460||
672.e: And they were not running away from that battlefield with persistence.460.

672.g: ਕਟੰਤ ਕਾਰਮੰ ਸੁਭੰ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਚਿਤ੍ਰਤੰ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ॥
672.t: kaTa(n)t kaarama(n) subha(n) bachitr chitrata(n) kirata(n) ||

672.g: ਸਿਲੇਣਿ ਉਜਲੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੰ ਬਹੰਤ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸੁਭੰ ॥
672.t: silen ujalee kirata(n) baha(n)t saika(n) subha(n) ||
672.e: All were cutting one another in a strange way and the white arrows like the slab were flowing (like a stream)

672.g: ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਮੋਨਿਸੰ ਜੁਧੰ ਚਚਉਧ ਚਕ੍ਰਤੰ ਭਵੰ ॥
672.t: bilok monisa(n) judha(n) chachaudh chakrata(n) bhava(n) ||

672.g: ਮਮੋਹ ਆਸ੍ਰਮੰ ਗਤੰ ਪਪਾਤ ਭੂਤਲੀ ਸਿਰੰ ॥੪੬੧॥
672.t: mamoh aasrama(n) gata(n) papaat bhootalee sira(n) ||461||
672.e: Seeing that war the whole world was dazzled and wonder-struck and moving towards that hermitage, it was falling down upon the earth under the impact of attachment.461.

672.g: ਸਭਾਰ ਭਾਰਗ ਬਸਨਿਨੰ ਜਜਪਿ ਜਾਪਣੋ ਰਿਖੰ ॥
672.t: sabhaar bhaarag basanina(n) jajap jaapano rikha(n) ||

672.g: ਨਿਹਾਰਿ ਪਾਨ ਪੈ ਪਰਾ ਬਿਚਾਰ ਬਾਇਸਵੋ ਗੁਰੰ ॥
672.t: nihaar paan pai paraa bichaar baisavo gura(n) ||
672.e: That woman, carrying her utensils on her head, was moving remembering her husband like a sage and the sag seeing her and falling at her feet adopted her as the twenty-second Guru

672.g: ਬਿਅੰਤ ਜੋਗਣੋ ਸਧੰ ਅਸੰਖ ਪਾਪਣੋ ਦਲੰ ॥
672.t: bia(n)t jogano sadha(n) asa(n)kh paapano dhala(n) ||

672.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਚੇਲਕਾ ਲਏ ਰਿਖੇਸ ਆਸਨੰ ਚਲੰ ॥੪੬੨॥
672.t: anek chelakaa le rikhes aasana(n) chala(n) ||462||
672.e: That great sage, who had performed innumerable Yogic practices and destroying many sins, moved towards his abode.462.

672.g: ਇਤਿ ਹਰ ਬਾਹਤਾ ਬਾਈਸਵੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਭਾਤ ਲੈ ਆਈ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨੨॥
672.t: eit har baahataa baieesavo guroo isatree bhaat lai aaiee samaapata(n) ||22||
672.e: End of the description of the adoption of the Ploughman as the Twenty-second Guru, and his wife bringing the food.

672.g: ਅਥ ਤ੍ਰਿਆ ਜਛਣੀ ਤੇਈਸਮੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
672.t: ath triaa jachhanee teieesamo guroo kathana(n) ||
672.e: Now begins the description of adopting a Yaksha woman as the twenty-third Guru

672.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
672.t: anoop naraaj chha(n)dh ||
672.e: ANOOP NARAAJ STANZA

672.g: ਬਜੰਤ ਨਾਦ ਦੁਧਰੰ ਉਠੰਤ ਨਿਸਨੰ ਸੁਰੰ ॥
672.t: baja(n)t naadh dhudhara(n) uTha(n)t nisana(n) sura(n) ||

672.g: ਭਜੰਤ ਅਰਿ ਦਿਤੰ ਅਘੰ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਭਾਰਗਵੰ ਭਿਸੰ ॥
672.t: bhaja(n)t ar dhita(n) agha(n) bilok bhaaragava(n) bhisa(n) ||
672.e: The trumpets sounded and there was thundering voice seeing the ochre-coloured garb the sins were destroyed

672.g: ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਕੰਚਨੰ ਗਿਰੰਤ ਤਜ ਮਾਨੁਖੀ ਭੁਅੰ ॥
672.t: bilok ka(n)chana(n) gira(n)t taj maanukhee bhua(n) ||

672.g: ਸ ਸੁਹਕ ਤਾਪਸੀ ਤਨੰ ਅਲੋਕ ਲੋਕਣੋ ਬਪੰ ॥੪੬੩॥
672.t: s suhak taapasee tana(n) alok lokano bapa(n) ||463||
672.e: The gold was seen being showered on the earth inhabitated by human beings and the bodies of the ascetic were supernatural glory.463.

672.g: ਅਨੇਕ ਜਛ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬੰ ਬਸੇਖ ਬਿਧਿਕਾ ਧਰੀ ॥
672.t: anek jachh ga(n)dhraba(n) basekh bidhikaa dharee ||

672.g: ਨਿਰਕਤ ਨਾਗਣੀ ਮਹਾ ਬਸੇਖ ਬਾਸਵੀ ਸੁਰੀ ॥
672.t: nirakat naaganee mahaa basekh baasavee suree ||
672.e: Many Yaksha, Gandharava, Naga and god’s women were dancing

672.g: ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਬਤੀ ਅਨੂਪ ਆਲਕਾਪਤੀ ॥
672.t: pavitr param paarabatee anoop aalakaapatee ||

672.g: ਅਸਕਤ ਆਪਿਤੰ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਸੇਖ ਆਸੁਰੀ ਸੁਰੀ ॥੪੬੪॥
672.t: asakat aapita(n) mahaa bisekh aasuree suree ||464||
672.e: There was Parvati and the wife of the unique Kuber there were seated the women off gods and demons.464.

672.g: ਅਨੂਪ ਏਕ ਜਛਣੀ ਮਮੋਹ ਰਾਗਣੋ ਮਨੰ ॥
672.t: anoop ek jachhanee mamoh raagano mana(n) ||

672.g: ਘੁਮੰਤ ਘੂਮਣੰ ਛਿਤੰ ਲਗੰਤ ਸਾਰੰਗੋ ਸਰੰ ॥
672.t: ghuma(n)t ghoomana(n) chhita(n) laga(n)t saara(n)go sara(n) ||
672.e: There was there a unique Yakssha woman, who was revolving in a circle as if she was struck by an arrow

672.g: ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਨੇਹ ਗੇਹਣੰ ਸਨੇਹ ਰਾਗਣੋ ਮਨੰ ॥
672.t: bisaar neh gehana(n) saneh raagano mana(n) ||

672.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗੀਸ ਜਾਣੁ ਘੁਮਤੰ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੇਣ ਕ੍ਰਿਸ ਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ ਸਰੰ ॥੪੬੫॥
672.t: miragees jaan ghumata(n) kiraten kiras kiratee sara(n) ||465||
672.e: Abandoning all kinds of desires, her mind was absorbed only in music she was moving agitated like a deer.465.

672.g: ਰਝੀਝ ਰਾਗਣੋ ਚਿਤੰ ਬਦੰਤ ਰਾਗ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਭੰ ॥
672.t: rajheejh raagano chita(n) badha(n)t raag suprabha(n) ||

672.g: ਬਜੰਤ ਕਿੰਗੁਰੀ ਕਰੰ ਮਮੋਹ ਆਸ੍ਰਮੰ ਗਤੰ ॥
672.t: baja(n)t ki(n)guree kara(n) mamoh aasrama(n) gata(n) ||
672.e: She was absorbed in singing in various male and female musical modes and playing on her fiddle, she went lovingly towards the hermitage

672.g: ਸਸਜਿ ਸਾਇਕੰ ਸਿਤੰ ਕਪੰਤ ਕਾਮਣੋ ਕਲੰ ॥
672.t: sasaj saika(n) sita(n) kapa(n)t kaamano kala(n) ||

672.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੰਤ ਭੂਤਲੰ ਭਲੰ ਭੁਗੰਤ ਭਾਮਿਣੀ ਦਲੰ ॥੪੬੬॥
672.t: bhrama(n)t bhootala(n) bhala(n) bhuga(n)t bhaaminee dhala(n) ||466||
672.e: That beautiful damsel was decorated with the arrows of her art and the group of those beautiful women was enjoying the earthly existence.466.

672.g: ਤੋਮਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
672.t: tomar chha(n)dh ||
672.e: TOMAR STANZA

672.g: ਗੁਨਵੰਤ ਸੀਲ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
672.t: gunava(n)t seel apaar ||

672.g: ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਚਾਰ ਉਦਾਰ ॥
672.t: dhas chaar chaar udhaar ||
672.e: She was virtuous very gentle and knower of eighteen sciences,

672.g: ਰਸ ਰਾਗ ਸਰਬ ਸਪੰਨਿ ॥
672.t: ras raag sarab sapa(n)n ||

672.g: ਧਰਣੀ ਤਲਾ ਮਹਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੪੬੭॥
672.t: dharanee talaa meh dha(n)n ||467||
672.e: Well versed in music and full of essence, She was fortunate enough on earth.467.

672.g: ਇਕ ਰਾਗ ਗਾਵਤ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
672.t: eik raag gaavat naar ||

672.g: ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਸੀਲ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
672.t: gunava(n)t seel apaar ||
672.e: A woman, gentle and virtuous, was singing a musical mode

672.g: ਸੁਖ ਧਾਮ ਲੋਚਨ ਚਾਰੁ ॥
672.t: sukh dhaam lochan chaar ||

673.e: She was the abode of happiness and her eyes were charming she was thoughtfully singing her musical modes.468.
She was pretty, gentle and generous
That lady, the treasure of music, to whichever direction she viewed, she allured everyone.469.
That blemishless and honourable lady was an ocean of happiness
She was singing with full concentration of mind and the auspicious songs seemed to be springing out from her very interior.470.
Seeing her, the king of Yogis gathered all his Yogis and
All of them were pleased to see that pure Yogin.471.
The king of Yogis thought that if in this way, detaching oneself from all other sides,
The mind is concentrated on the Lord, then the Lord can be realized without any apprehension.472.
The enthusiastic sage, accepted her as his Guru, fell at her feet
Getting absorbed in her love, the king of the sages, adopted her as his Twenty-Third Guru.473.

673.g: ਇਤਿ ਜਛਣੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਰਾਗ ਗਾਵਤੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੇਈਸਵੋ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥੨੩॥
673.t: eit jachhanee naar raag gaavatee guroo teieesavo samaapata(n) ||23||
673.e: End of the description of the adoption of a Yaksha woman-singer as the twenty-Third Guru.
(Now begins the description of the adoption of the Twenty-fourth Guru [carnation])
TOMAR STANZA
Then ascending the Sumeru mountain the sage performed great austerities for many years and felt pleased as the essence-finder.474.
Seeing the practice of the world, the sage thought as to who is He, who creates the world and then merges it within Himself?475.
When He is recognized through the knowledge, then the adoration will be complete
If He is comprehended through the medium off Yoga, only then the body (and the mind) will be completely healthy.476.
Then the supreme essence will be known (when it will be realized) that He is also the destroyer of the world
That master of the world is real and Lord is supremely absorbed and He is also beyond all forms.477.
There will be no peace without that one Lord  the bath at all the pilgrim-stations will be fruitless
When service will be rendered to him and His Name will be remembered, then all the desires will be fulfilled.478.
Without that One Lord, all the twenty-four incarnation and all others are meaningless
He, who recognizes the One Lord, he will remain jubilant even on adoring all the twenty-four incarnations.479.
He, who falls in love with the One Lord, he will feel happy in knowing about the wonderful works of all the twenty-four incarnations
He, who does not recognize the One Lord, he cannot know the mysteries of the twenty-four incarnations.480.

674.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਚਉਬਿਸੈ ਫਲ ਹੀਨ ॥
674.t: tin chaubisai fal heen ||
674.e: He, who not recognized the One Lord, the twenty-four are fruitless for him

674.g: ਜਿਨ ਏਕ ਕੋ ਪਹਿਚਾਨ ॥
674.t: jin ek ko pahichaan ||

674.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਚਉਬਿਸੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਨ ॥੪੮੧॥
674.t: tin chaubisai ras maan ||481||
674.e: He, who feels the presence of One and recognizes him, he can feel the happiness of the twenty-four.481.

674.g: ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਦ ਛੰਦ ॥
674.t: bachitr padh chha(n)dh ||
674.e: VICHITRA PAD STANZA

674.g: ਏਕਹਿ ਜਉ ਮਨਿ ਆਨਾ ॥
674.t: ekeh jau man aanaa ||

674.g: ਦੂਸਰ ਭਾਵ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥
674.t: dhoosar bhaav na jaanaa ||

674.g: ਦੁੰਦਭਿ ਦਉਰ ਬਜਾਏ ॥
674.t: dhu(n)dhabh dhaur bajaae ||

674.g: ਫੂਲ ਸੁਰਨ ਬਰਖਾਏ ॥੪੮੨॥
674.t: fool suran barakhaae ||482||
674.e: The sage absorbed his mind in the One Lord and did not allow any other idea to enter his mind, then the gods showered flowers, beating their drums.482.

674.g: ਹਰਖੇ ਸਬ ਜਟ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
674.t: harakhe sab jaT dhaaree ||

674.g: ਗਾਵਤ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
674.t: gaavat dhe dhe taaree ||
674.e: The sages, getting delighted, clapped their hands and began to sing

674.g: ਜਿਤ ਤਿਤ ਡੋਲਤ ਫੂਲੇ ॥
674.t: jit tit ddolat foole ||

674.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਕੇ ਸਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੂਲੇ ॥੪੮੩॥
674.t: gireh ke sab dhukh bhoole ||483||
674.e: They forgot their domestic worries and moved here and there happily.483.

674.g: ਤਾਰਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
674.t: taarak chha(n)dh ||
674.e: TAARAK STANZA

674.g: ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖ ਜਬੈ ਤਪਸਾ ਤਿਹ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
674.t: bahu barakh jabai tapasaa teh keenee ||

674.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਜੁ ਕਹੀ ਧਰ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
674.t: gurdhev kriaa ju kahee dhar leenee ||
674.e: In this way, when the sages performed austerities for many years and did all according to the bidding of their Guru

674.g: ਤਬ ਨਾਥ ਸਨਾਥ ਹੁਐ ਬ੍ਯੋਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
674.t: tab naath sanaath huaai bayot bataiee ||

674.g: ਤਬ ਹੀ ਦਸਓ ਦਿਸਿ ਸੂਝ ਬਨਾਈ ॥੪੮੪॥
674.t: tab hee dhaso dhis soojh banaiee ||484||
674.e: The great sage told them many methods and in this way, they obtained the wisdom of knowledge of all the ten directions.484.

674.g: ਦਿਜ ਦੇਵ ਤਬੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਉਬਿਸ ਕੈ ਕੈ ॥
674.t: dhij dhev tabai gur chaubis kai kai ||

674.g: ਗਿਰਿ ਮੇਰ ਗਏ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮੁਨਿ ਲੈ ਕੈ ॥
674.t: gir mer ge sabh hee mun lai kai ||
674.e: In this way, the sage adopting twenty-four Gurus, went on the Sumeru mountain alongwith other sages

674.g: ਤਪਸਾ ਜਬ ਘੋਰ ਤਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
674.t: tapasaa jab ghor tahaa tin keenee ||

674.g: ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ਤਬੈ ਤਿਹ ਯਾ ਸਿਖ ਦੀਨੀ ॥੪੮੫॥
674.t: gurdhev tabai teh yaa sikh dheenee ||485||
674.e: There he performed severe austerities and then the Guru Dutt, gave these instructions to all of them.485.

674.g: ਤੋਟਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
674.t: toTak chha(n)dh ||
674.e: TOTAK STANZA

674.g: ਗਿਰਿ ਮੇਰੁ ਗਏ ਰਿਖਿ ਬਾਲਕ ਲੈ ॥
674.t: gir mer ge rikh baalak lai ||

674.g: ਧਰ ਸੀਸ ਜਟਾ ਭਗਵੇ ਪਟ ਕੈ ॥
674.t: dhar sees jaTaa bhagave paT kai ||
674.e: The sage having matted locks on his head and wearing ochre-coloured clothed on his body, went on the Sumeru mountain alongwith his disciples

674.g: ਤਪ ਘੋਰ ਕਰਾ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਖ ਦਿਨਾ ॥
674.t: tap ghor karaa bahu barakh dhinaa ||

674.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਾਪ ਨ ਛੋਰਸ ਏਕ ਛਿਨਾ ॥੪੮੬॥
674.t: har jaap na chhoras ek chhinaa ||486||
674.e: There he performed austerities in various for many years and did not forget the Lord even for an instant.486.

674.g: ਦਸ ਲਛ ਸੁ ਬੀਸ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਬ੍ਰਖੰ ॥
674.t: dhas lachh su bees saha(n)sr brakha(n) ||

674.g: ਤਪ ਕੀਨ ਤਹਾ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਰਿਖੰ ॥
674.t: tap keen tahaa bahu bhaat rikha(n) ||
674.e: There the sages performed austerities in various ways for ten lakh twenty thousand years

674.g: ਸਬ ਦੇਸਨ ਦੇਸ ਚਲਾਇ ਮਤੰ ॥
674.t: sab dhesan dhes chalai mata(n) ||

674.g: ਮੁਨਿ ਦੇਵ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਗੂੜ ਗਤੰ ॥੪੮੭॥
674.t: mun dhev mahaa mat gooR gata(n) ||487||
674.e: Then they propagated the secret doctrines of that great sage in all the countries far and near.487.

674.g: ਰਿਖਿ ਰਾਜ ਦਸਾ ਜਬ ਅੰਤ ਭਈ ॥
674.t: rikh raaj dhasaa jab a(n)t bhiee ||

674.g: ਬਲ ਜੋਗ ਹੁਤੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਾਨ ਲਈ ॥
674.t: bal jog hute mun jaan liee ||
674.e: When the final hour of that great sage arrived, the great sage came to know of it with the strength of Yoga

674.g: ਧੂਅਰੋ ਜਗ ਧਉਲੁਰ ਜਾਨਿ ਜਟੀ ॥
674.t: dhooaro jag dhaulur jaan jaTee ||

674.g: ਕਛੁ ਅਉਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਆ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਠਟੀ ॥੪੮੮॥
674.t: kachh aaur kriaa ieh bhaat ThaTee ||488||
674.e: Then that sage with matted locks, considering this world like a cloud of smoke, formulated a plan of another activity.488.

674.g: ਸਧਿ ਕੈ ਪਵਨੈ ਰਿਖ ਜੋਗ ਬਲੰ ॥
674.t: sadh kai pavanai rikh jog bala(n) ||

674.g: ਤਜਿ ਚਾਲ ਕਲੇਵਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਤਲੰ ॥
674.t: taj chaal kalevar bhoom tala(n) ||
674.e: Controlling the wind with the strength of Yoga, relinquishing his body left the earth

674.g: ਕਲ ਫੋਰਿ ਉਤਾਲ ਕਪਾਲ ਕਲੀ ॥
674.t: kal for utaal kapaal kalee ||

674.g: ਤਿਹ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਜੋਤਿਹ ਮਧ ਮਿਲੀ ॥੪੮੯॥
674.t: teh jot su joteh madh milee ||489||
674.e: Breaking the skull, his light of the soul merged in the supreme light of the Lord.489.

674.g: ਕਲ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਵਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ਲਸੈ ॥
674.t: kal kaal kravaal karaal lasai ||

674.g: ਜਗ ਜੰਗਮ ਥਾਵਰ ਸਰਬ ਕਸੈ ॥
674.t: jag ja(n)gam thaavar sarab kasai ||
674.e: The KAL (death) streches his dreadful sword always o all categories of beings

674.g: ਜਗ ਕਾਲਹਿ ਜਾਲ ਬਿਸਾਲ ਰਚਾ ॥
674.t: jag kaaleh jaal bisaal rachaa ||

674.g: ਜਿਹ ਬੀਚ ਫਸੇ ਬਿਨ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਚਾ ॥੪੯੦॥
674.t: jeh beech fase bin ko na bachaa ||490||
674.e: It has created the large net of this world, from which none had been able to escape.490.

674.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ॥
674.t: savaiyaa ||
674.e: SWAYYA

674.g: ਦੇਸ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਨਰੇਸਨ ਜੀਤਿ ਅਨੇਸ ਬਡੇ ਅਵਨੇਸ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
674.t: dhes bidhes naresan jeet anes badde avanes sa(n)ghaare ||

674.g: ਆਠੋ ਈ ਸਿਧ ਸਬੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਮ੍ਰਿਧਨ ਸਰਬ ਭਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਸਾਰੇ ॥
674.t: aaTho iee sidh sabai nav nidh samiradhan sarab bhare gireh saare ||
674.e: This KAL (death) has killed the great sovereigns of all the countries and the earth, who had eight powers, nine treasures, all kinds of accomplishments

674.g: ਚੰਦ੍ਰਮੁਖੀ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਲ ਭਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਸੰਭਾਰੇ ॥
674.t: cha(n)dhramukhee banitaa bahutai ghar maal bhare nahee jaat sa(n)bhaare ||
674.e: Moon-faced women and unlimited wealth

674.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਭਏ ਜਮ ਅੰਤਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਗੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਸਿਧਾਰੇ ॥੪੯੧॥
674.t: naam biheen adheen bhe jam a(n)t ko naage hee pai sidhaare ||491||
674.e: They all left this world with naked feet under the control of Yama, without the remembrance of the Name of the Lord.491.

674.g: ਰਾਵਨ ਕੇ ਮਹਿਰਾਵਨ ਕੇ ਮਨੁ ਕੇ ਨਲ ਕੇ ਚਲਤੇ ਨ ਚਲੀ ਗਉ ॥
674.t: raavan ke mahiraavan ke man ke nal ke chalate na chalee gau ||
674.e: Even Ravan and Mehravan were helpless before him

675.g: ਭੋਜ ਦਿਲੀਪਤਿ ਕੌਰਵਿ ਕੈ ਨਹੀ ਸਾਥ ਦਯੋ ਰਘੁਨਾਥ ਬਲੀ ਕਉ ॥
675.t: bhoj dhileepat kauarav kai nahee saath dhayo raghunaath balee kau ||
675.e: He did not even co-operate with king Bhoj, the Delhi kings of Surya clan, the mighty Raghunath etc.

675.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਅਬ ਲੌ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਕੇ ਸਾਚ ਕਹੌ ਅਘ ਓਘ ਦਲੀ ਸਉ ॥
675.t: sa(n)g chalee ab lau nahee kaahoo(n) ke saach kahau agh ogh dhalee sau ||
675.e: He did not even side with the destroyer of the store of sins

675.g: ਚੇਤ ਰੇ ਚੇਤ ਅਚੇਤ ਮਹਾ ਪਸੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਚਲੀ ਨ ਹਲੀ ਹਉ ॥੪੯੨॥
675.t: chet re chet achet mahaa pas kaahoo ke sa(n)g chalee na halee hau ||492||
675.e: Therefore O great animal-like unconscious mind! come into your senses, but consider that the KAL (death) did not consider anyone its own.492.

675.g: ਸਾਚ ਔਰ ਝੂਠ ਕਹੇ ਬਹੁਤੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
675.t: saach aauar jhooTh kahe bahutai bidh kaam karodh anek kamaae ||
675.e: The being, in many ways, speaking both truth and falsehood, absorbed himself in lust and anger

675.g: ਭਾਜ ਨਿਲਾਜ ਬਚਾ ਧਨ ਕੇ ਡਰ ਲੋਕ ਗਯੋ ਪਰਲੋਕ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
675.t: bhaaj nilaaj bachaa dhan ke ddar lok gayo paralok gavaae ||
675.e: For earning and gathering wealth unashamedly lost both theis and the next world

675.g: ਦੁਆਦਸ ਬਰਖ ਪੜਾ ਨ ਗੁੜਿਓ ਜੜ ਰਾਜੀਵਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
675.t: dhuaadhas barakh paRaa na guRio jaR raajeev lochan naahin paae ||
675.e: Though he obtained education for twelve-years, but did not follow its sayings and lotus-eyed (Rajiv-lochan) could not realise that Lord

675.g: ਲਾਜ ਬਿਹੀਨ ਅਧੀਨ ਗਹੇ ਜਮ ਅੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਾਗੇ ਹੀ ਪਾਇ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥੪੯੩॥
675.t: laaj biheen adheen gahe jam a(n)t ke naage hee pai sidhaae ||493||
675.e: The unashamed being will ultimately be caught by Yama and it will have to go with naked feet from this place.493.

675.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਧਰੋ ਭਗਵੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਤੇ ਸਬ ਪਾਵਕ ਬੀਚ ਜਲੈਗੀ ॥
675.t: kaahe kau basatr dharo bhagave mun te sab paavak beech jalaigee ||
675.e: O sages! why do you wear ochre-coloured clothes?, they will all be burnt in the fire at the end.

675.g: ਕਿਯੋਂ ਇਮ ਰੀਤ ਚਲਾਵਤ ਹੋ ਦਿਨ ਦ੍ਵੈਕ ਚਲੈ ਸ੍ਰਬਦਾ ਨ ਚਲੈਗੀ ॥
675.t: kiyo(n) im reet chalaavat ho dhin dhavaik chalai srabadhaa na chalaigee ||
675.e: Why do you introduce such-like rites, which will not continue for ever?

675.g: ਕਾਲ ਕਰਾਲ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਇਹ ਕਾਹੂੰ ਜੁਗੇਸਿ ਛਲੀ ਨ ਛਲੈਗੀ ॥
675.t: kaal karaal kee reet mahaa ieh kaahoo(n) juges chhalee na chhalaigee ||
675.e: Now one will be able to deceive the great tradition of the dreadful KAL

675.g: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਮਹਾ ਮੁਨਿ ਅੰਤ ਮਸਾਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਧੂਰਿ ਰਲੈਗੀ ॥੪੯੪॥
675.t: su(n)dhar dheh tumaaree mahaa mun a(n)t masaan havai dhoor ralaigee ||494||
675.e: O sage! your beautiful body will ultimately be mixed with dust.494.

675.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਪਉਨ ਭਛੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਹੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਪਉਨ ਭਛੇ ਕਛੂ ਹਾਥਿ ਨ ਐ ਹੈ ॥
675.t: kaahe ko paun bhachho sun ho mun paun bhachhe kachhoo haath na aai hai ||
675.e: O sage! why are you only subsisting on wind ? You will not achieve anything by doing this

675.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਬਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੋ ਭਗਵਾ ਇਨ ਬਾਤਨ ਸੋ ਭਗਵਾਨ ਨ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਹੈ ॥
675.t: kaahe ko basatr karo bhagavaa in baatan so bhagavaan na havai hai ||
675.e: You cannot even attain that supreme Lord by wearing the ochre-coloured clothes

675.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਕੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਤੇ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਬਸ ਕਾਲ ਸਬੈ ਹੈ ॥
675.t: bedh puraan pramaan ke dhekhahu te sab hee bas kaal sabai hai ||
675.e: Look at the illustrations of all the Vedas, Pranas etc., then you will know that all are under the control of KAL

675.g: ਜਾਰਿ ਅਨੰਗ ਨ ਨੰਗ ਕਹਾਵਤ ਸੀਸ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਟਾਊ ਨ ਜੈ ਹੈ ॥੪੯੫॥
675.t: jaar ana(n)g na na(n)g kahaavat sees kee sa(n)g jaTaauoo na jai hai ||495||
675.e: You can be called ANANG (limbless) by burning your lust, but even your matted locks will not accompany your head and all this will be destroyed over here.495.

675.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕੂਟ ਗਿਰ੍ਯੋ ਕਹੋ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਸਾਤਓ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਿਯੋਂ ਨ ਸੁਕਾਨੋ ॥
675.t: ka(n)chan kooT girayo kaho kaahe na saato saagar kiyo(n) na sukaano ||
675.e: Undoubtedly, the citadels of gold be reduced to dust, all the seven oceans be dried up,

675.g: ਪਸਚਮ ਭਾਨੁ ਉਦ੍ਰਯੋ ਕਹੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਗੰਗ ਬਹੀ ਉਲਟੀ ਅਨੁਮਾਨੋ ॥
675.t: pasacham bhaan udhrayo kahu kaahe na ga(n)g bahee ulaTee anumaano ||
675.e: The sun may rise in the west, the Ganges may flow in the opposite direction,

675.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਤਪ੍ਯੋ ਰਵਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨ ਚੰਦ ਸਮਾਨ ਦਿਨੀਸ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੋ ॥
675.t: a(n)t basa(n)t tapayo rav kaahe na cha(n)dh samaan dhinees pramaano ||
675.e: The sun may heat in the spring season, the sun may become cold like the moon, the earth supported by the tortoise may shake,

675.g: ਕਿਯੋਂ ਡਮਡੋਲ ਡੁਬੀ ਨ ਧਰਾ ਮੁਨਿ ਰਾਜ ਨਿਪਾਤਨਿ ਤਿਯੋਂ ਜਗ ਜਾਨੋ ॥੪੯੬॥
675.t: kiyo(n) ddamaddol ddubee na dharaa mun raaj nipaatan tiyo(n) jag jaano ||496||
675.e: But even then, O king of the sages! the destruction of the world is certain by KAL.496.

675.g: ਅਤ੍ਰਿ ਪਰਾਸਰ ਨਾਰਦ ਸਾਰਦ ਬ੍ਯਾਸ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਜਿਤੇ ਮੁਨ ਭਾਏ ॥
675.t: atr paraasar naaradh saaradh bayaas te aadh jite mun bhaae ||
675.e: There have been many sages like Atri, Parashar, Narada, Sharda, Vyas etc.,

675.g: ਗਾਲਵ ਆਦਿ ਅਨੰਤ ਮੁਨੀਸ੍ਵਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤ ਗਨਾਏ ॥
675.t: gaalav aadh ana(n)t muneesavair braham hoo(n) te nahee jaat ganaae ||
675.e: Who cannot be counted even by Brahma

675.g: ਅਗਸਤ ਪੁਲਸਤ ਬਸਿਸਟ ਤੇ ਆਦਿ ਨ ਜਾਨ ਪਰੇ ਕਿਹ ਦੇਸ ਸਿਧਾਏ ॥
675.t: agasat pulasat basisaT te aadh na jaan pare keh dhes sidhaae ||
675.e: There had been many sages like Agastya, Pulastya, Vashistha etc., but it could not be known to which directions they have gone

675.g: ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਾਇ ਬਨਾਇ ਮਹਾ ਮਤਿ ਫੇਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਰ ਫੇਰ ਨ ਆਏ ॥੪੯੭॥
675.t: ma(n)tr chalai banai mahaa mat fer mile par fer na aae ||497||
675.e: They composed mantras and established many sects, but they merged in the cycle of dreadful existence, that after that nothing could be known about them.497.

675.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਧ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਫੋਰਿ ਮੁਨੀਸ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਕੇ ਮਧਿ ਮਿਲਾਨੀ ॥
675.t: braham nira(n)dhr ko for munees kee jot su jot ke madh milaanee ||
675.e: Breaking the Brahmarandhra (an aperture in the crown of the head), the light of the king of sages merged in that Supreme Light

675.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਰਲੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਸੋ ਇਮ ਬੇਦਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
675.t: preet ralee paramesar so im bedhan sa(n)g milai jim baanee ||
675.e: His love was absorbed in the Lord like all kinds of compositions are interlinked in the Veda

675.g: ਪੁੰਨ ਕਥਾ ਮੁਨਿ ਨੰਦਨ ਕੀ ਕਹਿ ਕੈ ਮੁਖ ਸੋ ਕਬਿ ਸ੍ਯਾਮ ਬਖਾਨੀ ॥
675.t: pu(n)n kathaa mun na(n)dhan kee keh kai mukh so kab sayaam bakhaanee ||
675.e: In his way, the poet Shyam has described the episode of the great sage Dutt

675.g: ਪੂਰਣ ਧਿਆਇ ਭਯੋ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਜਯ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਜਗਨਾਥ ਭਵੇਸ ਭਵਾਨੀ ॥੪੯੮॥
675.t: pooran dhiaai bhayo tab hee jay sree jaganaath bhaves bhavaanee ||498||
675.e: This chapter is now being completed hailing the Lord of the world and the mother of the world.498.

675.g: ਇਤਿ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਾਟਕ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੇ ਦਤ ਮਹਾਤਮੇ ਰੁਦ੍ਰਵਤਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਸਮਾਪਤੰ ॥ ਸੁਭੰ ਭਵੇਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਚਉਬੀਸ ॥੨੪॥
675.t: eit sree bachitr naaTak gra(n)the dhat mahaatame rudhravataar praba(n)dh samaapata(n) || subha(n) bhavet guroo chaubees ||24||
675.e: End of the description of the composition regarding the sage Dutt, the incarnation of Rudra in Bachittar Natak.

675.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
675.t: ikOankaar satiguraprasaadh ||
675.e: The Lord is One and He can be attained through the Grace of the True Guru.

675.g: ਅਥ ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਥ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਕਥਨੰ ॥
675.t: ath paaras naath rudhr avataar kathana(n) ||
675.e: Now begins the description of Parasnath, the incarnation of Rudra. Tent Guru.

675.g: ਪਾਤਸਾਹੀ ੧੦ ॥
675.t: paatasaahee 10 ||
675.e: CHAUPAI

675.g: ਚੌਪਈ ॥
675.t: chauapiee ||

675.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦਤ ਰੁਦ੍ਰ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ ॥
675.t: eeh bidh dhat rudhr avataaraa ||

675.g: ਪੂਰਣ ਮਤ ਕੋ ਕੀਨ ਪਸਾਰਾ ॥
675.t: pooran mat ko keen pasaaraa ||
675.e: In this way there was the Dutt incarnation of Rudra and he spread his religion

675.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੋ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਨੀ ॥
675.t: a(n)t jot so jot milaanee ||

675.g: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਭਵਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
675.t: jeh bidh so paarabraham bhavaanee ||1||
675.e: In the end, according to the Will of the Lord, his light (soul) merged in the Supreme Light of the Lord.1.

675.g: ਏਕ ਲਛ ਦਸ ਬਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨਾ ॥
675.t: ek lachh dhas barakh pramaanaa ||

675.g: ਪਾਛੇ ਚਲਾ ਜੋਗ ਕੋ ਬਾਨਾ ॥
675.t: paachhe chalaa jog ko baanaa ||
675.e: After that, the Yoga-marga (path) continued its way for one lakh and ten years

675.g: ਗ੍ਰਯਾਰਵ ਬਰਖ ਬਿਤੀਤਤ ਭਯੋ ॥
675.t: grayaarav barakh biteetat bhayo ||

675.g: ਪਾਰਸਨਾਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਭੂਅ ਵਯੋ ॥੨॥
675.t: paarasanaath purakh bhooa vayo ||2||
675.e: With the passing away of the eleventh year, Parasnath was born on this earth.2.

675.g: ਰੋਹ ਦੇਸ ਸੁਭ ਦਿਨ ਭਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
675.t: roh dhes subh dhin bhal thaan ||

675.g: ਪਰਸ ਨਾਥ ਭਯੋ ਸੁਰ ਗ੍ਰਯਾਨੁ ॥
675.t: paras naath bhayo sur grayaan ||
675.e: On an auspicious day and at an auspicious place and country, he was born

675.g: ਅਮਿਤ ਤੇਜ ਅਸਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਹੋਊ ॥
675.t: amit tej as avar na houoo ||

675.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤ ਦੋਊ ॥੩॥
675.t: chakrat rahe maat pit dhouoo ||3||
675.e: He was supremely learned and glorious there was none so illustrious like him and seeing him, his parents were wonder-struck.3.

675.g: ਦਸਊ ਦਿਸਨਿ ਤੇਜ ਅਤਿ ਬਢਾ ॥
675.t: dhasuoo dhisan tej at baddaa ||

675.g: ਦ੍ਵਾਦਸ ਭਾਨ ਏਕ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਚਢਾ ॥
675.t: dhavaiaadhas bhaan ek havai chaddaa ||
675.e: His glory spread in all the ten directions and it seemed that the twelve suns were shining in one

675.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਲੋਕ ਉਠੇ ਅਕੁਲਾਈ ॥
675.t: dheh dhis lok uThe akulaiee ||

675.g: ਭੂਪਤਿ ਤੀਰ ਪੁਕਾਰੇ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
675.t: bhoopat teer pukaare jaiee ||4||
675.e: The people in all the ten directions felt agitated and went to the king for their lamenation.4.

676.e: “O king! Listen, we tell you an episode

676.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਮ ਰੂਪ ਜਗਤ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
676.t: jeh sam roop jagat nahee koiee ||

676.e: A very proud person has been born and there is none so beautiful like him it seems that the Lord (Providence) Himself had created him.5.
“Either he is a Yaksha or Gandharva it appears that a second sun has arisen
His body is gleaming with youth and seeing him, even the god of love is feeling shy.”6.
The king called him in order to see him and he (Parasnath) came on the very first day with the messengers
The king was pleased in his heart on seeing him wearing matted locks and it appeared to him that he was the second incarnation of Dutt.7.
Seeing his figure the sages wearing matted locks trembled and thought he was some incarnation,

676.g: ਯਹ ਮਤ ਦੂਰ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਕੈ ਹੈ ॥
676.t: yeh mat dhoor hamaaraa kai hai ||

676.g: ਜਟਾਧਾਰ ਕੋਈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਪੈ ਹੈ ॥੮॥
676.t: jaTaadhaar koiee rahai na pai hai ||8||
676.e: who will finish their religion and no person with matted locks will survive.8.
The king, seeing the impact of his glory, was extremely pleased
Whosoever saw him, he was pleased like one pauper obtaining nine treasures.9.
He put his net of allurement on all and all were getting succumbed in wonder

676.g: ਜਹ ਤਹ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਕਲ ਨਰ ਗਿਰੇ ॥
676.t: jeh teh moh sakal nar gire ||

676.e: All the people getting fascinated fell down here and there like the warriors falling in battle.10.

676.g: ਨਰ ਨਾਰੀ ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਪੇਖਾ ॥
676.t: nar naaree jeh jeh teh pekhaa ||

676.e: The man or woman, who saw him, considered him s the god of love
The hermits considered him as an adept and the Yogis as a great Yogi.11.

676.g: ਦੇ ਤਿਹ ਸੁਤਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਾ ॥
676.t: dhe teh sutaa nirapat man maanaa ||
676.e: The group of queens was allured on seeing him and the king also decided to marry his daughter with him
When he became the son-in-law of the king, then he became famous as a great archer.12.
That extremely beautiful and infinitely glorious persons was absorbed within himself

676.g: ਜਾ ਸਮ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਜਗਤਿ ਨ ਆਨਾ ॥੧੩॥
676.t: jaa sam pa(n)ddit jagat na aanaa ||13||
676.e: He was expert in the knowledge of Shastras and weapons and there was no Pandit like him in the world.13.
He was like a Yaksha in human garb, not being troubled by the outer afflictions

676.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਿਹ ਰੂਪ ਤਵਨ ਕਾ ਲਹਾ ॥
676.t: jeh jeh roop tavan kaa lahaa ||

676.g: ਸੋ ਸੋ ਚਮਕ ਚਕ੍ਰਿ ਹੁਐ ਰਹਾ ॥੧੪॥
676.t: so so chamak chakr huaai rahaa ||14||
676.e: Whosoever saw his beauty, he was wonder-struck and duped.14.
SWAYYA

676.g: ਮਾਨ ਭਰੇ ਸਰ ਸਾਨ ਧਰੇ ਮਠ ਸਾਨ ਚੜੇ ਅਸਿ ਸ੍ਰੋਣਤਿ ਸਾਏ ॥
676.t: maan bhare sar saan dhare maTh saan chaRe as sronat saae ||
676.e: He was glorious like the sword saturated with marrow

676.g: ਲੇਤ ਹਰੇ ਜਿਹ ਡੀਠ ਪਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੇ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾਨ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
676.t: let hare jeh ddeeTh pare nahee fer fire gireh jaan na paae ||
676.e: Whomsoever he saw, he could not go back to his home

676.g: ਝੀਮ ਝਰੇ ਜਨ ਸੇਲ ਹਰੇ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਜਨੁ ਦੇਖਨ ਆਏ ॥
676.t: jheem jhare jan sel hare ieh bhaat gire jan dhekhan aae ||
676.e: He, who came to see him he fell down swinging on the earth, whomsoever he saw, he was inflicted with the arrows of the god of love,

676.g: ਜਾਸੁ ਹਿਰੇ ਸੋਊ ਮੈਨ ਘਿਰੇ ਗਿਰ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਰੇ ਨ ਉਠੰਤ ਉਠਾਏ ॥੧੫॥
676.t: jaas hire souoo main ghire gir bhoom pare na uTha(n)t uThaae ||15||
676.e: He fell down there and writhed and could not get up to go.1.15.

676.g: ਸੋਭਤ ਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਧਾਸਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਕਾਮ ਕੇ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਕੂਪ ਸੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
676.t: sobhat jaan sudhaasar su(n)dhar kaam ke maanahu koop su dhaare ||
676.e: It seemed that the store of lust had been opened and Parasnath looked splendid like the moon

676.g: ਲਾਜਿ ਕੇ ਜਾਨ ਜਹਾਜ ਬਿਰਾਜਤ ਹੇਰਤ ਹੀ ਹਰ ਲੇਤ ਹਕਾਰੇ ॥
676.t: laaj ke jaan jahaaj biraajat herat hee har let hakaare ||
676.e: Even if there were ships stored with shyness and he allured everyone only on seeing

676.g: ਹਉ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਭ੍ਰਮ੍ਯੋ ਖਗ ਜ੍ਯੋਂ ਇਨ ਕੇ ਸਮ ਰੂਪ ਨ ਨੈਕੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
676.t: hau chahu ku(n)T bhramayo khag jayo(n) in ke sam roop na naik nihaare ||
676.e: In all the four directions, the persons like wandering birds were saying this that they had seen none so beautiful like him

677.g: ਪਾਰਥ ਬਾਨ ਕਿ ਜੁਬਨ ਖਾਨ ਕਿ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਕਿ ਕਾਮ ਕਟਾਰੇ ॥੧੬॥
677.t: paarath baan k juban khaan k kaal kirapaan k kaam kaTaare ||16||
677.e: He is a killer like Arjuna’s arrow, he is a mine of youth he controls all like the sward of youth KAL and is the dagger of lust.2

677.g: ਤੰਤ੍ਰ ਭਰੇ ਕਿਧੌ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਜਰੇ ਅਰ ਮੰਤ੍ਰ ਹਰੇ ਚਖ ਚੀਨਤ ਯਾ ਤੇ ॥
677.t: ta(n)tr bhare kidhau ja(n)tr jare ar ma(n)tr hare chakh cheenat yaa te ||
677.e: On seeing him, the impact of tantra, mantra and yantra ends

677.g: ਜੋਬਨ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗੇ ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੇ ਮਦ ਸੇ ਮਦੂਆ ਤੇ ॥
677.t: joban jot jage at su(n)dhar ra(n)g ra(n)ge madh se madhooaa te ||
677.e: His eyes, glistening with the light of youth appear to be extremely pretty and intoxicated

677.g: ਰੰਗ ਸਹਾਬ ਫੂਲ ਗੁਲਾਬ ਸੇ ਸੀਖੇ ਹੈ ਜੋਰਿ ਕਰੋਰਕ ਘਾਤੇ ॥
677.t: ra(n)g sahaab fool gulaab se seekhe hai jor karorak ghaate ||
677.e: His eyes can kill crores of people like the roses and

677.g: ਮਾਧੁਰੀ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਹੇਰਤਿ ਹੀ ਹਰ ਲੇਤ ਹੀਯਾ ਤੇ ॥੧੭॥
677.t: maadhuree moorat su(n)dhar soorat herat hee har let heeyaa te ||17||
677.e: Seeing his comely figure, the mind gets fascinated on seeing him.3.17.

677.g: ਪਾਨ ਚਬਾਇ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਬਨਾਇ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਲਗਾਇ ਸਭਾ ਜਬ ਆਵੈ ॥
677.t: paan chabai seegaar banai suga(n)dh lagai sabhaa jab aavai ||

677.g: ਕਿੰਨਰ ਜਛ ਭੁਜੰਗ ਚਰਾਚਰ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
677.t: ki(n)nar jachh bhuja(n)g charaachar dhev adhev dhouoo bisamaavai ||
677.e: When he went to the court on chewing the betel and fragrancing the body then all the Kinnars, Yakshas, Nagas, animate and inanimate beings, gods and demons were wonder-struck

677.g: ਮੋਹਿਤ ਜੇ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਗਨ ਮਾਨਨਿ ਮੋਹਤ ਤਉਨ ਮਹਾ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
677.t: mohit je meh logan maanan mohat taun mahaa sukh paavai ||
677.e: The human males and females were pleased on getting fascinated by him

677.g: ਵਾਰਹਿ ਹੀਰ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਚੀਰ ਤ੍ਰੀਯਾ ਬਿਨ ਧੀਰ ਸਬੈ ਬਲ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧੮॥
677.t: vaareh heer amolak cheer treeyaa bin dheer sabai bal jaavai ||18||
677.e: They sacrificed their presious garments, diamonds and jewels on him impatiently.4.18.

677.g: ਰੂਪ ਅਪਾਰ ਪੜੇ ਦਸ ਚਾਰ ਮਨੋ ਅਸੁਰਾਰਿ ਚਤੁਰ ਚਕ ਜਾਨ੍ਯੋ ॥
677.t: roop apaar paRe dhas chaar mano asuraar chatur chak jaanayo ||
677.e: Indra also marveled at Parasnath, the most beautiful person and expert in all the fourteen science

677.g: ਆਹਵ ਜੁਕਤਿ ਜਿਤੀਕ ਹੁਤੀ ਜਗ ਸਰਬਨ ਮੈ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਅਨੁਮਾਨ੍ਰਯੋ ॥
677.t: aahav jukat jiteek hutee jag saraban mai sab hee anumaanrayo ||
677.e: He knew all the arts of warfare,

677.g: ਦੇਸਿ ਬਿਦੇਸਨ ਜੀਤ ਜੁਧਾਬਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਚੰਦੋਵ ਦਸੋ ਦਿਸ ਤਾਨ੍ਰਯੋ ॥
677.t: dhes bidhesan jeet judhaabar kirat cha(n)dhov dhaso dhis taanrayo ||
677.e: And after conquering all the countries far and near, he flag of victory waved in all the ten directions

677.g: ਦੇਵਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਗੋਪੀਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਸਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੰਦ ਸਮਾਨ ਪਛਾਨ੍ਯੋ ॥੧੯॥
677.t: dhevan i(n)dhr gopeen gobi(n)dh nisaa kar cha(n)dh samaan pachhaanayo ||19||
677.e: The gods comprehended him as Indra, the gopis as Krishna and the night as the moon.5.19.

677.g: ਚਉਧਿਤ ਚਾਰ ਦਿਸਾ ਭਈ ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਾ ॥
677.t: chaudhit chaar dhisaa bhiee chakrat bhoom akaas dhuhoo(n) pahichaanaa ||
677.e: Illumined like the full moon, Parasnath caused all the four directions wonder about him

677.g: ਜੁਧ ਸਮਾਨ ਲਖ੍ਯੋ ਜਗ ਜੋਧਨ ਬੋਧਨ ਬੋਧ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
677.t: judh samaan lakhayo jag jodhan bodhan bodh mahaa anumaanaa ||
677.e: He became famous everywhere on the earth and in the sky the warriors recognized him as a warrior and the learned as learned

677.g: ਸੂਰ ਸਮਾਨ ਲਖਾ ਦਿਨ ਕੈ ਤਿਹ ਚੰਦ ਸਰੂਪ ਨਿਸਾ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਾ ॥
677.t: soor samaan lakhaa dhin kai teh cha(n)dh saroop nisaa pahichaanaa ||
677.e: The day considered him as the sun and the night as the moon

677.g: ਰਾਨਨਿ ਰਾਵਿ ਸਵਾਨਿਨ ਸਾਵ ਭਵਾਨਿਨ ਭਾਵ ਭਲੋ ਮਨਿ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੨੦॥
677.t: raanan raav savaanin saav bhavaanin bhaav bhalo man maanaa ||20||
677.e: The queens considered him as the king, other women as the husband and the goddess as love.6.20.

677.g: ਭੁਜੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਯਾਤ ਛੰਦ ॥
677.t: bhuja(n)g prayaat chha(n)dh ||
677.e: BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA

677.g: ਬਿਤੈ ਬਰਖ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਸਟ ਮਾਸੰ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨੰ ॥
677.t: bitai barakh dhavai asaT maasa(n) pramaana(n) ||

677.g: ਭਯੋ ਸੁਪ੍ਰਭੰ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਦ੍ਯਾ ਨਿਧਾਨੰ ॥
677.t: bhayo suprabha(n) sarab bidhayaa nidhaana(n) ||
677.e: Two years and eight months passed and Parasnath, the store of all learnings was known as a glorious king

677.g: ਜਪੈ ਹਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਠਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਪਾਣ ਦੇਵੀ ॥
677.t: japai hi(n)gulaa Thi(n)gulaa paan dhevee ||

677.g: ਅਨਾਸਾ ਛੁਧਾ ਅਤ੍ਰਧਾਰੀ ਅਭੇਵੀ ॥੨੧॥
677.t: anaasaa chhudhaa atradhaaree abhevee ||21||
677.e: He repeated the names of he goddess of Hinglaaj and the weapon-wearing Durga.21.

677.g: ਜਪੈ ਤੋਤਲਾ ਸੀਤਲਾ ਖਗ ਤਾਣੀ ॥
677.t: japai totalaa seetalaa khag taanee ||

677.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਾ ਭੈਹਰੀ ਭੀਮ ਰੂਪਾ ਭਵਾਣੀ ॥
677.t: bhramaa bhaiharee bheem roopaa bhavaanee ||
677.e: The worship of the goddesses like Shitala, Bhavani etc. was performed and t

677.g: ਚਲਾਚਲ ਸਿੰਘ ਝਮਾਝੰਮ ਅਤ੍ਰੰ ॥
677.t: chalaachal si(n)gh jhamaajha(n)m atra(n) ||

677.g: ਹਹਾ ਹੂਹਿ ਹਾਸੰ ਝਲਾ ਝਲ ਛਤ੍ਰੰ ॥੨੨॥
677.t: hahaa hooh haasa(n) jhalaa jhal chhatra(n) ||22||
677.e: He gleaming arms, weapons, splendour, canopy, pleasantry etc. increased his glory.22.

677.g: ਅਟਾ ਅਟ ਹਾਸੰ ਛਟਾ ਛੁਟ ਕੇਸੰ ॥
677.t: aTaa aT haasa(n) chhaTaa chhuT kesa(n) ||

677.g: ਅਸੰ ਓਧ ਪਾਣੰ ਨਮੋ ਕ੍ਰੂਰ ਭੇਸੰ ॥
677.t: asa(n) odh paana(n) namo kraoor bhesa(n) ||
677.e: The beauty of his enjoyment and his hair appeared extremely comely and his sword glistened like lightning in his hands

677.g: ਸਿਰੰਮਾਲ ਸ੍ਵਛੰ ਲਸੈ ਦੰਤ ਪੰਤੰ ॥
677.t: sira(n)maal savaichha(n) lasai dha(n)t pa(n)ta(n) ||

677.g: ਭਜੈ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੂੜੰ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲੰਤ ਸੰਤੰ ॥੨੩॥
677.t: bhajai satr gooRa(n) prafula(n)t sa(n)ta(n) ||23||
677.e: He had worn a pure rosary on his head and the rows of his teeth looked magnificent seeing him, the enemies fled away and the saints were pleased.23.

677.g: ਅਲਿੰਪਾਤਿ ਅਰਧੀ ਮਹਾ ਰੂਪ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
677.t: ali(n)paat aradhee mahaa roop raajai ||

677.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੋਤ ਜ੍ਵਾਲੰ ਕਰਾਲੰ ਬਿਰਾਜੈ ॥
677.t: mahaa jot javaiaala(n) karaala(n) biraajai ||
677.e: He appeared as a most beautiful king and there was a hideous halo of light around his face

677.g: ਤ੍ਰਸੈ ਦੁਸਟ ਪੁਸਟੰ ਹਸੈ ਸੁਧ ਸਾਧੰ ॥
677.t: trasai dhusaT pusaTa(n) hasai sudh saadha(n) ||

677.g: ਭਜੈ ਪਾਨ ਦੁਰਗਾ ਅਰੂਪੀ ਅਗਾਧੰ ॥੨੪॥
677.t: bhajai paan dhuragaa aroopee agaadha(n) ||24||
677.e: On seeing him, the tyrants got illusioned and the saints smiled in their pleased mind he remembered the formless and mysterious Durga,24.

677.g: ਸੁਨੇ ਉਸਤਤੀ ਭੀ ਭਵਾਨੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੰ ॥
677.t: sune usatatee bhee bhavaanee kirapaala(n) ||

677.g: ਅਧੰ ਉਰਧਵੀ ਆਪ ਰੂਪੀ ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥
677.t: adha(n) uradhavee aap roopee rasaala(n) ||
677.e: On listening to her praises, Bhavani was pleased on him and she endowed him with unique beauty

677.g: ਦਏ ਇਖ੍ਵਧੀ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਅਭੰਗੰ ਖਤੰਗੰ ॥
677.t: dhe ikhavaidhee dhavai abha(n)ga(n) khata(n)ga(n) ||

677.g: ਪਰਸ੍ਰਯੰ ਧਰੰ ਜਾਨ ਲੋਹੰ ਸੁਰੰਗੰ ॥੨੫॥
677.t: parasraya(n) dhara(n) jaan loha(n) sura(n)ga(n) ||25||
677.e: She gave him two unfailing arms which could cause the steel-armoured enemies to fall on the earth.25.

677.g: ਜਬੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਾਧੀ ਸਬੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਾਏ ॥
677.t: jabai sasatr saadhee sabai sasatr paae ||

677.g: ਉਘਾਰੇ ਚੂਮੇ ਕੰਠ ਸੀਸੰ ਛੁਹਾਏ ॥
677.t: aughaare choome ka(n)Th seesa(n) chhuhaae ||
677.e: When this king, practising the armament, obtained the weapons, he kissed them, hugged them and placed them on his head

677.g: ਲਖ੍ਯੋ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਵੰ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
677.t: lakhayo sarab raava(n) prabhaava(n) apaara(n) ||

677.g: ਅਜੋਨੀ ਅਜੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥੨੬॥
677.t: ajonee ajai bedh bidhiaa bichaara(n) ||26||
677.e: All the kings saw him as unconquerable warrior and a successful scholar of he Vedic learning.26.

677.g: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੀਤੁਆ ਜਬੈ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
677.t: giraheetuaa jabai sasatr asatra(n) apaara(n) ||

677.g: ਪੜੇ ਅਨੁਭਵੰ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
677.t: paRe anubhava(n) bedh bidhiaa bichaara(n) ||
677.e: After obtaining the unlimited arms and weapons, he also obtained the experience of the reflection of Vedic learning

677.g: ਪੜੇ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਹੁਤੀ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਸੰ ॥
677.t: paRe sarab bidhiaa hutee sarab dhesa(n) ||

677.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਸੀ ਸੁ ਅਸਤ੍ਰੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ॥੨੭॥
677.t: jite sarab dhesee su asatra(n) naresa(n) ||27||
677.e: He studies the sciences of all the countries and on the strength of his arms and weapons, he conquered the kings of all the countries.27.

677.g: ਪਠੇ ਕਾਗਦੰ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸੰ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
677.t: paThe kaagadha(n) dhes dhesa(n) apaaree ||

677.g: ਕਰੋ ਆਨਿ ਕੈ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦ੍ਯਾ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥
677.t: karo aan kai bedh bidhayaa bichaaree ||
677.e: He invited the scholars and sages from many countries far and near for consultations on Vedic learning

678.g: ਜਟੇ ਦੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਤਪੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਚਾਰੀ ॥
678.t: jaTe dha(n)dd mu(n)ddee tapee brahamachaaree ||

678.g: ਸਧੀ ਸ੍ਰਾਵਗੀ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੀ ॥੨੮॥
678.t: sadhee sraavagee bedh bidhiaa bichaaree ||28||
678.e: They included those with matted locks, Dandis, Mudis, ascetics, celibates, practisers and many other students and scholars of Vedic learning.28.

678.g: ਹਕਾਰੇ ਸਬੈ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਾ ਨਰੇਸੰ ॥
678.t: hakaare sabai dhes dhesaa naresa(n) ||

678.g: ਬੁਲਾਏ ਸਬੈ ਮੋਨ ਮਾਨੀ ਸੁ ਬੇਸੰ ॥
678.t: bulaae sabai mon maanee su besa(n) ||
678.e: The king of all the countries far and near and the silence-observing hermits were also called

678.g: ਜਟਾ ਧਾਰ ਜੇਤੇ ਕਹੂੰ ਦੇਖ ਪਈਯੈ ॥
678.t: jaTaa dhaar jete kahoo(n) dhekh pieeyai ||

678.g: ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਨਾਥ ਭਾਖੈ ਬੁਲਈਯੈ ॥੨੯॥
678.t: bulaavai tisai naath bhaakhai bulieeyai ||29||
678.e: Wherever an ascetic with matted locks was seen, he was also invited with the permission of Parasnath.29.

678.g: ਫਿਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਦੇਸੰ ਨਰੇਸੰ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥
678.t: fire sarab dhesa(n) naresa(n) bulaavai ||

678.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਨ ਤਿਸੈ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਛੈਣੀ ਛਿਨਾਵੈ ॥
678.t: mile na tisai chhatr chhainee chhinaavai ||
678.e: The kings of all the countries were called and whosoever refused to meet the messengers, his canopy and the army were seixed

678.g: ਪਠੇ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਏਕੈ ਦਿਸਾ ਏਕ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
678.t: paThe patr ekai dhisaa ek dhaavai ||

678.g: ਜਟੀ ਦੰਡ ਮੁੰਡੀ ਕਹੂੰ ਹਾਥ ਆਵੈ ॥੩੦॥
678.t: jaTee dha(n)dd mu(n)ddee kahoo(n) haath aavai ||30||
678.e: The letters and persons were sent to all directions, so that if any ascetic with matted locks, Dandi, Mundi was found, he was brought.30.

678.g: ਰਚ੍ਯੋ ਜਗ ਰਾਜਾ ਚਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
678.t: rachayo jag raajaa chale sarab jogee ||

678.g: ਜਹਾ ਲਉ ਕੋਈ ਬੂਢ ਬਾਰੋ ਸਭੋਗੀ ॥
678.t: jahaa lau koiee boodd baaro sabhogee ||
678.e: Then the king performed a Yajna, in which all the Yogis, children, old men came,

678.g: ਕਹਾ ਰੰਕ ਰਾਜਾ ਕਹਾ ਨਾਰ ਹੋਈ ॥
678.t: kahaa ra(n)k raajaa kahaa naar hoiee ||

678.g: ਰਚ੍ਯੋ ਜਗ ਰਾਜਾ ਚਲਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਕੋਈ ॥੩੧॥
678.t: rachayo jag raajaa chalio sarab koiee ||31||
678.e: Kings, paupers, men, women etc. all came for participation.31.

678.g: ਫਿਰੇ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਸਰਬਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਸੰ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
678.t: fire patr sarabatr dhesa(n) apaara(n) ||

678.g: ਜੁਰੇ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਜਾ ਨ੍ਰਿਪੰ ਆਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੰ ॥
678.t: jure sarab raajaa nirapa(n) aan dhuaara(n) ||
678.e: Invitations were sent to all the countries and all the kings reached at the gate of Parasnath

678.g: ਜਹਾ ਲੌ ਹੁਤੇ ਜਗਤ ਮੈ ਜਟਾਧਾਰੀ ॥
678.t: jahaa lau hute jagat mai jaTaadhaaree ||

678.g: ਮਿਲੈ ਰੋਹ ਦੇਸੰ ਭਏ ਭੇਖ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੩੨॥
678.t: milai roh dhesa(n) bhe bhekh bhaaree ||32||
678.e: All the ascetics with matted locks in the world, they all gathered together and reached before the king.32.

678.g: ਜਹਾ ਲਉ ਹੁਤੇ ਜੋਗ ਜੋਗਿਸਟ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
678.t: jahaa lau hute jog jogisaT saadhe ||

678.g: ਮਲੇ ਮੁਖ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ਸੁ ਲੰਗੋਟ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
678.t: male mukh bibhoota(n) su la(n)goT baadhe ||
678.e: The practising Yogis, smeared with ashes and wearing lion-cloth and all sages resided there peacefully

678.g: ਜਟਾ ਸੀਸ ਧਾਰੇ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
678.t: jaTaa sees dhaare nihaare apaara(n) ||

678.g: ਮਹਾ ਜੋਗ ਧਾਰੰ ਸੁਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥੩੩॥
678.t: mahaa jog dhaara(n) subidhiaa bichaara(n) ||33||
678.e: Many great Yogis, scholars, and the ascetics with matted locks were seen there.33.

678.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਪੰ ਬੁਲੇ ਸਰਬ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
678.t: jite sarab bhoopa(n) bule sarab raajaa ||

678.g: ਚਹੂੰ ਚਕ ਮੋ ਦਾਨ ਨੀਸਾਨ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
678.t: chahoo(n) chak mo dhaan neesaan baajaa ||
678.e: All the kings were invited by Parasnath and in all the four directions, he became famous as a donor

678.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਾਨ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
678.t: mile dhes dhesaan anek ma(n)tree ||

678.g: ਕਰੈ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਜੋਗ ਬਾਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਤੰਤ੍ਰੀ ॥੩੪॥
678.t: karai saadhanaa jog baaja(n)tr ta(n)tree ||34||
678.e: Many ministers of the countries gathered there, the musical instruments of the practising Yogis were played there.34.

678.g: ਜਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਭੂਮਿ ਸਥਲੀ ਸੰਤ ਆਹੇ ॥
678.t: jite sarab bhoom sathalee sa(n)t aahe ||

678.g: ਤਿਤੇ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਥੰ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
678.t: tite sarab paaras naatha(n) bulaae ||
678.e: All the saints who had come at that place, they were all called by Prasnath

678.g: ਦਏ ਭਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਭੋਜ ਅਰਘ ਦਾਨੰ ॥
678.t: dhe bhaat anek bhoj aragh dhaana(n) ||

678.g: ਲਜੀ ਪੇਖ ਦੇਵਿ ਸਥਲੀ ਮੋਨ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੩੫॥
678.t: lajee pekh dhev sathalee mon maana(n) ||35||
678.e: He served them with various types of food and bestowed charities on them, seeing which the abode of the gods felt shy.35.

678.g: ਕਰੈ ਬੈਠ ਕੇ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
678.t: karai baiTh ke bedh bidhiaa bichaara(n) ||

678.g: ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੋ ਸਬੈ ਆਪੁ ਆਪੰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰੰ ॥
678.t: prakaaso sabai aap aapa(n) prakaara(n) ||
678.e: All sitting there held consultations in their own way regarding Vedic learning

678.g: ਟਕੰ ਟਕ ਲਾਗੀ ਮੁਖੰ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੇਖਿਓ ॥
678.t: Taka(n) Tak laagee mukha(n) mukh pekhio ||

678.g: ਸੁਨ੍ਯੋ ਕਾਨ ਹੋ ਤੋ ਸੁ ਤੋ ਆਖਿ ਦੇਖਿਓ ॥੩੬॥
678.t: sunayo kaan ho to su to aakh dhekhio ||36||
678.e: All of them saw pointedly towards one another and whatever they had heard earlier with their ears, on that day they saw it there with their own eyes.36.

678.g: ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੋ ਸਬੈ ਆਪ ਆਪੰ ਪੁਰਾਣੰ ॥
678.t: prakaaso sabai aap aapa(n) puraana(n) ||

678.g: ਰੜੋ ਦੇਸਿ ਦੇਸਾਣ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮੁਹਾਣੰ ॥
678.t: raRo dhes dhesaan bidhiaa muhaana(n) ||
678.e: All of them opened up their Puranas and began to study their country’s lore

678.g: ਕਰੋ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤੰ ਸੁ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਚਾਰੰ ॥
678.t: karo bhaat bhaata(n) su bidhiaa bichaara(n) ||

678.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਭੈ ਚਿਤ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਮਹਾ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ਟਾਰੰ ॥੩੭॥
678.t: nirabhai chit dhai kai mahaa traas Taara(n) ||37||
678.e: They began to reflect fearlessly on their lore in various ways.37.

678.g: ਜੁਰੇ ਬੰਗਸੀ ਰਾਫਿਜੀ ਰੋਹਿ ਰੂਮੀ ॥
678.t: jure ba(n)gasee raafijee roh roomee ||

678.g: ਚਲੇ ਬਾਲਖੀ ਛਾਡ ਕੈ ਰਾਜ ਭੂਮੀ ॥
678.t: chale baalakhee chhaadd kai raaj bhoomee ||

678.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਭੈ ਭਿੰਭਰੀ ਕਾਸਮੀਰੀ ਕੰਧਾਰੀ ॥
678.t: nirabhai bhi(n)bharee kaasameeree ka(n)dhaaree ||

678.g: ਕਿ ਕੈ ਕਾਲਮਾਖੀ ਕਸੇ ਕਾਸਕਾਰੀ ॥੩੮॥
678.t: k kai kaalamaakhee kase kaasakaaree ||38||
678.e: There were gathered there the residents of Bang country, rafzi, Rohelas, Sami, Balakshi, Kashmiri, Kandhari and several Kal-mukhi Snnyasis.38.

678.g: ਜੁਰੇ ਦਛਣੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬੇਤਾ ਅਰਯਾਰੇ ॥
678.t: jure dhachhanee sasatr betaa arayaare ||

678.g: ਦ੍ਰੁਜੈ ਦ੍ਰਾਵੜੀ ਤਪਤ ਤਈਲੰਗ ਵਾਰੇ ॥
678.t: dhrujai dhraavaRee tapat tieela(n)g vaare ||
678.e: The southern scholars of Shastras and the Dravidian and Telangi Savants has also gathered there

678.g: ਪਰੰ ਪੂਰਬੀ ਉਤ੍ਰ ਦੇਸੀ ਅਪਾਰੰ ॥
678.t: para(n) poorabee utr dhesee apaara(n) ||

678.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸੇਣ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਝਾਰੰ ॥੩੯॥
678.t: mile dhes dhesen jodhaa jujhaara(n) ||39||
678.e: Alongwith them there were gathered warriors of Eastern and Northern countries.39.

678.g: ਪਾਧਰੀ ਛੰਦ ॥
678.t: paadharee chha(n)dh ||
678.e: PAADHARI STANZA

678.g: ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਬੀਰ ਜੋਰਿ ॥
678.t: eeh bhaat beer bahu beer jor ||

679.e: In this way, Parasnath gathered together many brave fighters and kings of various countries far and near

679.g: ਦੇ ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਬਹੁ ਦਿਰਬ ਸਾਜ ॥
679.t: dhe heer cheer bahu dhirab saaj ||

679.e: And honoured all of them donating wealth and garments to them.40.
There many canopied and fearless Yogis there
There were seated there unconquerable warriors, experts in arms and weapons, indestructible fighters, many mighty heroes, who had conquered thousand of wars.41.

679.g: ਸਬ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸ ਕੇ ਜੀਤ ਰਾਵ ॥
679.t: sab dhes dhes ke jeet raav ||

679.e: Parasnath had taken various kinds of measures, had conquered the kings of various countries in wars

679.g: ਕੈ ਸਾਮ ਦਾਮ ਅਰੁ ਦੰਡ ਭੇਦ ॥
679.t: kai saam dhaam ar dha(n)dd bhedh ||

679.e: On the strength of Saam Daam, Dand and Bhed, he brought all together and brought them his control.42.
When all the kings were brought together by the great Parasnath and al of them gave him the letter of victory,
Then Parasnath gave unlimited wealth and garments to them and allured them.43.
One day, Parasnath went for the worship of the goddess
He adored her in various ways, whose description here I have composed in Mohani Stanza.44.
MOHANI STANZA
“Hail, O Bhairavi, Durga, You are the destroyer of fear, You ferry across the ocean of existence,
the rider of the lion, the destroyer of fear and generous Creator!45.
“You are blemishless, adopter of arms, the fascinator of all the worlds, the Kshatriya goddess
You are Sati Savitri with blood-saturated limbs and the Supremely Immaculate Parmeshwari.46.
“You are the youthful goddess of sweet words
You are the destroyer of worldly sufferings and redeemer of all
You are Rajeshwari full of beauty and wisdom
I hail you, O the attainer of all powers.47.
“O supporter of the world! You are superb for the devotees
Holding the arms and weapons in your hands
You have the revolving maces in your hand and on their strength, You appear to be Supreme.48.
“You are superb amongst Yakshas and Kinnars
The Gandharvas and Siddhas (adepts) remain present at your feet
Your figure is pure like the lightning in clouds.49.
“Holding the sword in your hand, You honour the saints,
The giver of comfort and destroyer of sorrow
You are the destroyer of tyrants, redeemer of the saints
You are invincible and treasure of Virtues.50.
“You are he bliss-giving girija Kumari
You are indestructible, the destroyer of all and the redeemer of all
You are the eternal goddess Kali, but alongwith it,
You are the doe-eyed most beautiful goddess.51.
“You are the wife of Rudra with blood-saturated limbs
You are the chopper of all, but You are also Pure and Bliss-giving goddess
You are the mistress of activity and harmony
You are the alluring deity and the sword-bearing Kali.52.
“You are the Donor of gifts and the destroyer of the world, the goddess Durga!
You sit on the left limb of Rudra, the blood-coloured goddess
You are Parmeshwari and the Piety-adopting Mother.53.
“You are the killer of Mahishasura You are kali,
The destroyer of Chachhasura and also the Sustainer of the earth
You are the pride of he goddesses,
The carrier of sword in the hand and Durga, the Giver of Victory.54.
“You are the brown-eyed immaculate Parvati, Savitri and Gayatri
You are the remover of fear, the mighty goddess Durga
Hail, hail to Thee.55.
You are the mother Durga,
“You are the destroyer of armies in the war, the perisher of the fear of all
The killer of the enemies like Chand and Mund,
Hail, O goddess, the giver of victory.56.
“You are the one who ferries across the ocean of the world
You are the one who roams and crushes everyone
O Durga! you are the cause of the creation of all the worlds
And you are the remover of the suffering of Indrani.57.

680.e: “You have the portrait like beautiful limbs and your plays are extensive
You are the store of wisdom and the well of glory
O mother! You are modest and blemishless.59
“Hanuman and Bairava jump and wander with your strength
O mother! you are the Donor of Victory
You are the mistress of al the worlds and You are Durga, who ferries across the cycle of existence.60.
“O goddess! You have engrossed all the world in sleep, hunger and thirst
O KAL! You are the goddess like Ratri and Indrani and the redeemer of the devotees.61.
“O Mother! the Vedas have also sung the Praises of your victory
You are Indiscriminate and Indestructible
You are the remover of the fear of the saints, the giver of victory and sword-wielder.”62.
ACHKARA STANZA BY THY GRACE
“O Goddess! You are Ambika and Shitala being intoxicated, you may falter
You are influential like the ocean You are also Dakini
“You are the performer of Sambhavi Mudra (a kind of osture) and the remover of suffering
You are absorbed in all, doer of good to all, greatly glorious and the destroyer of all.63.
“You manifest yourself in accordance with everyone’s emotion  You are the fear-remover of the world
You are the chopper of everyone and associated with them, you are profound and serene like the sea
“You are the double-edged sword and double-faced Durga  you are invincible
You are Hinglaj, the remover of the fear of all and all remember Thy Name.64.
You are the rider of lion; you have charming eyes;
You are Hinglaj, Pinglaj, a Gandharva woman and a Yaksha woman;
“You are the destroyer of armours
You are the sword-wielder and thundering goddess and you are the lance like a female serpent.65.
“You are renowned for your large body
You are Hinglaj and the goddess Kartikeyi You are glorious and indestructible and the base of all deaths
“Your various names are Ginglaj, Hinglaj, Thinglaj, Pinglaj
You are Chamunda of tricky speed.66.
“O Goddess! You are invincible, indiscriminate, non-white and base of all
You are unchopable and beyond all splendours
“You are also Anjani, the mother of Hanuman  you are Ambika, who holds the weapons
You are imperishable, support of all and the redeemer of the world.67.
“You are Anjani, you are Shitala, the destroyer of all
You are serene like the sea and always remain absorbed
“You are alert, serene  you are large and invincible like the sky
You have enwrapped all the world within yourself and you yourself are ineffaceable and destroyer of all.68.
“O Goddess! you are Bhairavi, the remover of fear and the mover in the world in the world
You are the Trikuti, Yogini, Chamunda and Manavi in practice
“You are youthful, the killer of the demon Jambh

681.e: You are the goddess Kalika lisping, stuttering and stammering while being intoxicated.69.
“You are the wanderer, fulfiller of the emotions beyond the illusions and the remover of fear
You are the donor of boons and the destroyer of enemies
“You are indiscriminate, invincible and high like the tree
You are the wielder of arms, beyond all splendours, with lose matted locks and indistinguishable.70.
“You are expert in Tantras and Mantras and black (Kali) like a cloud
You have a large body  You are the remover of fear and you are the emotion-manifestation of the whole world
“You are Dakini, Shakini and sweet in speech
O Goddess! You are Kalika having the sound of Kinkini  Hail to Thee.71.
“You have a subtle form  You are the adorable Hinglaj and Pinglaj
You are the wielder of arms and weapons and the agoniser like the thorn
“O the Goddess of corn, pervading in all particles! You are the one to arise from the cloud and become and renowned  Hail to thee.
You are the quality to activity, power-manifestation and sustainer of the saints, Hail to Thee.72.
“You are Goddess and the rules of prosody
You are also Yogni, Enjoyer and Kalika, the destroyer of ailments
“You are ever active in the form of Chamunda and you are charming like a portrait
You are the mistress of the Tantas You are all pervading and have canopy over your head.73.
“You are the lightning of large teeth You are unstoppable and far away from all illusions
You are also the movement of all including hunger, sleep and garb
“You are the bow-wielder and ornament-wearer woman
You are everywhere seated in various adorable forms.”74.
VISHNUPADA SAYING (A MUSICAL MODE) PARAZ

681.g: ਜਾਨੁਕ ਨਿਪਟ ਅਘਟ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਮ ਸੰਪਟ ਸੁਭਟ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥
681.t: jaanuk nipaT aghaT a(n)mirat sam sa(n)paT subhaT bichaaro ||
681.e: How can I describe the Gory of thy feet? Thy feet are auspicious and vice-less like lotus

681.g: ਮਨ ਮਧੁਕਰਹਿ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲਨ ਪਰ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਮਨਮਤ ਗੁੰਜਾਰੋ ॥
681.t: man madhukareh charan kamalan par havai manmat gu(n)jaaro ||
681.e: My mind has become a bumble bee and is humming over the lotus-feet

681.g: ਮਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਸਪਤ ਸਪਿਤ ਪਿਤਰਨ ਕੁਲ ਚੌਦਹੂੰ ਕੁਲੀ ਉਧਾਰੋ ॥੭੫॥
681.t: maatirak sapat sapit pitaran kul chauadhahoo(n) kulee udhaaro ||75||
681.e: This being will be redeemed alongwith the fourteen generations of parents and manes (if it meditates on Thy Lotus-Feet).175.
VISHNUPADA KAFI

681.g: ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਦੇਹ ਸਫਲ ਕਰ ਜਾਨੋ ॥
681.t: taa dhin dheh safal kar jaano ||
681.e: I shall accept that day fruitful and blessed, on which the mother of the world,

681.g: ਜਾ ਦਿਨ ਜਗਤ ਮਾਤ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਦੇਹਿ ਬਿਜੈ ਬਰਦਾਨੋ ॥
681.t: jaa dhin jagat maat prafulit havai dheh bijai baradhaano ||
681.e: Getting pleased, will bestow on me the boon of victory

681.g: ਤਾ ਦਿਨ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਕਟਿ ਬਾਧੋ ਚੰਦਨ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਲਗਾਊਾਂ ॥
681.t: taa dhin sasatr asatr kaT baadho cha(n)dhan chitr lagaauooaa(n) ||
681.e: On that day I shall fasten the arms and weapons with my waist, and plaster the place with sandal

681.g: ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ਨੇਤ ਨਿਗਮ ਕਹਿ ਬੋਲਤ ਤਾਸੁ ਸੁ ਬਰੁ ਜਬ ਪਾਊਾਂ ॥੭੬॥
681.t: jaa kahu net nigam keh bolat taasu su bar jab paauooaa(n) ||76||
681.e: From her I shall obtain the boon, whom the Vedas etc. call “neti, neti’ (not this, not this).2.76.
VISHNUPADA SORATHA SAYING BY THY GRACE
The Goddess Bhavani who understands everything contained in the mind,

681.g: ਅਤਿ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੋ ਚਿਤ ਕੀ ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
681.t: at hee nirakh prem paaras ko chit kee birathaa pachhaanee ||
681.e: Seeing the extreme love of the king Parasnath, understood his mind-thought

681.g: ਆਪਨ ਭਗਤ ਜਾਨ ਭਵਖੰਡਨ ਅਭਯ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਯੋ ॥
681.t: aapan bhagat jaan bhavakha(n)ddan abhay roop dhikhaayo ||
681.e: Considering him Her devotee, the goddess showed him her fearless form

681.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਤ ਰਹੇ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਰ ਅਜਰ ਅਮਰ ਪਦ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੭੭॥
681.t: chakrat rahe pekh mun jan sur ajar amar padh paayo ||77||
681.e: Seeing it all the sages and men were wonder-struck and all of them attained the supreme State.3.77.

681.g: ਜਾ ਤਰ ਜਛ ਕਿੰਨਰ ਅਸੁਰਨ ਕੀ ਸਬ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਯਾ ਹਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
681.t: jaa tar jachh ki(n)nar asuran kee sab kee kirayaa hiraanee ||
681.e: In the left hand of the goddess that sword was there, with which she had destroyed all the Yakshas, demons and Kinnars etc.

681.g: ਜਾ ਤਨ ਮਧੁ ਕੀਟਭ ਕਹੁ ਖੰਡ੍ਯੋ ਸੁੰਭ ਨਿਸੁੰਭ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ॥
681.t: jaa tan madh keeTabh kahu kha(n)ddayo su(n)bh nisu(n)bh sa(n)ghaare ||

681.g: ਸੋਈ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਲਗੇ ਜਗ ਦਾਇਨ ਰਹੋ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੭੮॥
681.t: soiee kirapaan nidhaan lage jag dhain raho hamaare ||78||
681.e: The same sword had killed Madhu-Kaitabh and Shumbh-Nishumbh. O Lord! the same sword may ever be on my left side i.e. I may wear it.4.78.

681.g: ਜਾ ਤਨ ਬਿੜਾਲਾਛ ਚਿਛ੍ਰਾਦਿਕ ਖੰਡਨ ਖੰਡ ਉਡਾਏ ॥
681.t: jaa tan biRaalaachh chichhraadhik kha(n)ddan kha(n)dd uddaae ||

681.g: ਧੂਲੀਕਰਨ ਧੂਮ੍ਰਲੋਚਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਸਨ ਗਿਧ ਰਜਾਏ ॥
681.t: dhooleekaran dhoomralochan ke maasan gidh rajaae ||
681.e: Biralaksh, Chakshrasura etc. were torn into bits and with the same sword, the flesh of Dhumar Lochan was caused to be eaten by the vultures to their fill

681.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਸੂਲ ਕਿਸਨ ਬਿਸਨਾਦਿਕ ਕਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਵਾਲਹਿ ਕੂਟੇ ॥
681.t: raam rasool kisan bisanaadhik kaal kravaaleh kooTe ||
681.e: Ram, Muhammad, Krishna, Vishnu etc., All were destroyed by this sword of KAL

681.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਸਭ ਥਾਕੇ ਬਿਨ ਤਿਹ ਭਜਨ ਨ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੭੯॥
681.t: koT upai dhai sabh thaake bin teh bhajan na chhooTe ||79||
681.e: Crores of measures, but without the devotion of One Lord, no one achieved redemption.5.79.
VISHNUPADA SUHI SAYING BY THY GRACE

681.g: ਜਾ ਤਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਈ ਖੰਡੇ ਬਿਸਨ ਕ੍ਰੋਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
681.t: jaa tan i(n)dhr koT kiee kha(n)dde bisan kror tirapuraaree ||
681.e: There is that sword in His hand, which had chopped crores of Vishnus, Indras and Shivas

681.g: ਜਾ ਕਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਉਚਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਬ ਸੇਵਤ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਗਾਏ ॥
681.t: jaa kahu raam uchar mun jan sab sevat dhiaan lagaae ||
681.e: The sages meditate on that sword-like power

682.g: ਤਸ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਬਾਰ ਉਪਾਇ ਮਿਟਾਏ ॥੮੦॥
682.t: tas tum raam kirasan kiee koTik baar upai miTaae ||80||
682.e: O Power! You created heroes like Rama and Krishna many times and destroyer them many times.6.80.

682.g: ਅਨਭਵ ਰੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਅਗੰਜਨ ਕਹੋ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਗਈਯੈ ॥
682.t: anabhav roop saroop aga(n)jan kaho kavan bidh gieeyai ||
682.e: Your figure is a thing of perception how can I sing about it?

682.g: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਰਟਤ ਗੁਨ ਥਾਕੀ ਕਬਿ ਜਿਹਵੇਕ ਬਤਈਯੈ ॥
682.t: jihabaa saha(n)sr raTat gun thaakee kab jihavek batieeyai ||
682.e: The tongue of the poet sings about your thousands of qualities and gets tired

682.g: ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਰ ਜਵਨ ਕਰ ਚਉਦਹਿ ਖੰਡ ਬਿਹੰਡੇ ॥
682.t: bhoom akaas pataar javan kar chaudheh kha(n)dd biha(n)dde ||
682.e: He, who destroyers the earth, sky nether-world and the fourteen world,

682.g: ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੋਤਿ ਭੂਤਲਿ ਮੈ ਖੰਡਨ ਅਉ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੇ ॥੮੧॥
682.t: jagamag jot hot bhootal mai kha(n)ddan aau brahama(n)dde ||81||
682.e: The Light of that Power is shining everywhere.781.

682.g: ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ॥ ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
682.t: bisanapadh || soraTh ||
682.e: VISHNUPADA SORATHA

682.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਰੂਪ ਅਰੇਖ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
682.t: jai jai roop arekh apaar ||
682.e: His form is infinite and beyond dimension

682.g: ਜਾਸਿ ਪਾਇ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਇ ਜਹ ਤਹ ਭੀਖ ਕੋ ਸਿਵ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
682.t: jaas pai bhramai jeh teh bheekh ko siv dhuaar ||
682.e: Even Shiva is begging and wandering for his realization

682.g: ਜਾਸਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗ੍ਯੋ ਨਿਸੇਸਿਹ ਕਾਰਮਾ ਤਨ ਏਕ ॥
682.t: jaas pai lagayo niseseh kaaramaa tan ek ||
682.e: Chandra is also lying at His feet and

682.g: ਦੇਵਤੇਸ ਸਹੰਸ੍ਰ ਭੇ ਭਗ ਜਾਸਿ ਪਾਇ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੮੨॥
682.t: dhevates saha(n)sr bhe bhag jaas pai anek ||82||
682.e: For His realization Indra had got marks of a thousand genital organs of woman on his body.8.82.

682.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਰਾਮ ਭਏ ਕਿਤੇ ਪੁਨਿ ਕਾਲ ਪਾਇ ਬਿਹਾਨ ॥
682.t: kirasan raam bhe kite pun kaal pai bihaan ||

682.g: ਕਾਲ ਕੋ ਅਨਕਾਲ ਕੈ ਅਕਲੰਕ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਮਾਨ ॥
682.t: kaal ko anakaal kai akala(n)k moorat maan ||
682.e: Because of the impact of KAL, many Krishna and Ramas have been created, but KAL himself is indestructible and blemishless

682.g: ਜਾਸਿ ਪਾਇ ਭਯੋ ਸਭੈ ਜਗ ਜਾਸ ਪਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਨ ॥
682.t: jaas pai bhayo sabhai jag jaas pai bilaan ||

682.g: ਤਾਹਿ ਤੈ ਅਬਿਚਾਰ ਜੜ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥੮੩॥
682.t: taeh tai abichaar jaR karataar kaeh na jaan ||83||
682.e: He, with the impact of whose Feel, the world is created and destroyed, O fool! why do you not pray to Him, considering Him as the creator?.9.83.

682.g: ਨਰਹਰਿ ਜਾਨ ਕਾਹਿ ਨ ਲੇਤ ॥
682.t: narahar jaan kaeh na let ||

682.g: ਤੈ ਭਰੋਸ ਪਰ੍ਯੋ ਪਸੂ ਜਿਹ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਧਿ ਅਚੇਤ ॥
682.t: tai bharos parayo pasoo jeh moh badh achet ||
682.e: O being! Why do you not comprehend the Lord and are lying unconscious in attachment under the impact of maya?

682.g: ਰਾਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਰਸੂਲ ਕੋ ਉਠਿ ਲੇਤ ਨਿਤਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
682.t: raam kirasan rasool ko uTh let nitaprat naau ||

682.g: ਕਹਾ ਵੈ ਅਬ ਜੀਅਤ ਜਗ ਮੈ ਕਹਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੋ ਗਾਉ ॥੮੪॥
682.t: kahaa vai ab jeeat jag mai kahaa tin ko gaau ||84||
682.e: O being! You always remember the names of Rama, Krishna and Rasul, tell me, are they alive and is there any abode of theirs in the world?10.84.

682.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ॥
682.t: soraTh ||
682.e: SORATH

682.g: ਤਾਸ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਪਛਾਨਹੀ ਜੇ ਹੋਹਿ ਹੈ ਅਬ ਹੈ ॥
682.t: taas kiau na pachhaanahee je hoh hai ab hai ||
682.e: Why do you not pray to Him, who will be there in future and who is there in the present?

682.g: ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਹੇ ਭਜਤ ਪਾਹਨ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਛੁ ਫਲਿ ਦੈ ॥
682.t: nihafal kaahe bhajat paahan toh kachh fal dhai ||
682.e: You are worshipping the stones uselessly what will you gain by that worship?

682.g: ਤਾਸੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਜਾਸ ਸੇਵਤਿ ਹੋਹਿ ਪੂਰਣ ਕਾਮ ॥
682.t: taas sevahu jaas sevat hoh pooran kaam ||
682.e: Only worship Him who will fulfil your wishes

682.g: ਹੋਹਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਕਲ ਪੂਰਣ ਲੈਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ॥੮੫॥
682.t: hoh manasaa sakal pooran lait jaa ke naam ||85||
682.e: Mediate on that Name, which will fulfil your wishes.11.85.

682.g: ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ॥ ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
682.t: bisanapadh || raamakalee || tavaiprasaadh ||
682.e: VISHNUPADA RAMKALI BY THY GRACE

682.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਜਬੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
682.t: eeh bidh keenee jabai baddaiee ||

682.g: ਰੀਝੇ ਦੇਵ ਦਿਆਲ ਤਿਹ ਉਪਰ ਪੂਰਣ ਪੁਰਖ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
682.t: reejhe dhev dhiaal teh upar pooran purakh sukhadhaiee ||
682.e: When He was eulogized in this way, then the perfect Purusha, the Lord was pleased with the king Parasnath

682.g: ਆਪਨਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਦੇਵਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਭਯੋ ਸਿੰਘ ਕਰੀ ਅਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
682.t: aapan mile dhev dharasan bhayo si(n)gh karee asavaaree ||
682.e: In order to bestow His sight to him, He mounted on a lion

682.g: ਲੀਨੇ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਲੰਕੁਰਾ ਕੂਦਤ ਨਾਚਤ ਗਣ ਦੈ ਤਾਰੀ ॥੮੬॥
682.t: leene chhatr la(n)kuraa koodhat naachat gan dhai taaree ||86||
682.e: He had a canopy over His head and the ganas, demons etc. began to dance in front of Him.12.86.

682.g: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ॥
682.t: raamakalee ||

682.g: ਝਮਕਤ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਛਟਾ ਸਸਤ੍ਰਨਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਜਤ ਡਉਰ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
682.t: jhamakat asatr chhaTaa sasatran kee baajat ddaur apaar ||
682.e: The arms and weapons glistened and the thunderous tabors were played

682.g: ਨਿਰਤਤ ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਨਾਨਾ ਬਿਧਿ ਡਹਕਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬੈਤਾਰ ॥
682.t: niratat bhoot pret naanaa bidh ddahakat firat baitaar ||
682.e: The ghosts, fiends and Vaitals danced and wandered

682.g: ਕੁਹਕਤਿ ਫਿਰਤਿ ਕਾਕਣੀ ਕੁਹਰਤ ਡਹਕਤ ਕਠਨ ਮਸਾਨ ॥
682.t: kuhakat firat kaakanee kuharat ddahakat kaThan masaan ||
682.e: The crows cawed and the ghosts etc. laughed

682.g: ਘਹਰਤਿ ਗਗਨਿ ਸਘਨ ਰਿਖ ਦਹਲਤ ਬਿਚਰਤ ਬ੍ਯੋਮ ਬਿਵਾਨ ॥੮੭॥
682.t: ghaharat gagan saghan rikh dhahalat bicharat bayom bivaan ||87||
682.e: The sky thundered and the sages in fear wandered in their air-vehicles.13.87.

682.g: ਦੇਵੀ ਬਾਚ ॥
682.t: dhevee baach ||
682.e: Speech of the Goddess :

682.g: ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ॥ ਸਾਰੰਗ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
682.t: bisanapadh || saara(n)g || tavaiprasaadh ||
682.e: SARANG VISHNUPADA. BY THY GRACE

682.g: ਕਛੂ ਬਰ ਮਾਗਹੁ ਪੂਤ ਸਯਾਨੇ ॥
682.t: kachhoo bar maagahu poot sayaane ||
682.e: “O son! ask for a boon

682.g: ਭੂਤ ਭਵਿਖ ਨਹੀ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰ ਸਾਧ ਚਰਿਤ ਹਮ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
682.t: bhoot bhavikh nahee tumaree sar saadh charit ham jaane ||
682.e: No one has practised austerities like you in the past and there will also be none in the future

682.g: ਜੋ ਬਰਦਾਨ ਚਹੋ ਸੋ ਮਾਗੋ ਸਬ ਹਮ ਤੁਮੈ ਦਿਵਾਰ ॥
682.t: jo baradhaan chaho so maago sab ham tumai dhivaar ||
682.e: “You may ask for anything, I shall grant the same

682.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਰਤਨ ਬਜ੍ਰ ਮੁਕਤਾਫਲ ਲੀਜਹਿ ਸਕਲ ਸੁ ਧਾਰ ॥੮੮॥
682.t: ka(n)chan ratan bajr mukataafal leejeh sakal su dhaar ||88||
682.e: I shall bestow on you the gold, Vajra, the fruit of salvation or anything else, I shall bestow the same on you.”14.88.

682.g: ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਥ ਬਾਚ ॥
682.t: paaras naath baach ||
682.e: Speech of Parasnath :

682.g: ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ॥ ਸਾਰੰਗ ॥
682.t: bisanapadh || saara(n)g ||
682.e: SARANG VISHNUPADA

682.g: ਸਬ ਹੀ ਪੜੋ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਿਧਿ ਸਬ ਹੀ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਚਲਾਊ ॥
682.t: sab hee paRo bedh bidhiaa bidh sab hee sasatr chalaauoo ||
682.e: “I may become the knower of all the Vedic learning and may also be able to strike successfully all the weapons

682.g: ਸਬ ਹੀ ਦੇਸ ਜੇਰ ਕਰਿ ਆਪਨ ਆਪੇ ਮਤਾ ਮਤਾਊ ॥
682.t: sab hee dhes jer kar aapan aape mataa mataauoo ||
682.e: I may conquer all the countries and start my own sect.”

682.g: ਕਹਿ ਤਥਾਸਤੁ ਭਈ ਲੋਪ ਚੰਡਿਕਾ ਤਾਸ ਮਹਾ ਬਰ ਦੈ ਕੈ ॥
682.t: keh tathaasat bhiee lop cha(n)ddikaa taas mahaa bar dhai kai ||

682.g: ਅੰਤ੍ਰ ਧ੍ਯਾਨ ਹੁਐ ਗਈ ਆਪਨ ਪਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਅਰੂੜਤ ਹੁਐ ਕੈ ॥੮੯॥
682.t: a(n)tr dhayaan huaai giee aapan par si(n)gh arooRat huaai kai ||89||
682.e: The Goddess Chandi said, “Let it be” and disappeared after riding on her lion.15.89.

682.g: ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ॥ ਗਉਰੀ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
682.t: bisanapadh || gauree || tavaiprasaadh ||
682.e: VISHNUPADA BY THY GRACE GAURI

682.g: ਪਾਰਸ ਕਰਿ ਡੰਡੌਤ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਏ ॥
682.t: paaras kar dda(n)ddauat fir aae ||

682.g: ਆਵਤ ਬੀਰ ਦੇਸ ਦੇਸਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਭੇਜ ਬੁਲਾਏ ॥
682.t: aavat beer dhes dhesan te maanukh bhej bulaae ||
682.e: Parasnath came back after prostrating before the Goddess and as soon as he came back, he sent messages and called the warriors from all the countries far and near

683.g: ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੋ ਰੂਪ ਬਿਲੋਕਿ ਸੁਭਟ ਸਭ ਚਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਚਿਤ ਬਿਸਮਾਏ ॥
683.t: nirap ko roop bilok subhaT sabh chakirat chit bisamaae ||

683.g: ਐਸੇ ਕਬਹੀ ਲਖੇ ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜਾ ਜੈਸੇ ਆਜ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
683.t: aaise kabahee lakhe nahee raajaa jaise aaj lakhaae ||
683.e: Seeing the glorious personality of the king all were wonder-struck and said, “We have never seen such personality of the king before which we are seeing today

683.g: ਚਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਈ ਗਗਨਿ ਕੀ ਬਾਲਾ ਗਨ ਉਡਗਨ ਬਿਰਮਾਏ ॥
683.t: chakirat bhiee gagan kee baalaa gan uddagan biramaae ||

683.g: ਝਿਮਝਿਮ ਮੇਘ ਬੂੰਦ ਜ੍ਯੋਂ ਦੇਵਨ ਅਮਰ ਪੁਹਪ ਬਰਖਾਏ ॥
683.t: jhimajhim megh boo(n)dh jayo(n) dhevan amar puhap barakhaae ||
683.e: The heavenly damsels also marveled and the ganas etc.also wondered, the gods showered flowered like rain-drops

683.g: ਜਾਨੁਕ ਜੁਬਨ ਖਾਨ ਹੁਐ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਰੂਪ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਅਨੁਵਾਏ ॥
683.t: jaanuk juban khaan huaai nikase roop si(n)dh anuvaae ||
683.e: The king appeared like a mine of youth, having come out form the ocean of beauty after taking bath

683.g: ਜਾਨੁਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਨਿਡਰ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਪਰ ਕਾਮ ਕਲੇਵਰ ਆਏ ॥੯੦॥
683.t: jaanuk dhaar niddar basudhaa par kaam kalevar aae ||90||
683.e: He seemed like an incarnation of the god of love on earth.16.90.

683.g: ਬਿਸਨਪਦਿ ॥ ਸਾਰੰਗ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
683.t: bisanapadh || saara(n)g || tavaiprasaadh ||
683.e: VISHNUPADA SARANG BY THY GRACE

683.g: ਭੂਪਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਜਬ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
683.t: bhoopat param gayaan jab paayo ||

683.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕਰਮ ਕਠਨ ਕਰ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜੌ ਕਰਿ ਧ੍ਯਾਨ ਲਗਾਯੋ ॥
683.t: man bach karam kaThan kar taa ko jau kar dhayaan lagaayo ||
683.e: When the king obtained the Supreme knowledge, he had earlier performed rigorous austerities for the realization of the Lord, with his mind, speech and action

683.g: ਕਰਿ ਬਹੁ ਨ੍ਯਾਸ ਕਠਨ ਜਪੁ ਸਾਧ੍ਰਯੋ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਦੀਯੋ ਭਵਾਨੀ ॥
683.t: kar bahu nayaas kaThan jap saadhrayo dharasan dheeyo bhavaanee ||
683.e: When he performed various kinds of difficult postures and the repetition of God’s Name, then the goddess Bhavani appeared before him

683.g: ਤਤਛਿਨ ਪਰਮ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਉਪਦੇਸ੍ਯੋ ਲੋਕ ਚਤੁਰਦਸ ਰਾਨੀ ॥
683.t: tatachhin param gayaan upadhesayo lok chaturadhas raanee ||
683.e: She, the mistress of all the fourteen worlds instructed him regarding Supreme Knowledge

683.g: ਤਿਹ ਛਿਨ ਸਰਬ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰ ਮੁਖ ਉਚਰੇ ਤਤ ਅਤਤ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥
683.t: teh chhin sarab saasatr mukh uchare tat atat pachhaanaa ||
683.e: The king obtained the recognition of essence and non-essence at the same moment and he recited all the Shastras from his mouth

683.g: ਅਵਰ ਅਤਤ ਸਬੈ ਕਰ ਜਾਨੇ ਏਕ ਤਤ ਠਹਰਾਨਾ ॥
683.t: avar atat sabai kar jaane ek tat Thaharaanaa ||
683.e: Considering all the elements as destructible, he accepted only one Essence as indestructible

683.g: ਅਨਭਵ ਜੋਤਿ ਅਨੂਪ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸੀ ਅਨਹਦ ਨਾਦ ਬਜਾਯੋ ॥
683.t: anabhav jot anoop prakaasee anahadh naadh bajaayo ||
683.e: Perceiving the unique Light of the Supreme Soul, he blissfully blew he Unstruck Melody

683.g: ਦੇਸ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਜੀਤਿ ਰਾਜਨ ਕਹੁ ਸੁਭਟ ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਪਾਯੋ ॥੯੧॥
683.t: dhes bidhes jeet raajan kahu subhaT abhai padh paayo ||91||
683.e: He achieved the fearless state on conquering the kings of all the countries far and near.17.91.

683.g: ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ॥ ਪਰਜ ॥
683.t: bisanapadh || paraj ||
683.e: VISHNUPADA PARAJ

683.g: ਐਸੇ ਅਮਰਪਦ ਕਹੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
683.t: aaise amarapadh kahu pai ||

683.g: ਦੇਸ ਅਉਰ ਬਿਦੇਸ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਜੀਤਿ ਲੀਨ ਬੁਲਾਇ ॥
683.t: dhes aaur bidhes bhoopat jeet leen bulai ||
683.e: In this was, achieving the everlasting state, disciplining the kings of various countries, he invited them

683.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਗੁਮਾਨ ਨਿਸਾਨ ਸਰਬ ਬਜਾਇ ॥
683.t: bhaat bhaat bhare gumaan nisaan sarab bajai ||

683.g: ਚਉਪ ਚਉਪ ਚਲੇ ਚਮੂੰਪਤਿ ਚਿਤ ਚਉਪ ਬਢਾਇ ॥
683.t: chaup chaup chale chamoo(n)pat chit chaup baddai ||
683.e: They, getting pleased marched proudly towards Parasnath, sounding their trumpets

683.g: ਆਨਿ ਆਨਿ ਸਬੈ ਲਗੇ ਪਗ ਭੂਪ ਕੇ ਜੁਹਰਾਇ ॥
683.t: aan aan sabai lage pag bhoop ke juharai ||

683.g: ਆਵ ਆਵ ਸੁਭਾਵ ਸੋ ਕਹਿ ਲੀਨ ਕੰਠ ਲਗਾਇ ॥
683.t: aav aav subhaav so keh leen ka(n)Th lagai ||
683.e: They all came and bowed at the feet of the Sovereign, who welcomed them all and hugged them

683.g: ਹੀਰ ਚੀਰ ਸੁ ਬਾਜ ਦੈ ਗਜ ਰਾਜ ਦੈ ਪਹਿਰਾਇ ॥
683.t: heer cheer su baaj dhai gaj raaj dhai pahirai ||

683.g: ਸਾਧ ਦੈ ਸਨਮਾਨ ਕੈ ਕਰ ਲੀਨ ਚਿਤ ਚੁਰਾਇ ॥੯੨॥
683.t: saadh dhai sanamaan kai kar leen chit churai ||92||
683.e: He gave them ornaments, garments, elephants, horses etc. and in this way, honouring all of them, he allured their mind.18.92.

683.g: ਬਿਸਨਪਦ ॥ ਕਾਫੀ ॥ ਤ੍ਵਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
683.t: bisanapadh || kaafee || tavaiprasaadh ||
683.e: KAFI VISHNUPADA BY THY GRACE

683.g: ਇਮ ਕਰ ਦਾਨ ਦੈ ਸਨਮਾਨ ॥
683.t: eim kar dhaan dhai sanamaan ||

683.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਿਮੋਹਿ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਭੂਪ ਬੁਧ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
683.t: bhaat bhaat bimoh bhoopat bhoop budh nidhaan ||
683.e: In this way, giving them gifts and honouring them, Parashnath, the store of wisdom, fascinated the mind of all

683.g: ਭਾਤਿ ਭਾਤਿਨ ਸਾਜ ਦੈ ਬਰ ਬਾਜ ਅਉ ਗਜਰਾਜ ॥
683.t: bhaat bhaatin saaj dhai bar baaj aau gajaraaj ||
